title: E16-012 tl_ui::run(UiLaunch) entry point for tl-app
description:
## Context
`tl-app` cannot depend on gpui-kit (ADR-001 tl-app row: tl-model, tl-engine, tl-ui, tl-ops, tl-tray only), so it cannot call `Application::run` itself. This bead adds one entry point in tl-ui that owns the GPUI application loop: `tl_ui::run(UiLaunch) -> UiExit`. tl-app builds a `UiLaunch` and calls it in UI-SHL-110 step 8, then uses the returned `UiExit` for engine shutdown (E33-011) and the renderer-failure and device-loss paths (E33-012). Sources: ADR-001 (allowed rows), ADR-009 (`app.rs`), ADR-010, ADR-015 (device loss), UI-SHL-110 steps 8 to 11, U-2 (`Application::run` returns on Linux after `cx.quit()`), R-153 item 1 (B1's E33-OI-1 proposal is replaced by this shape). Phase P0, because E33-A1 (P0) calls it.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs` (created by E16-A1):

```rust
pub struct UiLaunch {
    pub client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>,
    pub init: UiInit,                       // the E16-A1 struct, unchanged
    pub open: OpenMode,
    pub start: StartOptions,
}
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum OpenMode { Main, Gallery, LowMemory }
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct StartOptions {
    pub tab: Option<<general.start_tab type>>, // `--tab`; use the tl-model type of `general.start_tab` from crates/tl-model/src/settings.rs
    pub select_pid: Option<u32>,            // `--select-pid`
    pub start_minimized: bool,              // `--start-minimized`
    pub shift_held: bool,                   // UI-SHL-110 step 6 (X11 reading by tl-app); false on Wayland
    pub pending_crash_report: Option<PathBuf>, // UI-SHL-093
}
impl Global for StartOptions {}
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum UiExit { Quit, RendererFailed(String), DeviceLost }
pub struct UiExitSlot(pub Option<UiExit>);  // Global; first writer wins
impl Global for UiExitSlot {}
pub fn request_exit(cx: &mut App, exit: UiExit); // sets UiExitSlot if empty, then cx.quit()
pub struct OpenHooks {
    pub main: Option<Box<dyn Fn(&mut App)>>,
    pub gallery: Option<Box<dyn Fn(&mut App)>>,
    pub low_memory: Option<Box<dyn Fn(&mut App)>>,
}
impl Global for OpenHooks {}
/// Runs the GPUI application on the calling thread (the main thread).
/// Returns after the application quits.
pub fn run(launch: UiLaunch) -> UiExit;
fn open_first(cx: &mut App, mode: OpenMode);
```

Body of `run`:
1. `let app = gpui_kit::application().with_assets(components::icons::TlAssets).with_quit_mode(QuitMode::Explicit);` (asset source from E15-005). `QuitMode::Explicit` keeps the app alive when its last window closes (ADR-010); gpui-pre 0.3.7 defines `pub enum QuitMode { Default, LastWindowClosed, Explicit }` at `src/app.rs:389` and `Application::with_quit_mode` at `src/app.rs:227` (R-178). The UI quits only through `request_exit` / `cx.quit()`.
2. Wrap the next step in `std::panic::catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(..))`.
3. `app.run(move |cx| { cx.set_global(launch.start); cx.set_global(UiExitSlot(None)); cx.set_global(OpenHooks { main: None, gallery: None, low_memory: None }); TasklensUi::init(cx, launch.client, launch.init); open_first(cx, launch.open); })`. Write the comment line `// E32-013: low-memory init` directly before the `TasklensUi::init` call: E32-013 (tasklens-m1f.15) replaces that call with a dispatch on `launch.open` that calls `windows::low_memory::init_low_memory` for `OpenMode::LowMemory` (R-243). `OpenMode` derives `Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug`.
4. Result: if the closure panicked before `open_first` returned, return `UiExit::RendererFailed(<panic message as String, or "unknown renderer error">)`. If it panicked later, resume the panic (`std::panic::resume_unwind`), so the APP-055 panic hook handles it. Otherwise return the value in `UiExitSlot`, or `UiExit::Quit` when empty. Read the slot through a `Rc<Cell<Option<UiExit>>>` shared with the closure, because the App is gone after `run` returns: `request_exit` writes both the Global and the cell.
5. If U-2 shows that `Application::run` does not return on Linux, `request_exit` and the Quit path call `std::process::exit` instead, after running `UiInit`'s persist callback. Do not build that fallback now. Leave a `// U-2:` comment at the return point that says so.

`open_first(cx, mode)` takes the matching hook out of `OpenHooks` and calls it. A missing hook logs `error!(target: "tasklens::ui", ?mode, "no window registered")` and calls `request_exit(cx, UiExit::Quit)`. Hooks are installed by their owners through a one-line chain edit at a `// open hooks` comment in `TasklensUi::init`: E20 (main window), E01 (gallery, behind feature `bench`), E32 (low-memory window). Device-loss detection is not in this bead: whoever detects it (E33-012) calls `request_exit(cx, UiExit::DeviceLost)`.

`lib.rs`: `pub use app::{run, request_exit, OpenHooks, OpenMode, StartOptions, UiExit, UiLaunch};`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a TestAppContext after `TasklensUi::init` with a FakeEngine, and a `main` hook that records a call, **When** `open_first(cx, OpenMode::Main)` runs, **Then** the hook is called once.
- **Given** no hook for `OpenMode::Gallery`, **When** `open_first(cx, OpenMode::Gallery)` runs, **Then** an error is logged, `UiExitSlot` holds `UiExit::Quit` and no panic happens.
- **Given** `request_exit(cx, UiExit::DeviceLost)` ran, **When** `request_exit(cx, UiExit::Quit)` runs after it, **Then** `UiExitSlot` still holds `UiExit::DeviceLost`.
- **Given** a `StartOptions { select_pid: Some(42), .. }` installed by the launch closure, **When** a test reads `cx.global::<StartOptions>()`, **Then** `select_pid == Some(42)`.
- **Given** the workspace, **When** `cargo tree -p tl-app -e normal --depth 1` is read, **Then** gpui-kit is not a direct dependency of tl-app.
- **Given** a TestAppContext with `QuitMode::Explicit` set **When** the last open window is removed **Then** the app does not quit and `UiExitSlot` stays empty (R-178).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs`: change. Add the types and functions above, and the `// open hooks` comment line in `TasklensUi::init`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: change. One `pub use` line.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_hub.rs`: change. Add the tests below (E16 owns the file).

## Tests
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::open_first_calls_main_hook`: criterion 1, through `open_first` (made `pub(crate)` plus a `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))] pub fn open_first_for_test`), never through `run`, which blocks.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::open_first_missing_hook_quits`: criterion 2.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::request_exit_first_writer_wins`: criterion 3.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::start_options_global_installed`: criterion 4.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::explicit_quit_mode_survives_last_window`: the `QuitMode::Explicit` criterion (set it with `cx.set_quit_mode(QuitMode::Explicit)`, `src/app.rs:1754`, because the test does not go through `run`).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: a missing hook is logged at `error` and the app quits. A panic before the first window becomes `UiExit::RendererFailed`; tl-app shows the notice (E33-012). No user text in this bead.
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: N/A
- Performance: inside the ADR-014 first-frame gate (200 ms warm). `run` adds no work beyond `init` and the hook.
- Privacy: logs only the mode name, never settings contents or paths (ADR-015).

## Notes
- `gpui_kit::application` is re-exported from `gpui_platform` (`gpui-component/crates/kit/src/lib.rs:168`). Check how its `run` reports a failed renderer start before relying on the panic path; if it calls `std::process::exit` itself, record that in the U-2 row and report to the leader.
- The fields B1 proposed in E33-OI-1 map like this (settled, R-153 items 1 and 2): settings, state, themes_json, persist, persist_themes, app_requests and queued toasts are in `UiInit` (E16-A1); `start_tab`, `select_pid`, `start_minimized`, `pending_crash_report` are in `StartOptions`; `debug` is not needed by tl-ui (logging is set up by tl-app); `on_quit` is replaced by the return value of `run`.
- Build rule: run every cargo build, test, check, clippy or doc through `heavy-build`, for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_hub`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_hub.rs`. Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first.
- `UiLaunch` has no `platform` field: the tl-app-only features (Ctrl+Esc through kglobalaccel, TaskSlinger import) reach tl-ui through `AppEnv.global_shortcut` and `AppEnv.import_taskslinger` in `UiInit` (R-153 item 3 as ADR-009 records it, R-171). Device loss: whoever detects it calls `request_exit(cx, UiExit::DeviceLost)`; tl-app relaunches once with `TASKLENS_RELAUNCHED=1` (R-153 item 4). U-2 stays open and E33-011 (cr0.14) answers it (R-153 item 5).
close_reason: tl_ui::run(UiLaunch) -> UiExit, StartOptions, UiExitSlot, request_exit, OpenHooks, open_first and the // open hooks line in TasklensUi::init; 6 tests in ui_hub.rs. Commit 8a086b9

comments.text: Leader: fut.1 could not register the asset source in TasklensUi::init (gpui-pre 0.3.7 has no setter on App). tl_ui::run must call Application::with_assets(TlAssets); add a test or check that icons resolve.

title: TlMenu: rebuild on gpui_kit base parts so keys and look meet the spec
description:
Files: crates/tl-ui/src/components/menu.rs (and its tests).
Why: fut.13 (e73594f..bd46582) built TlMenu over the styled kit PopupMenu as the bead said. The kit keeps the highlight and layout private, so these spec points fail: Home, End and jump-by-letter keys; Down and Right land on header rows; Left out of a submenu leaves the submenu drawn with no highlight; mark column about 13 px instead of 20; separators 2 px; headers use the kit label style instead of t_xs at 22 px; submenu overlap 8 px instead of 4; item heights fixed at 26 px and do not follow ui_scale.
Leader decision: same rule as select.rs, tabs.rs and slider.rs: build TlMenu on gpui_kit::base unstyled parts with a tasklens-owned highlight state. Keep the public TlMenu builder API and context_menu_layer so callers do not change. Keep the Space binding in bind_keys_components.
AC: the 8 existing menu tests pass. New tests: Home and End move to the first and last enabled item; typing a letter jumps to the next item starting with it; Down and Right skip headers and disabled items; Left closes the submenu and restores the parent highlight; mark column 20 px, separator 1 px, header 22 px high, submenu overlap 4 px, row height scales with ui_scale 1.1. clippy -p tl-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean.
close_reason: TlMenu rebuilt on unstyled elements with a tasklens-owned TlMenuPopup (highlight, open submenu, Home/End, type-ahead, header skip, Left/Esc close, 20 px mark column, 1 px separators, 22 px headers, 4 px overlap with flip, ui_scale rows, 150 ms hover open). a619f28, 2bb48c9. 17 menu tests pass.

title: Toast stack: own layout and look per UI-FND-020 instead of the kit Sonner stack
description:
Files: crates/tl-ui/src/components/toast.rs, crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_toasts.rs, crates/tl-ui/src/components/button.rs (one builder only).
Why: fut.9 (176b16f, baa9ecf, 44808d2) built the ToastQueue but draws through the kit toast stack. The kit overlaps toasts with a 14 px peek and spreads them only on hover, adds its own close button on hover, keeps its own shadow, and only skips motion on cx.reduce_motion(), not on the motion.animations setting. UI-FND-020 wants a 6 px gap with the newest at the bottom, one close button, the spec shadow, and no motion when animations are off. The X icon is 16 px because TlButton has no icon size option.
Leader decision: draw the stack in tasklens code on gpui_kit::base parts (same rule as select.rs and menu.rs), keep the ToastQueue API and all its rules unchanged. Add TlButton::icon_size(..) (default unchanged) and use i_sm for the toast X. Move the kind words in the tooltip ("Error: " and so on) to i18n keys in assets/locales/en-US.ftl.
AC: the 12 ui_toasts tests pass with reduced motion off as well as on. New tests: 3 toasts are laid out bottom-up with 6 px gaps and no overlap without hover; only one close button per toast; with motion.animations = false no enter or exit animation runs; the X icon is i_sm. clippy -p tl-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean.
close_reason: Toast stack drawn in tasklens code: ToastQueue is a view mounted by the ToastLayer Root plugin (toast::init, registered in TasklensUi::init). 6 px gaps, newest at the bottom, one close button with an i_sm X, toast shadow 0 4 16, enter and exit gated on animations_on. Tooltip kind words moved to fnd-toast-tip-* keys. TlButton::icon_size added. Commits e312cba 48a27f8 6982ac3 ae22cb5. ui_toasts 32/32 passing in both motion modes.

title: Secondary window keys: bind Esc and Ctrl+W in bind_keys_global, not inside the first open
description:
Files: crates/tl-ui/src/components/window_frame.rs, crates/tl-ui/src/actions.rs, crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_dialogs.rs.
Why: fut.12 (33e9cf5..a7ede73) binds the secondary window Esc and Ctrl+W keys once inside the first TlSecondaryWindow::open call, because it could not edit app.rs. Key bindings belong in actions::bind_keys_global (jqk.4), which TasklensUi::init calls.
Deliverable: move the two bindings into a window_frame::bind_keys(cx) called from bind_keys_global; remove the bind-on-first-open code.
AC: the 9 ui_dialogs tests pass; a new test opens a secondary window after init and Esc closes it without any earlier open having run. clippy -p tl-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean with and without test-hooks.

title: Run window: scale RUN_SIZE with ui_scale_pct
description:
Files: crates/tl-ui/src/components/window_frame.rs, crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_props.rs.
Why: gma.5 (82a7dd2) found that the Run window always opens at the unscaled RUN_SIZE 480 x 248 because window_frame.rs forces that size, so it ignores ui_scale_pct while every other process window scales.
Deliverable: multiply RUN_SIZE by the UI scale where window_frame.rs applies it, like windows/frame.rs does for the other kinds.
AC: Run opens at 600 x 310 at 125% scale and at 480 x 248 at 100%. Existing ui_props and ui_dialogs tests pass. clippy clean with and without test-hooks.

title: E16-A2 Windows, dialogs, toasts
description:
## Context
Anchor E16-A2 (Windows, dialogs, toasts). Builds `WindowRegistry`, the one place that knows every open secondary window by `WindowKey`: it focuses an open window instead of opening a second, enforces the per-kind caps, and closes children with the main window. When this bead closes the E16-A2 group is complete: `components/toast.rs`, `components/dialog.rs`, `components/window_frame.rs` and `window/registry.rs` exist and are exported, and `tests/ui_toasts.rs` and `tests/ui_dialogs.rs` pass. It closes the group beads E16-006 (ToastQueue), E16-008 (TlSecondaryWindow), E16-007 (TlDialog). Spec phase P1; priority 0 because E18-A2 (P0) opens the column picker through it. Sources: UI-FND-021 (registry, caps, close rules), UI-SHL-090 (refocus of shell windows), INDEX.md "Window keys", APP-045 (main window closes children; detached graphs kept when `graphs.keep_detached_on_close`), PROC-077 (8 Properties windows).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/window/registry.rs` (E16-008 created the file with `WindowKey`; this bead adds the registry):
```rust
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug)]
pub enum WindowKey {
    Properties(ProcessKey),            // cap 8 (PROC-077)
    AppProperties(GroupKey),           // cap 8
    Service(UnitRef),                  // cap 10
    StartupProperties(StartupRef),     // cap 10
    ConnectionProperties(u64),         // cap 10, socket cookie
    Run, HandleSearch, Columns,
    Settings, ThemeEditor, ShareTheme, About, CrashReport, AdditionalSetup, Shortcuts, PublicIpNotice, CollectorHealth,
    Smart(DeviceIdx), DiskInUse(DeviceIdx),
    DetachedGraph(u8), Mini,
    Main,                              // the main window (R-176); never stored in the map, cap_class() is None
}
pub enum CapClass { ProcessProps, AppProps, ServiceProps, StartupProps, ConnectionProps }
impl WindowKey { pub fn cap_class(&self) -> Option<CapClass>; }
pub const CAP_PROCESS_PROPS: usize = 8; pub const CAP_APP_PROPS: usize = 8;
pub const CAP_SERVICE_PROPS: usize = 10; pub const CAP_STARTUP_PROPS: usize = 10; pub const CAP_CONNECTION_PROPS: usize = 10;
pub enum OpenOutcome { Focused, Opened, CapReached(CapClass), Failed }
pub struct WindowRegistry { windows: FxHashMap<WindowKey, AnyWindowHandle> }
pub struct GlobalRegistry(pub Entity<WindowRegistry>); impl Global for GlobalRegistry {}
impl WindowRegistry {
    pub fn open_or_focus(&mut self, key: WindowKey, cx: &mut Context<Self>,
                         open: impl FnOnce(&mut App) -> gpui::Result<AnyWindowHandle>) -> OpenOutcome;
    pub fn get(&self, key: &WindowKey) -> Option<AnyWindowHandle>;
    pub fn close(&mut self, key: &WindowKey, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    pub fn close_children_of_main(&mut self, keep_detached: bool, cx: &mut Context<Self>); // called when the main window closes
    pub fn count(&self, class: CapClass) -> usize;
    pub fn has_key(&self, pred: impl Fn(&WindowKey) -> bool) -> bool;     // R-218
    pub fn count_where(&self, pred: impl Fn(&WindowKey) -> bool) -> usize; // R-218 (named count_where because count(class) exists)
}
```
Rules:
- `open_or_focus`: if `key` is open, `window.activate_window()` on it and return `Focused` (UI-SHL-090: `OpenAbout` twice leaves one About window). Else if the key has a cap class and `count(class) >= cap`, return `CapReached(class)` and open nothing (the owner shows its toast, for example "Too many process properties windows are already open", UI-PRC-015). Else call `open`, store the handle, return `Opened`, or `Failed` if `open` errs.
- The registry removes a key when its window closes (observe window release / `on_window_should_close` hook installed by `TlSecondaryWindow::open` through `GlobalRegistry`).
- Every insert and every removal calls `cx.notify()` on the registry entity, so observers (E20-028 close row 2) see each change (R-218).
- `has_key(pred)` is true when any stored key matches; `count_where(pred)` counts the matches. E20-028 calls `has_key(|k| matches!(k, WindowKey::DetachedGraph(_)))` (R-218).
- `close_children_of_main(keep_detached)`: closes every registered window; when `keep_detached` (`graphs.keep_detached_on_close`) is true it keeps `DetachedGraph(_)` windows (APP-045).
- Confirmations, Set Affinity, Set Priority and Send Signal have no key (modal children of their parent); the low-memory window has none (own process).
Install `GlobalRegistry` in `TasklensUi::init` (chain edit of one line in `app.rs`, same batch).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** About is open **When** `open_or_focus(About)` runs again **Then** the existing window is activated and the open closure is not called.
- **Given** 8 process Properties windows open **When** a ninth `Properties(key)` is requested **Then** the result is `CapReached(ProcessProps)` and no window opens.
- **Given** 10 Service windows open **When** an eleventh is requested **Then** `CapReached(ServiceProps)` is returned.
- **Given** a registered window **When** the user closes it **Then** its key is removed and `count` drops by one.
- **Given** Settings, a Properties window and a detached graph open and `keep_detached = true` **When** `close_children_of_main` runs **Then** Settings and Properties close and the detached graph stays.
- **Given** the same with `keep_detached = false` **When** it runs **Then** all three close.
- **Given** one `DetachedGraph(0)` and one About window registered **When** `has_key(|k| matches!(k, WindowKey::DetachedGraph(_)))` and `count_where(|_| true)` run **Then** they return true and 2.
- **Given** an observer on the registry entity **When** a window is registered and then closed **Then** the observer runs once for each change.
- **Given** the E16-A2 group **When** `cargo test -p tl-ui` runs **Then** `tests/ui_toasts.rs` and `tests/ui_dialogs.rs` pass.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/window/registry.rs`: add `WindowRegistry`, `GlobalRegistry`, caps, `OpenOutcome`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/window_frame.rs`: one call to deregister on close (chain edit inside the batch).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs`: install `GlobalRegistry` (one line).
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_dialogs.rs`: add the tests below.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::secondary_window_refocus` (UI-SHL-090)
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::ninth_properties_refused` (UI-FND-021 `registry::tests::ninth_properties_refused`)
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::service_cap_is_10`
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::closed_window_deregisters`
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::main_close_closes_children` (with and without `keep_detached`)
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::registry_has_key_and_count_where`: criterion with `DetachedGraph(0)` and About.
- `tests/ui_dialogs.rs::registry_notifies_on_insert_and_remove`: observer count after open and close.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `Failed` when the open closure errs; the owner shows its error toast ("Could not open properties." for Properties).
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: refocus brings the existing window to the front with keyboard focus inside it.
- Performance: hash map lookups only.
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- The main window's own close path (UI-SHL-113, E20) calls `close_children_of_main`; that call is E20's.
- Build rule: run cargo only through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>` (run `git add` on new files first). Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first. Sources: `docs/ui/foundation.md` UI-FND-021, `docs/ui/INDEX.md` window keys, `docs/ui/shell.md` UI-SHL-090, `docs/spec/merged/sys-app.md` APP-045.
close_reason: WindowRegistry, GlobalRegistry, caps, OpenOutcome, cap_class in window/registry.rs; GlobalRegistry installed in TasklensUi::init; 7 registry tests in ui_dialogs.rs. Deregistration uses App::on_window_closed in the registry, so window_frame.rs needed no change. Commit 4e6dc4a

title: E16-A3 Menus, shield, action tracker
description:
## Context
Anchor E16-A3 (Menus, shield, action tracker). Builds `ActionTracker`, the one entity per app that reads the engine's action-event channel and turns every request's events into toasts that replace each other in place, including the "Outcome unknown" timeout and the summary toast for 4 or more targets, plus `message(&ActionError)`, the plain-text form of every action error. When this bead closes the E16-A3 group is complete: `components/menu.rs`, `components/shield.rs` and `action_tracker.rs` exist and are exported, and `tests/ui_actions.rs` passes. It closes the group beads E16-009 (TlMenu), E16-010 (TlShield). Sources: ADR-005 "UI handling" and action types, ADR-006 (deadline table, EPERM toast and Retry button from P3), ADR-015 (`ActionError`, `message`), R-114 (summary toast), R-129 (file name), UI-FND-020 (Progress kind, ToastKey), UI-PRC-015 (toast kinds and "Outcome unknown" as Warning).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/action_tracker.rs` (add `pub mod action_tracker;` to `lib.rs`):
```rust
pub struct ToastTexts {
    pub started: Option<(ToastKind, SharedString)>,     // e.g. (Info, "End task requested."); None = no toast until a result
    pub success: SharedString,                          // single target, e.g. "Process terminated"
    pub failure: SharedString,                          // single target prefix, e.g. "Could not end task."
    pub summary: Option<SummaryTexts>,                  // R-114 texts for many targets (owner supplies)
    pub summary_min_targets: u16,                       // 4 by default (R-114); process actions pass 2 (UI-PRC-015 "Ended 4 of 5 processes")
    pub retry_as_admin: bool,                           // P3: show "Retry as administrator" on PermissionDenied
    pub toast_key: Option<ToastKey>,                    // R-197: grouped requests (affinity on several targets, the SetSched then SetNice pair) share one toast that replaces in place; None = ToastKey(id.0)
}
pub struct SummaryTexts { pub started: SharedString,        // "Starting 6 services..."
                          pub all_ok: SharedString,         // "6 services started"
                          pub partial: Box<dyn Fn(u16, u16, u16) -> SharedString> } // (ok, total, failed) -> "4 of 6 services started. 2 failed."
pub struct PendingAction { pub request: ActionRequest, pub queue: WeakEntity<ToastQueue>, pub texts: ToastTexts,
                           pub started_at: Instant, pub deadline: Option<Duration>,
                           pub results: SmallVec<[(u16, ActionState); 4]> }
pub struct ActionTracker { pending: FxHashMap<ActionId, PendingAction>, next_id: AtomicU64 /* starts at 1 */ }
pub struct GlobalActionTracker(pub Entity<ActionTracker>); impl Global for GlobalActionTracker {}
impl ActionTracker {
    pub fn new(client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self; // spawns the event loop and a 1 s deadline sweep timer
    pub fn next_id(&self) -> ActionId;                                         // AtomicU64 from 1 (ADR-005)
    pub fn track(&mut self, request: ActionRequest, queue: WeakEntity<ToastQueue>, texts: ToastTexts, cx: &mut Context<Self>)
        -> Result<ActionId, CommandError>;                                     // R-197: sends Command::Action, records the pending entry, returns its id
}
pub enum ActionTrackerEvent { Started(ActionId), Finished { id: ActionId, ok: u16, total: u16, failed: u16 } } // R-197
impl EventEmitter<ActionTrackerEvent> for ActionTracker {}                    // cx.emit on Started and on the summary event; SysActions (E27) and the E23 dialogs subscribe by id
pub fn message(err: &ActionError) -> SharedString;
pub fn short_reason(err: &ActionError) -> SharedString; // R-196: first sentence of message() lower-cased without its full stop; PermissionDenied -> "permission denied"
pub fn deadline_for(kind: &ActionKind, targets: usize) -> Option<Duration>;
```
Event loop: `while let Ok(ev) = client.action_events().recv().await { this.update(cx, |t, cx| t.on_event(ev, cx)) }`. Per request (ADR-005 order: `Started` or one `Rejected`, then one final state per target, then a summary with `target: None`):
- `Started`: emit `ActionTrackerEvent::Started(id)`. If `texts.started` is set, push it with the request key (`texts.toast_key`, else `ToastKey(id.0)`); for `summary_min_targets` or more targets push `summary.started` as kind Progress with the same key. When `texts.started` is `None` no Progress toast is pushed at all, also for many targets (R-197; UI-SYS-045 and UI-SYS-046 want none for startup and connection actions).
- Per-target final states are stored. Below `summary_min_targets` with 2 or more targets each target result gets its own toast with key `ToastKey(id.0 << 8 | target_index)` (R-114: one toast per target); for 1 target the result replaces the request toast `ToastKey(id.0)` in place (UI-PRC-015).
- Summary event (`target: None`): emit `ActionTrackerEvent::Finished { id, ok, total, failed }` first. 1 target: `Succeeded` → Success `success`; `Failed(e)` → Error "`failure` `message(e)`"; `Rejected(r)` → Warning with the reject text (below); `OutcomeUnknown(_)` → Warning "Outcome unknown". `summary_min_targets` or more targets (with `summary` set): all succeeded → Success `summary.all_ok`; else Warning `summary.partial(ok, total, failed)` with the button "Details" that opens a `TlDialog` (E16-007) titled "tasklens", non-destructive, one line per failed target "<target label>: <message(err)>", one button "Close" (R-197). The entry is removed.
- `Failed(ActionError::PermissionDenied)` with `texts.retry_as_admin` and the shield not `Missing`: Error toast "Permission denied" with button "Retry as administrator", which re-sends the same request with `privileged = true` and only the failed targets (UI-PRC-015, ADR-006). Before P3 (`retry_as_admin = false`) no button.
- Destructive actions are never retried automatically (ADR-005).
- `Failed(ActionError::PermissionDenied)` while `HealthSnapshot.helper == HelperState::Missing`: call `StatusChip::note_restricted_refusal(count, cx)` (E20-016; `count: u32` = the number of targets of that request that failed with `PermissionDenied`) through the `ShellState` global when it exists; in tests without a shell this is a no-op (R-197).
Deadline sweep (every 1 s): an entry whose age exceeds `deadline + 5 s` becomes Warning "Outcome unknown" with its key and is removed (ADR-005). `deadline_for` from ADR-006 and R-196 (per request: the per-target deadline; requests run targets in one task, so use `per_target × targets` capped by nothing else):
| Kind | Deadline |
|---|---|
| `Signal`, `KillTree`, `Suspend`, `Resume`, `SetNice`, `SetSched`, `SetAffinity`, `SetIoPriority`, `FreezeGroup`, `ThawGroup`, `KillGroup` | 2 s per target |
| `UnitStart`, `UnitStop`, `UnitRestart`, `UnitReload`, `UnitResetFailed`, `UnitMask`, `UnitUnmask` | None (service jobs have no client-side timeout, SYS-005) |
| `UnitEnable`, `UnitDisable` | 10 s |
| `StartupEnable`, `StartupDisable`, `StartupDelete` | 2 s per target |
| `OpenUri`, `ShowInFileManager`, `Launch` | 2 s, or 120 s when `Launch` has `as_admin` |
| `StartupRunNow` | 2 s (shared launcher, R-134) |
| `SockDestroy`, `UnitWriteRecovery`, `UnitRemoveRecovery` | 120 s (may show a polkit prompt, R-196) |
| `Dump` | None (R-196: a core of several GiB is normal; the progress toast "Writing core… 1.2 GiB" is its liveness signal) |
| any other request with `privileged = true` (may show a polkit prompt) | 120 s |
`message(&ActionError)` (ADR-015, R-196; sentence case, plain):
- `PermissionDenied` → "Permission denied. This process belongs to another user." (ADR-015)
- `NoSuchProcess` → "The process has already exited."
- `Partial { done, total }` → "Done for {done} of {total} targets."
- `UnitJob { result, error_name }` → "The service job ended with result: {result}." (`error_name` feeds E27's D-Bus mapping, not this text)
- `Os(code)` → "The system call failed (error {code})."
- `Internal(text)` → "Internal error: {text}."
Reject texts (R-196; toast kind Warning unless noted):
| `RejectReason` | text |
|---|---|
| `Busy` | Another action on this process is still running. |
| `TooManyTargets` | Too many processes selected. The limit is 256. |
| `IdentityChanged` | The selected process changed; wait for the list to update and try again. |
| `KernelThread` | Kernel threads cannot be signalled. |
| `Protected` | This process is protected. Confirm the warning to end it. |
| `NotOwner` | This process belongs to another user. Administrator access is needed. |
| `Unsupported` | This action is not available for this process. |
| `AlreadyRunning` (startup entries) | Already running (kind Info, not Warning) |
`short_reason(&err)` feeds partial summaries such as "Ended 4 of 5 processes (1 permission denied)" (E22-017).
Install `GlobalActionTracker` in `TasklensUi::init` at the `// ActionTracker` marker (E16-A1, chain edit inside the batch).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a 1-target End Task tracked with started text "End task requested." **When** `Started` then `Succeeded` arrive **Then** one toast with key `ToastKey(id)` shows "End task requested." and is replaced in place by Success "Process terminated".
- **Given** a 1-target request **When** `Failed(PermissionDenied)` arrives before P3 **Then** an Error toast shows the failure text with "Permission denied. This process belongs to another user." and no button.
- **Given** `retry_as_admin = true` and a PermissionDenied failure on 2 of 3 targets **When** "Retry as administrator" is clicked **Then** a new request with `privileged = true` and only the 2 failed targets is sent.
- **Given** a 6-target request with summary texts **When** 4 succeed and 2 fail **Then** one Warning toast "4 of 6 … 2 failed." with a "Details" button replaces the Progress toast.
- **Given** a Signal request with 1 target **When** no final event arrives for 7 s (2 s + 5 s) **Then** the toast becomes Warning "Outcome unknown" and the entry is removed.
- **Given** a `UnitStart` request **When** 60 s pass without events **Then** no "Outcome unknown" is shown.
- **Given** two trackers' ids **When** `next_id` is called twice **Then** the ids are 1 and 2.
- **Given** a 3-target request whose `ToastTexts.started` is `None` and `summary_min_targets = 2` **When** `Started` arrives **Then** no toast is pushed (R-197).
- **Given** two requests tracked with the same `toast_key` **When** both finish **Then** one toast exists and it shows the last result.
- **Given** a subscriber to `ActionTrackerEvent` **When** a 3-target request ends with 1 failure **Then** it receives `Started(id)` then `Finished { id, ok: 2, total: 3, failed: 1 }`, where `id` is the value `track` returned.
- **Given** a partial summary toast **When** "Details" is clicked **Then** a dialog titled "tasklens" lists one line "<target label>: <message>" per failed target and has the single button "Close".
- **Given** `HealthSnapshot.helper == Missing` and a shell present **When** `Failed(PermissionDenied)` arrives **Then** `StatusChip::note_restricted_refusal` was called once.
- **Given** a `Dump` request **When** 10 minutes pass without a final event **Then** no "Outcome unknown" is shown.
- **Given** each `RejectReason` **When** `Rejected` arrives **Then** the toast text and kind match the reject table (`AlreadyRunning` is Info).
- **Given** each `ActionError` variant **When** `message` runs **Then** the text matches the table above.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/action_tracker.rs`: create, with unit tests for `message` and `deadline_for`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod action_tracker;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs`: install the global (one line at the marker).
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_actions.rs`: create.
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: append the texts above as `fnd-action-*` keys (`fnd-action-permission-denied`, `fnd-action-no-such-process`, `fnd-action-partial`, `fnd-action-unit-job`, `fnd-action-os`, `fnd-action-internal`, `fnd-action-outcome-unknown`, `fnd-action-retry-admin` = "Retry as administrator", `fnd-action-details` = "Details", and the reject texts).

## Tests
- `action_tracker::tests::message_texts`: one assertion per variant.
- `action_tracker::tests::deadline_table`: one assertion per row, including `Dump` -> `None`.
- `action_tracker::tests::short_reason_texts`: `PermissionDenied` -> "permission denied", `NoSuchProcess` -> "the process has already exited".
- `action_tracker::tests::reject_texts`: one assertion per `RejectReason`, kind included.
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::no_started_text_no_progress_toast`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::shared_toast_key_replaces_in_place`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::tracker_events_by_id`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::details_dialog_lists_failed_targets`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::eperm_without_helper_notes_restricted_refusal`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::action_toast_replaces_in_place_per_request` (FakeEngine `emit`)
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::outcome_unknown_after_deadline_plus_5s` (`advance_clock`)
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::service_jobs_have_no_timeout`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::summary_toast_for_four_or_more_targets` (R-114)
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::retry_button_only_when_enabled_and_eperm`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::retry_sends_only_failed_targets_privileged`
- `tests/ui_actions.rs::busy_send_shows_warning`: `FakeEngine::set_busy(true)`, `track` returns `Err(Busy)` and the owner-facing helper pushes "Too many actions are running. Try again shortly."

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `track` returns `CommandError::Busy` or `EngineStopped` without recording; a closed event channel ends the loop and every pending entry becomes "Outcome unknown".
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: toasts state results in text; the Details dialog lists each target in text.
- Performance: one map entry per in-flight action (max 16 admitted, ADR-006); the sweep runs once per second only while entries exist.
- Privacy: action logs record kind, target PID and result only (ADR-015); toast texts never include command lines.

## Notes
- The `message` texts, the reject texts, `short_reason` and the deadlines are settled (R-196); the tracker contract (`ActionId` return, `toast_key`, `ActionTrackerEvent`, Details dialog, no-Progress rule, `note_restricted_refusal`) is settled (R-197).
- `StatusChip::note_restricted_refusal` is E20-016 (`window/status.rs`), a later bead than this anchor. Call it through `cx.try_global::<ShellState>()`: when the global does not exist (tests, or before E20 lands) do nothing. E20-016 names this bead as its caller.
- Per-feature texts (End Task, services, startup and so on) are the owners'; they pass `ToastTexts` when they call `track`.
- Large-file rule: commit the file before building or testing; fix-ups go in a follow-up commit, never an amend.
- Build rule: run cargo only through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>` (run `git add` on new files first). Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first. Sources: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` ADR-005, ADR-006, ADR-015; `docs/RECONCILIATION.md` R-114; `docs/ui/processes.md` UI-PRC-015.
close_reason: action_tracker.rs (ActionTracker, message, short_reason, reject_text, deadline_for), TlDialog::without_cancel, install in TasklensUi::init, tests/ui_actions.rs (13 pass), fnd-action ftl keys. Commits 0ac9390 c17434d b54c6c9 039aec5 5ec776e

title: E16-001 tl-ui Cargo features, testing module and FakeEngine
description:
## Context
Sets up the tl-ui crate manifest (features and dev-dependencies) and the test support module with `FakeEngine`, the `EngineClient` implementation every UI test uses instead of the real engine. Sources: ADR-013 "UI tests" (FakeEngine publishes scripted snapshots and records commands), ADR-005 (`EngineClient` trait, wake and action channels), ADR-002 (tl-ui dev-dependency and `bench` feature), ADR-001 (tl-ui allowed row), D-001 (no asupersync types in tl-ui).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml` (owner E16; E02-A1 created the skeleton, E17-001 may have added normal dependencies):
  - normal dependencies, add each that is missing: `tl-model = { path = "../tl-model" }`, `gpui-kit = { workspace = true }`, `serde = { workspace = true }`, `serde_json = { workspace = true }`, `smallvec = { workspace = true }`, `rustc-hash = { workspace = true }`, `tracing = { workspace = true }`, `async-channel = { workspace = true }`, `jiff = { workspace = true }` (R-142 items 2 and 9).
  - `[dev-dependencies]`: `gpui-kit = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }`, `tempfile = { workspace = true }`.
  - `[features]`: `bench = ["gpui-kit/profiler"]` (ADR-002), `render-tests = []` (headless screenshot tests, ADR-013), `test-hooks = []` (render counters, ADR-013). `default = []`.
  - `[lints] workspace = true` stays.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/testing/mod.rs`: `pub mod fake_engine;` compiled when `cfg(any(test, feature = "test-hooks"))`. Add `#[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-hooks"))] pub mod testing;` to `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/testing/fake_engine.rs`:
  ```rust
  pub struct FakeEngine { inner: Arc<Mutex<FakeState>>, wake_tx: async_channel::Sender<()>, wake_rx: async_channel::Receiver<()>,
                          ev_tx: async_channel::Sender<ActionEvent>, ev_rx: async_channel::Receiver<ActionEvent> }
  struct FakeState { latest: Arc<Snapshot>, demands: Vec<Demand>, settings: Vec<EngineSettings>,
                     commands: Vec<Command>, journals: Vec<JournalQuery>, busy: bool }
  impl FakeEngine {
      pub fn new() -> Arc<Self>;                        // latest = empty snapshot, sequence 0
      pub fn publish(&self, snap: Snapshot);            // store, then wake_tx.try_send(()) ignoring Full (ADR-005 publish order)
      pub fn publish_with(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Snapshot)); // clone latest, bump sequence by 1, apply f, publish
      pub fn emit(&self, ev: ActionEvent);              // ev_tx.try_send
      pub fn demands(&self) -> Vec<Demand>;             // every set_demand call, in order
      pub fn settings(&self) -> Vec<EngineSettings>;
      pub fn commands(&self) -> Vec<Command>;
      pub fn set_busy(&self, busy: bool);               // send() returns Err(CommandError::Busy) while true
  }
  impl EngineClient for FakeEngine { /* latest, wake (wake_rx.clone()), action_events (ev_rx.clone()),
      set_demand (push), set_settings (push), send (push or Busy), journal (push query, return a handle whose channel stays empty) */ }
  pub fn empty_snapshot() -> Snapshot;                 // every component Default with header.validity WarmingUp
  ```

title: E16-002 Fluent string layer and English catalogue
description:
## Context
Builds the Fluent string layer: every user-visible string in tl-ui goes through a message key from P1, the English catalogue ships embedded, and a language change re-applies text live without a restart. Spec phase P1; built in the phase-0 slice because anchor E16-A1 (P0) needs it. Sources: APP-043, R-132, UI-SHL-131, R-081 (numbers do not follow the locale), canonical table (a) `general.language`.

## Deliverable
- Root `Cargo.toml` (owner E02, chain edit): replace the caret pins `fluent-bundle = "0.15"` and `unic-langid = "0.9"` in `[workspace.dependencies]` with exact pins resolved by `cargo add` (ADR-002 says "exact pins set by the bead that adds them"); write them as `fluent-bundle = "=0.15.x"` and `unic-langid = "=0.9.y"` with the resolved versions. This is the only change to the root file.
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml`: add `fluent-bundle = { workspace = true }`, `unic-langid = { workspace = true }`.
- `assets/locales/en-US.ftl`: the English catalogue, embedded with `include_str!`. Keys are `<area>-<entry>-<slug>` in kebab case (R-132), for example `processes-menu-end-task`. This bead adds the keys of the foundation strings that E15 and E16 render: `fnd-validity-warming-up = Collecting first sample`, `fnd-validity-stale = Last updated { $age } ago`, `fnd-validity-restricted = Needs administrator access.`, `fnd-validity-restricted-p3 = Needs administrator access. Click the shield to grant it.`, `fnd-validity-unsupported = Not available on this device`, `fnd-validity-missing = No longer present`, `fnd-validity-failed = Could not read: { $error }`, `fnd-menu-no-items = No items`, `fnd-pin-off = Always on top`, `fnd-pin-on = Always on top (on)`, `fnd-pin-unsupported = Not supported by this desktop`, `fnd-toast-outcome-unknown = Outcome unknown`, `fnd-empty-clear-filter = Clear filter`, `fnd-kv-copy-section = Copy section`, `fnd-kv-copy-row = Copy row`, `fnd-kv-copy-value = Copy value`, `fnd-shield-start-failed = Could not start the privileged helper`, `fnd-shield-auth-cancelled = Authentication cancelled`, `fnd-props-open-failed = Could not open properties.`. Other epics append their own keys by chain edit (00-epics section 2).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/i18n.rs`:
  ```rust
  pub const LOCALES: [&str; 12] = ["system", "en-US", "de-DE", "es-ES", "fr-FR", "ja-JP", "ko-KR", "pt-BR", "ru-RU", "uk-UA", "zh-CN", "nb-NO"]; // table (a)
  pub struct Strings { bundle: FluentBundle<FluentResource>, fallback: FluentBundle<FluentResource>, pub locale: LanguageIdentifier, pub strings_version: u64 }
  impl Global for Strings {}
  pub fn init_strings(cx: &mut App, setting: &str);            // setting = general.language
  pub fn set_language(cx: &mut App, setting: &str);            // replace the bundle, strings_version += 1, cx.refresh_windows()
  pub fn tr(cx: &App, key: &str) -> SharedString;
  pub fn tr_args(cx: &App, key: &str, args: &[(&str, FluentValue<'_>)]) -> SharedString;
  pub fn system_locale() -> LanguageIdentifier;                // LC_ALL, then LC_MESSAGES, then LANG, read once at startup; "C"/"POSIX"/empty -> en-US
  ```
  Resolution: `"system"` uses `system_locale()`. A locale without an embedded catalogue (every locale except en-US in P1) uses en-US. A key missing in the chosen bundle falls back to the en-US bundle (APP-043). A key missing in en-US too returns the key text and logs `warn!(target: "tasklens::ui", key, "missing string")` once per key, plus a `debug_assert!` in debug builds.
  `FluentBundle::set_use_isolating(false)` so no bidi isolation marks enter the text (the UI is LTR, UI-FND-053 rule 8).
  `tr` returns `SharedString`; callers that render the same key every frame cache the result keyed by `strings_version`.
- Add `pub mod i18n;` to `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Given** `tr_args(cx, "fnd-validity-stale", [("age", "5s")])` **When** it runs **Then** it returns "Last updated 5s ago" with no U+2068 or U+2069 characters.
- **Given** a key that exists in no catalogue **When** `tr` runs **Then** it returns the key itself.

- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod i18n;`.

title: E16-003 SnapshotHub, ComponentMask install and hidden state
description:
## Context
Builds `SnapshotHub`, the one entity per app that receives engine snapshots, works out which components changed, and tells subscribed views through an event. It also owns the main window hidden-state detection that drives demand off while the window is parked by the compositor. Sources: ADR-005 "UI receiver" and "Retention", ADR-003 (`Snapshot`, `ComponentHeader`, `SeriesSet`, `ComponentMask`), ADR-010 "Hidden state", ADR-008 "Hidden detection", ADR-009 (nothing notifies in render), ADR-013 (render counters, 10,000-publish test), INDEX.md component bits.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/hub.rs` (add `pub mod hub;` to `lib.rs`):
```rust
pub use tl_model::snapshot::ComponentMask;   // bits SYSTEM, SERIES, PROCESSES, TABLE, CONNECTIONS, SERVICES, STARTUP,
                                             // INVENTORY, DEVICES, HEALTH, WINDOWS, DETAILS, HISTORY (ADR-003, one bit per Snapshot field in declaration order)
pub struct SnapshotChanged { pub mask: ComponentMask, pub changed_series: SmallVec<[SeriesId; 64]> }
pub struct HiddenChanged { pub hidden: bool }
pub struct SnapshotHub {
    client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>,
    current: Arc<Snapshot>,
    pending_notify_since: Option<Instant>,   // set when a SnapshotChanged is emitted and no render has been noted since
    last_render: Option<Instant>,
    hidden: bool,
    refresh_while_hidden: bool,              // U-3 fallback switch, default false (see below)
}
impl EventEmitter<SnapshotChanged> for SnapshotHub {}
impl EventEmitter<HiddenChanged> for SnapshotHub {}
impl SnapshotHub {
    pub fn new(client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self;   // spawns the receive task and the 500 ms timer
    pub fn current(&self) -> &Arc<Snapshot>;
    pub fn install(&mut self, snap: Arc<Snapshot>, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    pub fn note_render(&mut self, cx: &mut Context<Self>);   // called by MainWindow::render (E20 chain edit); clears pending, sets last_render, hidden=false
    pub fn is_hidden(&self) -> bool;
    pub fn client(&self) -> &Arc<dyn EngineClient>;
}
pub struct GlobalHub(pub Entity<SnapshotHub>); impl Global for GlobalHub {}
```
Receive task, exactly as ADR-005 writes it: `while wake.recv().await.is_ok() { let snap = client.latest(); if this.update(cx, |hub, cx| hub.install(snap, cx)).is_err() { break; } }` (load after receive).
`install` rules:
1. If `snap.sequence <= current.sequence`: ignore (no event).
2. Mask: set the bit of each component whose `header.version` differs from the currently installed snapshot (`system`, `processes`, `table`, `connections`, `services`, `startup`, `inventory`, `health`, `windows`, `details`, `history` by `header.version`; `devices` by `DeviceCatalog.version`; `series` by `SeriesSet.header.version`).
3. `changed_series`: walk both sorted `series` arrays by `SeriesId` and list every id whose `SeriesView.version` changed or which is new (merge walk, no allocation beyond the SmallVec).
4. Replace `current`, then `cx.emit(SnapshotChanged { mask, changed_series })` only if the mask is not empty. Set `pending_notify_since = Some(now)` if it is `None`.
5. The hub never calls `notify` on views (views subscribe and decide).
Hidden state (ADR-010): a 500 ms foreground timer (`cx.spawn` loop with `cx.background_executor().timer(500 ms)`) sets `hidden = true` and emits `HiddenChanged { hidden: true }` when `pending_notify_since` is older than 1000 ms; `note_render` sets it back to false and emits `HiddenChanged { hidden: false }`. While hidden the hub keeps installing snapshots. If `refresh_while_hidden` is true the timer also calls `window.refresh()` on the main window every 1 s while hidden; the flag is `pub const REFRESH_WHILE_HIDDEN: bool = false;` until phase 0 settles U-3 (E01 records the result; flip the constant in a separate bead if U-3 fails).
Retention: the hub holds exactly one `Arc<Snapshot>`; no other code stores one beyond a render (Ctrl-pause holds the second, ADR-005).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an installed snapshot with sequence 5 **When** a snapshot with sequence 5 or 4 arrives **Then** nothing is installed and no event is emitted.
- **Given** only the CPU series version changed **When** the snapshot installs **Then** the mask is `SERIES` only and `changed_series` lists exactly the changed CPU ids.
- **Given** `processes.header.version` changed **When** it installs **Then** the mask contains `PROCESSES` and not `TABLE`.
- **Given** a fake publisher thread publishing 10,000 snapshots **When** the hub loop runs to completion **Then** the installed sequence equals the last one and the observed sequence never decreases.
- **Given** a subscribed test view that notifies only on `PROCESSES` **When** a CPU-only snapshot installs **Then** its render counter does not change.
- **Given** an emitted change and no `note_render` call for 1000 ms **When** the 500 ms timer fires **Then** `is_hidden()` is true and `HiddenChanged { hidden: true }` is emitted once.
- **Given** the hub is hidden **When** `note_render` is called **Then** `is_hidden()` is false and `HiddenChanged { hidden: false }` is emitted.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/hub.rs`: create, with unit tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod hub;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_hub.rs`: create (integration tests with `FakeEngine` and `TestAppContext`).

## Tests
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::ignores_old_sequence`: equal and lower sequences are dropped.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::mask_per_component`: one test per header bump, asserting the single bit.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::changed_series_lists_only_changed`: two of five series bumped, one added.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::ten_thousand_publishes_monotonic`: publisher thread on `std::thread`, hub loop under `TestAppContext::run_until_parked`, last sequence reached, never backwards (ADR-005 verification).
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::cpu_only_change_does_not_notify_process_view`: render counter (feature `test-hooks`) unchanged (ADR-005 verification).
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::hidden_after_1000ms_pending_without_render`: `advance_clock` 1500 ms with a pending change gives hidden; `note_render` clears it.
- `tests/ui_hub.rs::no_hidden_without_pending_change`: no change emitted, 5 s pass, still visible.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: if the hub entity is dropped, `update` fails and the loop ends; if the wake channel closes (engine stopped) the loop ends and the hub keeps the last snapshot.
- Validity: N/A (the hub passes headers through).
- Accessibility: N/A
- Performance: one load and one mask computation per wake; mask work is O(components + series); no allocation except the `SmallVec` spill above 64 changed series. Nothing per frame.
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- Render counter pattern for tests: a `Cell<u32>` in the test view behind `cfg(test)` or `feature = "test-hooks"` (ADR-013).
- `MainWindow` (E20) calls `note_render` from its render through `cx.defer` or a stored entity update; that call is E20's chain edit, not this bead's.
- Build rule: run cargo only through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>` (run `git add` on new files first). Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first. Sources: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` ADR-003, ADR-005, ADR-008, ADR-010, ADR-013.

title: E16-004 DemandAggregator
description:
## Context
Builds `DemandAggregator`, the one entity per app that merges what every visible surface needs into one `Demand` and sends it to the engine at most every 100 ms, only when it changed. Hidden windows turn demand off. Sources: ADR-008 (`Demand` type, schedule, hidden detection), ADR-005 ("The UI sends demand at most every 100 ms and only when it differs from the last value sent"), ADR-009 (visible demand from tables), ADR-013 (demand tests), ADR-010 hidden state.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/demand.rs` (add `pub mod demand;` to `lib.rs`):
```rust
pub struct DemandAggregator {
    client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>,
    parts: FxHashMap<EntityId, (Option<AnyWindowHandle>, Demand)>,  // one contribution per surface; window None = not in a window (tray)
    main_window: Option<AnyWindowHandle>,
    last_sent: Option<Demand>,
    flush_scheduled: bool,
    hidden: bool,                        // mirrors SnapshotHub::is_hidden through HiddenChanged
}
impl DemandAggregator {
    pub fn new(client: Arc<dyn EngineClient>, hub: &Entity<SnapshotHub>, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self; // subscribes to HiddenChanged
    pub fn set(&mut self, source: EntityId, window: Option<AnyWindowHandle>, part: Demand, cx: &mut Context<Self>); // replace this surface's part, schedule flush
    pub fn set_main_window(&mut self, window: AnyWindowHandle);                      // called once by MainWindow::new (E20)
    pub fn remove(&mut self, source: EntityId, cx: &mut Context<Self>);              // on surface drop or hide
    pub fn merged(&self) -> Demand;
}
pub struct GlobalDemand(pub Entity<DemandAggregator>); impl Global for GlobalDemand {}
pub const DEMAND_COALESCE: Duration = Duration::from_millis(100);
```
Merge rules (field-wise over all parts):
- `bool` fields (`memory`, `disks`, `nets`, `gpus`, `sensors`, `process_table`, `gpu_process`, `connections`, `services`, `startup`, `inventory`, `service_cgroup_stats`, `connections_all_netns`, `recording`, `cpu_fast`): OR.
- `cpu: CpuDemand`: maximum with `Off < Total < PerCore`.
- `process_columns: ColumnSet`: union.
- `tray: TrayDemand`: field-wise OR/union as for the rest.
- Arc lists, deduplicated, in first-seen order, then capped: `detail_keys` 512, `details` 16, `affinity_targets` 256, `unit_details` 10 (ADR-008 caps). `remote_host_cookies` has no cap in ADR-008 and is not capped.
- `any_surface_visible`: true if any part sets it. Main-window surfaces set it; when `hidden` is true, every part whose source is in the main window is ignored, so the merged value keeps only detached graph and tray parts (ADR-008 "Hidden detection"). Parts whose window equals `main_window` are dropped from the merge while hidden.
- With no visible part and recording off, the merged demand is `Demand { recording: <merged>, ..Default::default() }` (every periodic source off).
Flush: `set` and `remove` schedule one flush with `cx.spawn` and a 100 ms timer if none is pending; the flush computes `merged()` and calls `client.set_demand(m)` only if `Some(&m) != last_sent.as_ref()`, then stores it. Hidden changes flush the same way.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** five `set` calls within 100 ms that change the demand **When** 100 ms pass **Then** `set_demand` is called once with the final merge.
- **Given** a flushed demand **When** `set` is called with the same part again **Then** no `set_demand` call follows.
- **Given** a Processes part (process_table, detail_keys A) and a Performance part (cpu PerCore) **When** merged **Then** the result has `process_table`, `cpu = PerCore` and `detail_keys = A`.
- **Given** two parts with 400 detail keys each, 100 shared **When** merged **Then** `detail_keys` has 512 unique keys.
- **Given** the hub reports hidden and only main-window parts exist **When** the flush runs **Then** `any_surface_visible` is false and every periodic field is off.
- **Given** hidden and a detached-graph part with `cpu = Total` **When** the flush runs **Then** `any_surface_visible` is true and `cpu = Total`.
- **Given** a tab switch removes the Processes part and adds the Performance part **When** the flush runs **Then** the sent demand has `process_table = false` and `cpu` set.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/demand.rs`: create, with unit tests for the merge.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod demand;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_demand.rs`: create (TestAppContext with FakeEngine and clock advance).

## Tests
- `demand::tests::merge_rules`: bools OR, cpu max, column union, list dedup.
- `demand::tests::caps_applied`: each list cap (512, 16, 256, 10); `remote_host_cookies` not capped.
- `tests/ui_demand.rs::coalesces_within_100ms`: five sets give one `FakeEngine::demands()` entry.
- `tests/ui_demand.rs::not_resent_when_equal`: identical merge sends nothing (ADR-013).
- `tests/ui_demand.rs::tab_switch_changes_demand`: remove plus set produces the new demand (ADR-013).
- `tests/ui_demand.rs::hidden_turns_demand_off`: HiddenChanged true gives `any_surface_visible = false`.
- `tests/ui_demand.rs::detached_part_survives_hidden`: a part from another window keeps the source on.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `set_demand` never fails (watch semantics, ADR-005).
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: N/A
- Performance: merge is O(total list length) ≤ a few thousand items, at most 10 times per second. No per-frame work; surfaces call `set` only when their part changed (the table compares a 64-bit hash of its key set, UI-PRC-010).
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- Surfaces own their part shape: the process table fills `process_table`, `process_columns`, `detail_keys`; Properties windows fill `details`; and so on (their epics).
- Build rule: run cargo only through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>` (run `git add` on new files first). Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first. Sources: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` ADR-005, ADR-008, ADR-010, ADR-013.

title: E16-005 Headless render helpers and golden compare
description:
## Context
Builds the headless screenshot helpers and the golden-image compare that every `tests/render_*.rs` file uses (gallery, theme, table, chart). ADR-013 says this GPUI path exists in source but gpui-kit does not exercise it, so this bead first proves it works on Mesa lavapipe and, if it does not, provides a `painted_quads()` fallback. U-4 itself is recorded by E15-A3 when the gallery tests run in CI. Sources: ADR-013 "Headless screenshot tests" (pass rule, scales, `TL_UPDATE_GOLDEN`), U-4, UI-FND-030.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml`: `render-tests = ["gpui-kit/test-support"]`. PNG read and write use the `RgbaImage` type that `capture_screenshot` returns (gpui-pre `src/app/headless_app_context.rs:168`; it is `image::RgbaImage`, so `save` and `image::open` through GPUI's re-export). If the `image` crate has to be named directly, stop and report: it is not in the tl-ui row of ADR-001 (would need an optional dependency behind `render-tests` and a check-deps row change).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/testing/render.rs` (add `#[cfg(feature = "render-tests")] pub mod render;` to `testing/mod.rs`):
  ```rust
  pub struct RenderHarness { cx: HeadlessAppContext }
  impl RenderHarness {
      pub fn new() -> Self;   // HeadlessAppContext::with_platform(Arc::new(CosmicTextSystem::new(..)), Arc::new(TlAssets), || gpui_platform::current_headless_renderer())
                              // then load the bundled fonts (E15-001), gpui_kit::init, theme init with Default Dark (E17-A1)
      pub fn set_theme(&mut self, name: &str);                  // ThemeStore::activate, no crossfade
      pub fn set_scale(&mut self, scale: f32);                  // 1.0 or 1.1 (ADR-013)
      pub fn render<V: Render>(&mut self, size: Size<Pixels>, build: impl FnOnce(&mut Window, &mut App) -> Entity<V>) -> RgbaImage;
                              // open_window, run_until_parked, capture_screenshot(window)
      pub fn painted_quads<V: Render>(&mut self, size: Size<Pixels>, build: ...) -> Vec<PaintedQuad>; // fallback path, see Notes
  }
  pub fn assert_golden(name: &str, img: &RgbaImage);
  pub const GOLDEN_DIR: &str = concat!(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), "/tests/golden");
  pub const MAX_DIFF_FRACTION: f64 = 0.001;   // at most 0.1% of pixels may differ
  pub const CHANNEL_TOLERANCE: u8 = 2;        // by more than 2/255 in any channel
  ```

title: E16-006 ToastQueue and toast rendering
description:
## Context
Builds `ToastQueue`, the per-window toast stack every surface pushes to, over the kit notification list. It owns the stack limit, wait list, durations, hover pause, replace-in-place keys, coalescing and the hidden-window rule. Owners only choose kinds, texts and keys (R-113). Spec phase P1; priority 0 because E18-A2 (P0) shows a toast. Sources: UI-FND-020, UI-SHL-100, APP-044, R-109, R-113, ADR-015 (no toast for collection errors), ADR-010 hidden state, UI-SHL-130 (globals re-set on scale change).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/components/toast.rs` (add `pub mod toast;` to `components/mod.rs`):
```rust
pub enum ToastKind { Info, Success, Warning, Error, Progress }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)] pub struct ToastKey(pub u64);
pub const FIXED_KEY_BASE: u64 = 0x8000_0000_0000_0000; // R-232: keys at or above this are fixed keys owned by pages; tracker keys (id << 8 | index, ActionId < 2^55) never reach it
pub const SERVICES_LOADING_TOAST: ToastKey = ToastKey(0x8000_0000_0000_0101); // R-232 (E27)
pub const STARTUP_LOADING_TOAST: ToastKey = ToastKey(0x8000_0000_0000_0201);  // R-232 (E28 Startup Apps)
pub const CONNECTIONS_LOADING_TOAST: ToastKey = ToastKey(0x8000_0000_0000_0301); // R-232 (E28 Connections)
pub struct ToastAction { pub label: SharedString, pub action: Box<dyn Action> }
pub struct ToastQueue { visible: SmallVec<[ToastEntry; 4]>, waiting: VecDeque<ToastEntry>, top: Pixels, window: AnyWindowHandle, ... }
impl ToastQueue {
    pub fn new(window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>, top: Pixels) -> Self;
    pub fn push(&mut self, kind: ToastKind, text: impl Into<SharedString>, key: Option<ToastKey>, action: Option<ToastAction>, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    pub fn remove(&mut self, key: ToastKey, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    pub fn set_top(&mut self, top: Pixels, cx: &mut App);       // re-applied on every UI scale change (UI-SHL-130)
}
pub const MAX_VISIBLE: usize = 4;
pub const MAX_WAITING: usize = 16;
pub const WIDTH: f32 = 382.0;
```
Look (UI-FND-020): width 382, min height 40, padding `sp4` (8), background `menu_bg`, 1 px `divider` border, radius `r_md` (6), toast-level shadow offset (0, 4) blur 16 with `derived.shadow`. Leading icon `i_md` 16 per kind: Info `info` in `status.info`; Success `circle-check` in `status.success`; Warning `triangle-alert` in `status.warning`; Error `circle-x` in `status.danger`; Progress `TlSpinner` `i_md` in `text_secondary`. Text `t_base` `text_primary`, wraps, at most 3 lines, then cut with "…" and the full text in the toast's tooltip, prefixed by the kind ("Error: …") for accessibility. Close button `TlButton::Icon` sm with `x` `i_sm`, always present. Optional action button `TlButton::Secondary` sm under the text, left-aligned.
Placement: horizontally centred, top = the `top` passed in (main window: `(TITLEBAR_H 34 + TAB_STRIP_H 30) × ui_scale + sp4` = 72 at 100%, 108 at 150%; server decorations 28 + 30 + 8 = 66; secondary windows 34 + 8 = 42), stacked downward with `sp3` (6) gap, newest at the bottom. Kit settings written by `new` and `set_top` into `Theme::notification`: `placement = Anchor::TopCenter`, `margins.top = top`, `max_items = 20` (`MAX_VISIBLE + MAX_WAITING`; the queue enforces the cap of 4 itself, so the kit never hides a Progress toast), `width = px(382)`.
P1 rule (R-195): `Theme::notification` is app-global, so every window uses the main-window top: 72 × `ui_scale` (66 with server decorations). `ToastQueue::new` keeps its `top` parameter, and every caller in P1 passes the shell's value; secondary windows get their own 42 only in P2, when the queue takes a per-window top.
Queue rules (UI-FND-020, numbered as there):
1. At most 4 visible, not counting Progress toasts (R-197): a Progress toast always shows at once and does not take one of the 4 slots. A fifth non-Progress toast goes to a FIFO wait list and shows when a slot frees. The wait list holds 16; a 17th drops the oldest waiting Info or Success toast (never Warning or Error).
2. Durations from the moment a toast becomes visible: Info, Success, Warning 5 s; Error 8 s; Progress never auto-dismisses: it stays until its key is replaced or removed (R-197; the action tracker's deadline sweep turns a stuck request into "Outcome unknown", and `Dump` has no deadline); any toast with an action button 15 s. The kit autohide (5 s) is used for the 5 s kinds; others use `autohide(false)` and a queue timer (`cx.background_executor().timer`) that calls `window.remove_notification1::<ToastKeyTag>(key)`.
3. Hover or keyboard focus on any toast pauses every visible toast's timer; it resumes when the pointer leaves the stack.
4. Replace in place: pushing with an existing key swaps text, kind and button, restarts the timer and keeps the position. Kit id: `Notification::id1::<ToastKeyTag>(key.0)`.
5. Coalescing: a push with the same kind and text as a visible toast within 1 s adds nothing; the visible one restarts its timer and shows a count suffix " (×2)" from the second repeat on ("Copied to clipboard (×5)" after five pushes). The count uses `tnum`.
6. An Error pushed while 4 are visible evicts the oldest visible Info or Success toast instead of waiting. Warnings wait.
7. Esc never closes toasts. A click on the body does nothing; X closes; the action button dispatches its action then closes.
8. Pushes while the main window is hidden (`SnapshotHub::is_hidden()`): Error toasts go to a desktop notification through `NotificationDelivery::System`; all other kinds are dropped. Nothing is replayed on restore.
9. Each secondary window has its own `ToastQueue` (its own kit Root).
Motion: enter and exit are the kit's fixed 400 ms and 200 ms (R-109); with `motion.animations = false` or `cx.reduce_motion()` there is no enter or exit animation.
Focus: the stack is last in the window's Tab order; inside it Tab moves between each toast's action button and X; Enter on X closes, Enter on the action runs it.
Owners never push from `render`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** 4 visible toasts **When** a fifth Info is pushed **Then** it waits, and appears when one of the four closes.
- **Given** 4 visible Info toasts **When** an Error is pushed **Then** the oldest Info is removed and the Error shows at once.
- **Given** a visible toast with key 7 **When** another toast with key 7 is pushed **Then** the content changes in place and the timer restarts.
- **Given** "Copied to clipboard" pushed 5 times within 1 s each **When** the stack renders **Then** one toast shows "Copied to clipboard (×5)".
- **Given** an Info toast and an Error toast **When** 5 s pass **Then** the Info is gone and the Error stays until 8 s.
- **Given** a toast with an action button **When** 14 s pass **Then** it is still shown, and at 15 s it is gone.
- **Given** a Progress toast **When** 10 minutes pass without replacement **Then** it is still shown (R-197).
- **Given** 4 visible Info toasts **When** a Progress toast is pushed **Then** it shows at once and the 4 Info toasts stay.
- **Given** the constants **When** compared **Then** `SERVICES_LOADING_TOAST.0`, `STARTUP_LOADING_TOAST.0` and `CONNECTIONS_LOADING_TOAST.0` are at least `FIXED_KEY_BASE`, and `((1u64 << 55) - 1) << 8 | 255` is below it (R-232).
- **Given** the pointer over a toast **When** 10 s pass **Then** no visible toast closes.
- **Given** 16 waiting toasts **When** a 17th Info arrives **Then** the oldest waiting Info or Success is dropped and no Warning, Error or Progress is dropped.
- **Given** the main window hidden **When** an Error and an Info are pushed **Then** the Error is delivered as a system notification and the Info is dropped.
- **Given** `ui_scale_pct = 150` and `set_top` called with the main-window formula **When** a toast shows **Then** the stack top is 108.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/toast.rs`: create, with unit tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/mod.rs`: add `pub mod toast;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_toasts.rs`: create.

## Tests
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::fifth_waits_then_shows`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::error_evicts_oldest_info`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::same_key_replaces_in_place`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::coalesce_count_suffix` ("(×5)")
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::error_lives_8s_info_5s` (TestAppContext `advance_clock`)
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::action_toast_lives_15s`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::progress_never_auto_dismisses`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::progress_does_not_take_a_slot`
- `components::toast::tests::fixed_keys_above_tracker_range`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::hover_pauses_all`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::wait_list_drops_oldest_info_only`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::hidden_window_drops_or_routes_to_system`
- `tests/ui_toasts.rs::toast_top_follows_scale` (150% gives 108, UI-SHL-100)
Each asserts the visible set, order and texts through a test accessor `ToastQueue::visible_texts()` (feature `test-hooks`).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: a system-notification delivery failure is logged at `warn!` and dropped.
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: kind is spelled out in the tooltip ("Error: …"); stack reachable by Tab; nothing is colour-only.
- Performance: the kit runs a 50 ms tick only while a toast animates or counts down; queue timers are one future per non-5 s toast; no toast is pushed from render.
- Privacy: toast texts come from owners; the queue logs only kinds and keys, never texts with process data.

## Notes
- `Theme::notification` is app-global, so the last `set_top` call wins for every window. Settled for P1 (R-195): secondary windows do not call `set_top` and pass the main-window value (72 × `ui_scale`) to `ToastQueue::new`. Tests cover the main window only.
- Kit pointers: `NotificationSettings` gpui-kit `crates/component/src/notification.rs:537`; `push_notification` `crates/component/src/window_ext.rs:163`; `remove_notification1` `crates/component/src/root.rs:396`.
- The `UiInit.startup_toasts` queue is shown by the shell after the first frame (UI-SHL-110 step 11), not by this bead.
- Large-file rule: commit the file before building or testing; fix-ups go in a follow-up commit, never an amend.
- Build rule: run cargo only through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>` (run `git add` on new files first). Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first. Sources: `docs/ui/foundation.md` UI-FND-020, `docs/ui/shell.md` UI-SHL-100, `docs/RECONCILIATION.md` R-109, R-113.
