title: E20-006 Status chip, StatusChanged and StatusAction (status.rs)
description:
## Context
Builds the floating status chip at the bottom-left of the page area (R-107: the TaskSlinger chip, not a full-width status bar) and the `StatusChanged` event pages emit when their status text changes. The chip shows the active page's text, "[PAUSED - Ctrl]" while Ctrl-pause is on (E20-012 sets it), and, from E20-016, health items. It is hidden when it has nothing to show, so Performance and Information normally show no chip. Phase P0 (the P0 main window lays it out). Sources: UI-SHL-050, R-107, APP-029, PROC-051, R-042, table (d) thin-space grouping.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/window/status.rs` (create; add `pub mod status;` to `crates/tl-ui/src/window/mod.rs`, chain edit):

```rust
pub const CHIP_H: f32 = 26.0;            // × ui_scale; tables add this as bottom padding (UI-SHL-050)
pub const CHIP_RESERVE: f32 = 200.0;     // the chip's max width is the page width minus this, × ui_scale

/// Emitted by a page entity when its `status_text` output changed (counts or selection size).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct StatusChanged;

/// A clickable part a page adds after its text (for example E22's " | 42 restricted" link and its
/// "Administrator mode" badge, P3). Returned by `ShellPage::status_actions` (E20-008).
pub enum StatusActionKind { Link, Badge }
pub struct StatusAction { pub kind: StatusActionKind, pub label: SharedString, pub tooltip: SharedString, pub action: Box<dyn Action> }
impl Clone for StatusAction { /* clones `action` with `boxed_clone()` */ }
impl PartialEq for StatusAction { /* kind, label, tooltip and action name and value (`partial_eq`) */ }

pub struct StatusChip {
    page_text: SharedString,             // the active page's text, segments joined by " | "
    page_actions: SmallVec<[StatusAction; 2]>,
    paused: bool,
    buf: String,                          // reused buffer
}
impl StatusChip {
    pub fn new(cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self;
    /// Called by MainWindow with the page's `status_text` output. Notifies only when the text changed.
    pub fn set_page_text(&mut self, text: &str, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    /// Called by MainWindow with the page's `status_actions`. Notifies only when they changed.
    pub fn set_page_actions(&mut self, actions: SmallVec<[StatusAction; 2]>, cx: &mut Context<Self>);
    pub fn set_paused(&mut self, paused: bool, cx: &mut Context<Self>);   // notify only on change
    pub fn is_visible(&self) -> bool;                                       // false when every segment is empty
}
impl Render for StatusChip { .. }
```

Look (sizes × `ui_scale`, hairlines 1 physical px):
- Height 26; padding left 8, right 12; background `tab_bg`; 1 px `divider` border on the top and right sides only; top-right corner radius `r_md`, the other corners square (flush with the window edges).
- Text `t_sm`, `text_primary`, tabular figures. The page text is drawn as its segments split on " | ", with each " | " separator in `text_secondary`.
- Page actions, right after the page text, in order: a `Link` is drawn as the separator " | " (`text_secondary`) and then its label in `text_primary`, underlined on hover, with its tooltip; a `Badge` is drawn as a `TlBadge` Info with its label, one space after the text before it. Each is a Tab stop (the chip's clickable parts come last in the main window's Tab order, UI-SHL-121) and dispatches its `action` on click, Enter or Space. The cursor stays the default arrow (widgets rule 7).
- While paused: one space, then "[PAUSED - Ctrl]" in `accent` after the page text and page actions.
- Width fits the content; the parent caps it at page width minus 200 (E20-008 sets `max_w`); overflow is cut at the end with "…".
- Hidden (renders an empty element of zero size) when the page text is empty, there are no page actions and it is not paused. E20-016 adds health items as a third segment and extends `is_visible`.
- Mouse-down on the chip stops propagation. Apart from page actions (and health items, E20-016) nothing is clickable. Right-click does nothing.

Strings (`assets/locales/en-US.ftl`, chain edit): `shell-status-paused = [PAUSED - Ctrl]`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** page text "41 / 296 Processes | 3 processes selected" **When** the chip renders **Then** it shows that text with the " | " in `text_secondary` and the rest in `text_primary`.
- **Given** an empty page text and not paused **When** rendered **Then** `is_visible()` is false and the chip takes no space.
- **Given** an empty page text and paused **When** rendered **Then** the chip is visible and shows "[PAUSED - Ctrl]" in `accent`.
- **Given** page text "296 Processes" and paused **When** rendered **Then** the text is "296 Processes [PAUSED - Ctrl]".
- **Given** `set_page_text` with the same text as before **When** called **Then** the chip is not notified (render count unchanged).
- **Given** a parent max width of 300 px and a 500 px text **When** rendered **Then** the text ends with "…" and the chip is 300 px wide.
- **Given** `ui_scale_pct = 150` **When** rendered **Then** the chip is 39 tall.
- **Given** page text "296 Processes" and one `Link` action "42 restricted" dispatching a test Action **When** the link is clicked **Then** the chip reads "296 Processes | 42 restricted" and the test Action is dispatched once; Tab from the page reaches the link.
- **Given** a `Badge` action "Administrator mode" **When** rendered **Then** a `TlBadge` with that label follows the text and a click dispatches its Action.

## Cross-cutting

title: E20-007 Focus rules: initial focus and Esc chain decision table (focus.rs)
description:
## Context
Writes `focus.rs`, the main window's focus rules as small, testable functions: where focus goes when the window opens and after every tab switch, and the decision table of the Esc chain. The Esc chain handler that uses the decision table is wired in E20-011 (P1); this bead writes only pure logic and the initial-focus helper. Phase P0 (the P0 main window uses the initial-focus rule). Sources: UI-SHL-121, UI-SHL-122, canonical table (b) Esc row, R-043, R-108, APP-058, widgets rule 16.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/focus.rs` (create; add `pub mod focus;` to `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`):

```rust
/// Initial focus rule (UI-SHL-121): focus the page's primary target when it has one,
/// else the main window's root focus handle (key context "Global").
pub fn focus_initial(primary: Option<&FocusHandle>, root: &FocusHandle, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut App);

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct EscState {
    pub picking: bool,               // window picking active (E20-027)
    pub filter_focused: bool,        // the shell filter input has focus
    pub filter_has_text: bool,       // the active tab's filter text is not empty
    pub close_with_esc: bool,        // settings.window.close_with_esc
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum EscOutcome {
    CancelPick,          // dispatch CancelWindowPick
    FilterRule,          // the filter's own rule (UI-SHL-024): handled by FilterEscape, stop here
    ClearFilterAndFocusTable,
    CloseWindow,         // dispatch CloseWindow (close decision of UI-SHL-113)
    Nothing,
}

/// The Esc chain after the kit has handled open menus, popovers and in-window dialogs
/// (steps 1 and 2 never reach this function). First match wins:
/// 3 picking -> CancelPick; 4 filter_focused -> FilterRule; 5 filter_has_text -> ClearFilterAndFocusTable;
/// 6 close_with_esc -> CloseWindow; 7 -> Nothing.
pub fn esc_outcome(s: EscState) -> EscOutcome;
```

Rules written as doc comments in the file:
- Title bar, toolbar, tabs and caption buttons are never Tab stops (R-108). The Tab order in the main window is the element tree order of tab stops: filter input, "Include children" checkbox (when shown), the active page's targets in the page's order, clickable status chip segments. GPUI wraps from the last to the first. No `tab_index` values are set by the shell.
- Menus, popovers and in-window dialogs return focus to the element that had it (kit behaviour, widgets rule 16). Secondary windows are separate windows; GPUI keeps each window's last focused element.
- The focus ring is drawn on keyboard focus only (`TlFocusRing`, E15).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a primary focus handle **When** `focus_initial` runs **Then** that handle is focused.
- **Given** no primary handle **When** `focus_initial` runs **Then** the root handle is focused.
- **Given** `EscState { picking: true, filter_focused: true, filter_has_text: true, close_with_esc: true }` **When** `esc_outcome` runs **Then** it is `CancelPick`.
- **Given** not picking and the filter focused **When** `esc_outcome` runs **Then** it is `FilterRule`, whatever the other fields.
- **Given** not picking, the filter not focused and filter text present **When** `esc_outcome` runs **Then** it is `ClearFilterAndFocusTable`.
- **Given** none of the above and `close_with_esc = true` **When** `esc_outcome` runs **Then** it is `CloseWindow`.
- **Given** every field false **When** `esc_outcome` runs **Then** it is `Nothing`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/focus.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: `pub mod focus;` (chain edit).
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_focus.rs`: create (E20 owns it).

## Tests
`crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_focus.rs`:
- `focus_initial_prefers_primary`: criteria 1 and 2 (`#[gpui_kit::test]`, two focus handles in a test window).
- `esc_outcome_order`: a table test over all 16 combinations of the four flags, checking the first-match rule above (criteria 3 to 7).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: this file is the keyboard focus contract of the main window (UI-SHL-121, UI-SHL-122).
- Performance: pure functions, no allocation.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- `EscapeChain` (Global, `escape`) and `CancelWindowPick` (Picker) are E20-002. E20-011 builds `EscState` from the window state and acts on the outcome; E20-009 implements the filter's own rule (`FilterEscape`).
- `window.focus(&handle)` is the gpui-pre 0.3.7 call; check the exact signature in `src/window.rs`.
- Build rule: run every cargo build, test, check, clippy or doc through `heavy-build`, for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_focus`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/focus.rs crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_focus.rs`. Never a bare `git commit`.
- Read `CLAUDE.md` and `AGENTS.md` in the repo first.

title: E17-A1 Theme model
description:
## Context
Anchor E17-A1 "Theme model". Writes `ThemeStore`, the GPUI Global that holds the built-in and user theme definitions, the active `TlTheme` and the optional preview, plus the instant theme switch (`activate` without crossfade) and the one-time install at start. When this bead closes, the whole theme model of E17-A1 is in place: `theme/{mod,palette,derived,builtin,metrics,map,store}.rs` and `assets/themes/builtin.json` with Default Dark and Default Light, U-8 recorded. Spec phase P1 (UI-FND-040 "P1: activate, instant switch"); priority 0 because the phase-0 spike needs it. This anchor closes E17-001, E17-002, E17-003 and E17-004. Sources: UI-FND-040, UI-SHL-080, ADR-009 "Theme switch", APP-035, APP-036, R-017, R-068, R-069, R-138.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`:

```rust
pub struct ThemeStore {
    pub builtin: Arc<[ThemeDef]>,       // from builtin::load(); 2 in P1, 12 in P2, in TaskSlinger order
    pub user: Vec<ThemeDef>,            // from themes.json (E17-008); empty until then
    pub active: Arc<TlTheme>,
    pub preview: Option<Arc<TlTheme>>,  // set only by E17-A2; when Some, it is what renders
    pub system_scheme: u8,              // portal color-scheme 0, 1 or 2 (E17-007); 0 until then
    version_counter: u64,               // TlTheme.version source
}
impl gpui::Global for ThemeStore {}

pub enum ActivateSource { User, FollowSystem }
pub enum ThemeEvent { Activated { name: Arc<str> }, Deleted { name: Arc<str> }, Copied { name: Arc<str> }, ImportFailed }
pub enum ThemeError { UnknownTheme(Arc<str>), PreviewActive }

#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema, Action)]
#[action(namespace = tasklens)]
pub struct ActivateTheme { pub name: SharedString }
```

Functions:
- `pub fn init(cx: &mut App, theme: &ThemeSettings, appearance: &AppearanceSettings, user: Vec<ThemeDef>)`: loads built-ins, builds the store, resolves `theme.active` (unknown name falls back to `theme.dark` and then to "Default Dark", with a `warn!`), installs `ThemeStore` and `UiMetrics` (`metrics::init_metrics`), and runs `map::apply` once inside `Theme::update`. No crossfade at start (UI-SHL-110 step 8). Called by `TasklensUi::init` (E16-A1).
- `pub fn current(cx: &App) -> &Arc<TlTheme>`: returns `preview` when `Some`, else `active`. Views never read `active` directly (UI-FND-043 rule 2).
- `impl ThemeStore { pub fn resolve(&self, name: &str) -> Option<(&ThemeDef, bool /*builtin*/)> }`: user themes first, then built-ins (a user theme may shadow a built-in name; the menu shows both and marks the user one "(custom)", UI-FND-040 step 1).
- `pub fn activate(name: &str, source: ActivateSource, cx: &mut App) -> Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError>`:
  1. `preview.is_some()` gives `Err(PreviewActive)` (the shell shows "Finish or cancel the theme editor first").
  2. Resolve `name`, else `Err(UnknownTheme)`.
  3. Build `TlTheme::from_def` with the fallback built-in of the same mode (Default Dark or Default Light) and `rebuild_derived(appearance)`; increment `version`.
  4. Replace `active`; call `metrics::bump_style_version(cx)` exactly once; run `map::apply` once with the final theme; call `cx.refresh_windows()`.
  5. Return `Ok(ThemeEvent::Activated { name })`. The caller writes `theme.active` when `source == User` (and turns off sync, UI-SHL-080); with `FollowSystem` it writes nothing. This function does no settings write and pushes no toast.
  `CellTextCache` is not cleared by a theme switch (text colour is not part of its key).
- `pub fn apply_metrics(appearance: &AppearanceSettings, cx: &mut App)`: `metrics::recompute`; if it returns `true`, run `map::apply` with the current theme and refresh windows. Called by the shell on scale or row-height changes (UI-SHL-130 steps 1 to 3) and on `rounded_corners` or `shadow_intensity_pct` changes (the latter also re-runs `rebuild_derived` on `active`).
- `pub fn names(cx: &App) -> Vec<(Arc<str>, bool /*builtin*/)>` in menu order: built-ins in `TS_THEME_ORDER`, then user themes in file order.

Crossfade (E17-006), follow-system (E17-007), user file (E17-008) and preview (E17-A2) extend this file or sit beside it; leave `system_scheme` and `preview` unused here.

`crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_theme.rs` (integration, `#[gpui_kit::test]`):
- installs the store with `init`, asserts the globals and that `current()` is Default Dark.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** settings `theme.active = "Default Dark"` **When** `init` runs **Then** `ThemeStore`, `UiMetrics` and the kit `Theme` are installed, `current().name == "Default Dark"` and the kit `background` equals `#191B1D`.
- **Given** `theme.active = "No Such Theme"` **When** `init` runs **Then** the active theme is `theme.dark` ("Default Dark" by default) and a warning is logged.
- **Given** a user theme named "Default Dark" with `WINDOW_BG #000000` in `user` **When** `activate("Default Dark", User)` runs **Then** the user theme is active (`builtin == false`, `window_bg == #000000`).
- **Given** Default Dark active and `style_version = n` **When** `activate("Default Light", User)` runs **Then** the active theme is Default Light, `style_version == n + 1`, the kit `tab_active` equals `#F3F4F6`, and the result is `Activated { name: "Default Light" }`.
- **Given** any theme **When** `activate("Missing", User)` runs **Then** it returns `Err(UnknownTheme)` and nothing changes.
- **Given** `preview` is `Some` **When** `activate` runs **Then** it returns `Err(PreviewActive)` and `active` is unchanged.
- **Given** `preview` is `Some(p)` **When** `current()` is read **Then** it returns `p`.
- **Given** metrics at scale 100 **When** `apply_metrics` runs with `ui_scale_pct = 150` **Then** kit `font_size == 19.5` and `style_version` rose by 1; with unchanged appearance nothing changes.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod store;` and `pub use store::{ThemeStore, ActivateTheme, ActivateSource, ThemeEvent, ThemeError, current};`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_theme.rs`: create.

## Tests

- `theme::store::tests::animations_off_is_instant_and_single_rebuild`: one activate bumps `style_version` by exactly 1 and the new theme is active at once.
- `theme::store::tests::unknown_name_and_preview_refused`.
- `theme::store::tests::apply_metrics_updates_kit_theme`.
- `ui_theme::theme_init_installs_globals`: init with a FakeEngine-free `TestAppContext`; globals present; kit colours mapped; unknown active name falls back.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `UnknownTheme` and `PreviewActive` are returned to the caller; the shell turns them into toasts (UI-SHL-038, UI-FND-043 text "Finish or cancel the theme editor first").
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.

title: E17-008 User themes file: load, repair, copy, delete, save
description:
## Context
Adds the user themes file `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tasklens/themes.json` (P2): lenient loading with per-theme repair, Create copy, Delete with fallback, and saving through the tl-app persist callback. tl-ui does no file I/O itself: tl-app reads the file text and passes it in `UiInit.themes_json`, and writes through `UiInit.persist_themes` (ADR-011). Sources: UI-FND-042, ADR-011 (path, atomic write, corrupt rename pattern), APP-036, R-018, R-079.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/user_store.rs`:
- `pub enum PersistTheme { Save(Vec<ThemeDef>), RenameCorrupt { unix_seconds: u64 } }` (the request type carried by `UiInit.persist_themes`; tl-app performs `write_atomic` or the rename).
- `pub struct LoadOutcome { pub themes: Vec<ThemeDef>, pub corrupt: Option<u64 /*unix seconds*/>, pub repairs: Vec<Repair> }` and `pub enum Repair { MissingSlot { theme: Arc<str>, key: &'static str }, BadColor { theme: Arc<str>, key: String }, Unnamed { index: usize, given: Arc<str> }, Renamed { from: Arc<str>, to: Arc<str> }, Truncated { total: usize } }`.
- `pub fn load_user_themes(text: Option<&str>, builtins: &[ThemeDef], now_unix: u64) -> LoadOutcome`:
  1. `None` (missing file): empty, nothing written until the first copy or import.
  2. Text that is not JSON, or not an object with a `themes` array: `corrupt = Some(now_unix)`, empty list.
  3. Per theme, lenient: a missing slot or bad colour string takes the value from the built-in of the same mode (Default Dark or Default Light; mode from `mode` key or `WINDOW_BG` lightness) and records a `Repair` (logged with `warn!` naming theme and slot); a theme without a name gets "Custom theme N" (N = 1-based index among unnamed); duplicate names get " (2)", " (3)" appended in file order; more than 64 themes keeps the first 64 and records `Truncated { total }`.
  4. Unknown keys go into `ThemeDef.extra` and are written back on save (round trip through `BTreeMap`).
- `pub fn serialize_user_themes(themes: &[ThemeDef]) -> String`: `{"themes":[...]}` pretty-printed with 2-space indent; slot keys upper-case, `name`, `mode` (when set), `accent`, `status` and `graph` (when set) lower-case, then `extra` keys.
- `impl ThemeStore`:
  - `pub fn install_user(&mut self, outcome: LoadOutcome)`; called by `TasklensUi::init` before `activate`.
  - `pub fn copy_theme(name: &str, cx) -> Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError>`: new name "<name> copy", or "<name> copy 2", "<name> copy 3" and so on (first free); appended to `user`; saved (`PersistTheme::Save`); activated with `ActivateSource::User`; returns `Copied { name }`.
  - `pub fn delete_theme(name: &str, cx) -> Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError>`: built-ins return `Err(ThemeError::BuiltinCannotBeDeleted)` (new variant; shell toast "Built-in themes cannot be deleted"); removes the user theme; saves; if it was active, activates `theme.dark` or `theme.light` chosen by the deleted theme's mode; returns `Deleted { name }`. The confirmation "Delete this custom theme?" is the shell's (UI-SHL-084).
  - Saving happens after Create copy, Delete, Import (E17-009) and editor Done (E17-A2). Never on activate.
- Persist callback access: a Global `ThemePersist(Box<dyn Fn(PersistTheme)>)` installed by `TasklensUi::init` from `UiInit.persist_themes`; tests install a recording closure.
- At init, when `corrupt` is `Some(t)`: send `PersistTheme::RenameCorrupt { unix_seconds: t }` and queue the Warning toast "Themes file was unreadable and has been reset. The old file was kept as themes.json.corrupt-<unix seconds>" (the toast is pushed by the shell after the first frame with the other queued start-up toasts, UI-SHL-110 step 11; this bead returns the text through `LoadOutcome` helper `pub fn corrupt_toast_text(t: u64) -> SharedString`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** no themes file **When** `load_user_themes(None, ..)` runs **Then** the list is empty, `corrupt` is `None`, and no persist request is sent.
- **Given** text `{"themes":` (truncated) **When** loaded at unix time 1759500000 **Then** the list is empty, `corrupt == Some(1759500000)`, and `corrupt_toast_text` reads "Themes file was unreadable and has been reset. The old file was kept as themes.json.corrupt-1759500000".
- **Given** a light theme missing `HEADER` **When** loaded **Then** its `HEADER` equals Default Light `#DDE1E5` and a `MissingSlot` repair is recorded.
- **Given** a dark theme with an unknown key `"FOO":"x"` and `"accent":"blue"` **When** loaded **Then** `accent` falls back to the same-mode built-in accent, a `BadColor` repair is recorded, and `FOO` is kept in `extra`.
- **Given** two themes both named "Mine" **When** loaded **Then** they are "Mine" and "Mine (2)".
- **Given** 70 themes **When** loaded **Then** 64 are kept and `Truncated { total: 70 }` is recorded.
- **Given** a loaded file with unknown keys **When** serialized again **Then** the unknown keys and values are present unchanged.
- **Given** user themes "Ocean copy" exists **When** `copy_theme("Ocean")` runs **Then** the new theme is "Ocean copy 2", it is active, and one `Save` request with the full list is sent.
- **Given** the active user theme "Ocean copy" with mode light **When** `delete_theme` runs **Then** it is removed, `theme.light` becomes active, and one `Save` is sent.
- **Given** "Default Dark" **When** `delete_theme` runs **Then** it returns `BuiltinCannotBeDeleted` and nothing is saved.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/user_store.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod user_store;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: add `ThemeError::BuiltinCannotBeDeleted` and the `install_user` call path.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_theme.rs`: copy and delete through the store with a recording persist closure.

## Tests
- `theme::user_store::tests::missing_file_empty`.
- `theme::user_store::tests::corrupt_renamed_and_toast`: `corrupt` set, toast text exact, `RenameCorrupt` sent at install.
- `theme::user_store::tests::missing_slot_falls_back`.
- `theme::user_store::tests::unknown_keys_round_trip`.
- `theme::user_store::tests::copy_names_increment`.
- `theme::user_store::tests::duplicate_and_unnamed_names`.
- `theme::user_store::tests::cap_at_64`.
- `ui_theme::delete_active_falls_back_by_mode`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: corrupt file renamed and reset with the Warning toast above; per-theme problems repaired and logged, never a toast.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Privacy: theme names are user data; log them only at `warn!` with the repair, never colours or file paths of other users.
- Performance: load once at start and after writes; under 1 ms for 64 themes.

## Notes
- The persist callback type and `UiInit.themes_json` are the proposed contract of open items 4 and 5 in docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md; B1 (E33) must match. If the leader changes the contract, follow the settled form.
- `tempfile` is not needed: tl-ui never touches the file; tests pass text in and record requests.
- Reuse `builtin::parse_hex` and `builtin::parse_theme_object` (E17-002) for the strict per-key parse, wrapping it with the repair logic here.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_theme theme::user_store`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/user_store.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_theme.rs`.
close_reason: user_store.rs: load with repair, serialize, copy_theme, delete_theme, ThemePersist Global, corrupt rename and toast; store::init_with_file; TasklensUi::init loads themes_json and drops BootSettings.persist_themes. Commits df4b103, cee793e

title: E17-009 TL1 share codes and theme import
description:
## Context
Adds the tasklens theme share code `TL1.` (encode and decode) and the clipboard import path (P3): "Share theme" shows a `TL1.` code, and "Import theme" accepts a `TL1.` code, raw `themes.json` text (`{"themes":[…]}`) or a single theme object, and adds the themes to the user file. The share and import windows and toasts are E21's; this bead is the codec and the store call. Sources: APP-038, UI-FND-042 (import), UI-FND-043 rule 8 (Share encodes the preview), R-079.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/share_code.rs`:
- `pub const TL1_PREFIX: &str = "TL1.";`
- `pub fn encode_tl1(def: &ThemeDef) -> String`: `"TL1."` + base64url without padding of the UTF-8 JSON object `{"v":1,"name":…,"accent":"#RRGGBB","WINDOW_BG":"#RRGGBB", … all 22 slots}` (APP-038). Keys in this order: `v`, `name`, `accent`, then the 22 slots in `ThemeSlot` order. Colours as upper-case `#RRGGBB`. `mode`, `status`, `graph` and `extra` are not included.
- `pub fn decode_tl1(code: &str) -> Result<ThemeDef, ShareCodeError>`: trims whitespace; requires the prefix; base64url decode (padding optional); JSON object; `v == 1`; then the lenient per-theme parse of E17-008 (missing slots fall back by mode).
- `pub enum ShareCodeError { NotAThemeCode, BadBase64, BadJson, UnsupportedVersion(u64) }`.
- `pub fn import_text(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<ThemeDef>, ShareCodeError>`: trimmed text starting with `TL1.` decodes one theme; text starting with `TS1.` goes to `decode_ts1` (E17-010; until then returns `Err(NotAThemeCode)`); text that parses as a JSON object with a `themes` array imports every entry; a JSON object with `WINDOW_BG` imports one theme; anything else `Err(NotAThemeCode)`.
- base64url: write a small encoder and decoder in this file (RFC 4648 section 5 alphabet). No new crate (the tl-ui row has no base64 crate).

`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/user_store.rs`:
- `impl ThemeStore { pub fn import_themes(defs: Vec<ThemeDef>, cx: &mut App) -> Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError> }`: appends to `user` with the duplicate-name rule (" (2)", " (3)") and the 64-theme cap (extra themes are dropped and counted); saves once (`PersistTheme::Save`); does not activate. Returns a new `ThemeEvent::Imported { count }` (add the variant). Empty input returns `Ok(ThemeEvent::ImportFailed)`.

The shell (E21) shows "Theme imported" or "Clipboard does not contain a theme code" (APP-038) and "Theme code copied" for Share.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** Default Dark's def **When** `encode_tl1` then `decode_tl1` runs **Then** the 22 slots, `accent` and `name` round-trip exactly.
- **Given** a code **When** encoded **Then** it starts with "TL1." and contains only `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` after the prefix.
- **Given** the decoded JSON of a code **When** inspected **Then** it is `{"v":1,"name":…,"accent":…,` followed by the 22 slot keys.
- **Given** `"TL1.!!!"` **When** decoded **Then** `BadBase64`; a valid base64 of `{"v":2,...}` gives `UnsupportedVersion(2)`.
- **Given** raw text `{"themes":[{...},{...}]}` **When** `import_text` runs **Then** two defs are returned.
- **Given** a single theme object text **When** `import_text` runs **Then** one def is returned.
- **Given** "hello" **When** `import_text` runs **Then** `NotAThemeCode`.
- **Given** an existing user theme "Mine" **When** `import_themes` adds another "Mine" **Then** it is stored as "Mine (2)", one `Save` is sent, and the active theme is unchanged.
- **Given** a live preview **When** Share runs **Then** it encodes `preview_def` (E17-A2), not the saved def.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/share_code.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/user_store.rs`: `import_themes`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: add `ThemeEvent::Imported { count: usize }`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod share_code;`.

## Tests
- `theme::share_code::tests::tl1_round_trip`.
- `theme::share_code::tests::tl1_alphabet_and_key_order`.
- `theme::share_code::tests::bad_codes_rejected`.
- `theme::share_code::tests::import_raw_json_list_and_single`.
- `theme::share_code::tests::base64url_rfc4648_vectors` (the RFC 4648 section 10 test vectors in the URL alphabet).
- `theme::user_store::tests::import_renames_duplicates_and_saves_once`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: the four `ShareCodeError` variants all map to the shell toast "Clipboard does not contain a theme code".
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: one-shot on user action.
- Privacy: clipboard text is user input; never log it, log only the error kind.
- Security: clipboard text is untrusted input. Cap the accepted text at 1 MiB before decoding and the theme count at 64; never panic on any input (a proptest over arbitrary strings asserts no panic).

## Notes
- Add the proptest as `theme::share_code::tests::import_never_panics` using `proptest` as a dev-dependency of tl-ui (dev-dependencies are unrestricted, ADR-001).
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::share_code theme::user_store`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.

description:

title: E17-011 Import themes from a TaskSlinger themes.json
description:
## Context
Adds the themes half of "Import from TaskSlinger…" (P4): parsing a TaskSlinger `themes.json` chosen by the user and adding its custom themes to tasklens's user themes. The Settings window entry (Advanced page), the portal file chooser and the toast "Imported N settings and M themes" belong to E21 and the settings half to E33; this bead turns the file text into `ThemeDef`s and adds them. Sources: APP-034, APP-035 (TaskSlinger format is tasklens's base format), UI-FND-042.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/import_ts.rs`:
- `pub struct TsImport { pub themes: Vec<ThemeDef>, pub skipped_builtin_names: usize }`.
- `pub fn parse_taskslinger_themes(text: &str, builtins: &[ThemeDef]) -> Result<TsImport, ShareCodeError>`: parses `{"themes":[…]}` with the lenient per-theme parse of E17-008 (missing slots fall back by mode, unknown keys kept in `extra`). A theme whose name equals one of the 12 names in `TS_THEME_ORDER` and whose 22 slots equal the shipped built-in exactly is skipped and counted (TaskSlinger exports may carry built-ins); others are kept, including user copies with built-in names (they get " (2)" through the import rule).
- `impl ThemeStore { pub fn import_taskslinger(text: &str, cx: &mut App) -> Result<usize /*themes added*/, ShareCodeError> }`: parses, then calls `import_themes` (E17-009) and returns the count for the toast.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a TaskSlinger file with 3 custom themes and the unchanged "Dracula" built-in **When** imported **Then** 3 themes are added, `skipped_builtin_names == 1`, and one `Save` is sent.
- **Given** a TaskSlinger theme without `accent` **When** imported **Then** `accent` falls back to the same-mode built-in accent.
- **Given** text that is not JSON **When** imported **Then** it returns `BadJson` and nothing is saved.
- **Given** a file of 2 MiB **When** imported **Then** it is refused before parsing (1 MiB cap) with `BadJson`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/import_ts.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod import_ts;`.

## Tests
- `theme::import_ts::tests::imports_custom_skips_unchanged_builtins`.
- `theme::import_ts::tests::missing_accent_falls_back`.
- `theme::import_ts::tests::bad_json_and_size_cap`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: returned to the caller, which shows the E21 toast.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: one-shot.
- Privacy: theme names only; never log file contents.
- Security: file content is untrusted; 1 MiB cap and 64-theme cap (E17-008 rule).

## Notes
- File reading happens in the caller (tl-ui does no file I/O, ADR-011): E21 reads the chosen file through GPUI's path prompt and passes the text, or tl-app reads it; the exact caller is E21's decision in its bead.
- The comparison against built-ins needs the 12 built-ins (E17-005) to be shipped; with only two built-ins the skip rule applies to those two.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::import_ts`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/import_ts.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`.

title: E17-012 Theme render goldens
description:
## Context
Adds headless render goldens for the two P1 themes (ADR-013 case "Default Dark theme", rendered at scale 1.0 and 1.1), so a wrong slot value or a broken kit mapping shows up as a pixel diff in CI. The test renders a fixed swatch view built only from `theme::current()` and the kit `Theme`. Sources: ADR-013 headless screenshot tests, UI-FND-001, UI-FND-002, UI-FND-030 (golden workflow).

title: E17-A2 User themes and follow-system
description:
## Context
Anchor E17-A2 "User themes and follow-system". Writes the theme editor live-preview contract in `theme/preview.rs`: how the Theme Editor window (E21) shows unsaved colours across the whole app and how Done and Cancel end the preview. When this bead closes, E17-A2 is complete: `theme/user_store.rs` (E17-008), follow-system switching (E17-007), the crossfade (E17-006) and `theme/preview.rs`. Spec phase of the preview is P3 (UI-FND-043, with the editor APP-037); it is built in P2 with priority 2 because E21's editor depends on this anchor (open item 1 in docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md). This anchor closes E17-006, E17-007 and E17-008. Sources: UI-FND-043, APP-037, R-083, UI-FND-040 rule 2.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/preview.rs`:

```rust
pub struct PreviewToken { id: u64 }        // not Clone; one live preview at a time
impl ThemeStore {
    pub fn begin_preview(base: &ThemeDef, cx: &mut App) -> PreviewToken;
    pub fn set_preview_slot(tok: &PreviewToken, slot: ThemeSlot, c: Hsla, cx: &mut App);
    pub fn set_preview_name(tok: &PreviewToken, name: Arc<str>, cx: &mut App);
    pub fn preview_def(tok: &PreviewToken, cx: &App) -> ThemeDef;          // current edited def (Share encodes this)
    pub fn commit_preview(tok: PreviewToken, cx: &mut App) -> Result<ThemeDef, ThemeError>;  // Done
    pub fn cancel_preview(tok: PreviewToken, cx: &mut App);                // Cancel, or editor window closed by X
    pub fn random_preview(tok: &PreviewToken, seed: u64, cx: &mut App);    // "Random"
    pub fn preview_name(cx: &App) -> Option<Arc<str>>;                     // for the Theme submenu "(editing)" marker
}
```

Rules (UI-FND-043):
1. One preview at a time. `begin_preview` while one is live cancels the first (the shell closes the first editor window) and invalidates its token: later calls with the old token are ignored with a `debug!`.
2. While `preview` is `Some`, `theme::current()` returns it (E17-A1). Views never read `active` directly.
3. `set_preview_slot` and `set_preview_name` record the latest value per slot and apply at most once per frame: the first call in a frame schedules one `window.on_next_frame` through the main window's `AnimationDriver` request (same reserved-id mechanism as E17-006); the callback clones `preview`, changes the recorded fields, runs `rebuild_derived`, replaces `preview` with the new `Arc<TlTheme>`, calls `bump_style_version` once, and refreshes windows. No crossfade during preview.
4. A change of `ThemeSlot::Accent` also runs `map::apply` with the preview theme, so kit `primary` and `ring` and the derived focus ring preview too. Other slot changes do not run `map::apply` per frame; `commit` and `cancel` run it once.
5. The graph palette and status colours are not editable and keep the base theme's values.
6. `random_preview(seed)`: randomizes the 22 slots and `accent` with a deterministic PRNG from `seed` (any small xorshift in this file; no new crate); re-rolls `text_primary` lightness until `text_primary` on `list_bg` is at least 4.5:1. The shell shows the toast "Random theme generated." (APP-037).
7. `commit_preview`: the base must be a user theme (built-ins are refused upstream with "Built-in themes cannot be edited. Copy it first.", R-209; here a built-in base returns `Err(ThemeError::BuiltinCannotBeEdited)`). Writes the def into `user`, replacing the theme with the same original name (a rename via `set_preview_name` replaces it under the new name), saves through `PersistTheme::Save` (E17-008), activates it without crossfade (`ActivateSource::User`), clears `preview`, returns the saved def.
8. `cancel_preview`: clears `preview`, bumps `style_version`, refreshes windows; `active` was never changed, so the app returns to it in one frame.
9. `activate` while previewing is refused with `ThemeError::PreviewActive` (E17-A1); the shell shows "Finish or cancel the theme editor first".
10. `preview_name()` returns the previewed theme name so the Theme submenu can show "<name> (editing)" with the check on it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** Default Dark active and a user theme "Ocean" **When** `begin_preview(Ocean)` runs **Then** `current().name == "Ocean"` and `active` is still Default Dark.
- **Given** a live preview **When** `set_preview_slot(WindowBg, #000000)` is called 50 times within one frame **Then** after the frame `current().window_bg == #000000` and `style_version` rose by exactly 1.
- **Given** a live preview **When** `set_preview_slot(Accent, c)` is applied **Then** kit `primary == c` and `derived.focus_ring == c`.
- **Given** a live preview with edits **When** `cancel_preview` runs **Then** `current()` is the original active theme, `preview` is `None`, and no save request was sent.
- **Given** a live preview of user theme "Ocean" with edits **When** `commit_preview` runs **Then** `user` holds the edited "Ocean", one `Save` request is sent, "Ocean" is active, and `preview` is `None`.
- **Given** a preview based on a built-in **When** `commit_preview` runs **Then** it returns `BuiltinCannotBeEdited` and nothing is saved.
- **Given** a live preview with token A **When** `begin_preview` runs again (token B) **Then** calls with token A change nothing.
- **Given** any seed **When** `random_preview` runs **Then** `text_primary` on `list_bg` has contrast at least 4.5:1 and graph and status colours are unchanged.
- **Given** a live preview **When** `preview_def` is read **Then** it holds the unsaved edits (used by Share, E17-009).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/preview.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod preview;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: add `ThemeError::BuiltinCannotBeEdited`.

## Tests
- `theme::preview::tests::views_read_preview_when_live`.
- `theme::preview::tests::cancel_restores_active`.
- `theme::preview::tests::commit_saves_and_activates`.
- `theme::preview::tests::second_begin_cancels_first`.
- `theme::preview::tests::random_keeps_contrast` (100 seeds).
- `theme::preview::tests::slot_updates_coalesce_per_frame`.
- `theme::preview::tests::accent_edit_updates_kit_tokens`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `BuiltinCannotBeEdited` and `PreviewActive` returned to the shell, which shows "Built-in themes cannot be edited. Copy it first." (R-209) and "Finish or cancel the theme editor first".
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: Random keeps the 4.5:1 text floor.
- Performance: one `TlTheme` clone (about 1 KB) per applied frame while dragging in the editor; each applied frame bumps `style_version`, the same cost as one theme-switch frame (UI-FND-043).
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- The editor window itself (slot list, hue strip, colour plane, readouts, buttons) is E21's `window/theme_editor.rs`; it calls only these methods.
- Uses the driver hook from E17-006 for the per-frame coalescing.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::preview`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/preview.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`.
close_reason: theme/preview.rs added (bfb6cca, fixes 1728f01, ebd1eb1). store.rs: ThemeError::BuiltinCannotBeEdited and PreviewEnded (stale token on Done), pub(super) on build, apply_kit, finish_crossfade, appearance, anim, anim_window. Evidence per AC, all in theme::preview::tests: begin(Ocean) renders Ocean, active stays Default Dark (views_read_preview_when_live); 51 WindowBg calls in one frame give #000000 and style_version +1, one driver callback (slot_updates_coalesce_per_frame); Accent edit sets kit primary, ring and derived.focus_ring (accent_edit_updates_kit_tokens); cancel restores active, preview None, no Save (cancel_restores_active); commit replaces Ocean in user, one Save, Ocean active without crossfade, preview None (commit_saves_and_activates, commit_rename_replaces_under_new_name); built-in base gives BuiltinCannotBeEdited, no Save (commit_builtin_refused); token A ignored after begin B (second_begin_cancels_first); 100 seeds keep text_primary on list_bg >= 4.5:1 with graph and status unchanged (random_keeps_contrast); preview_def holds unapplied edits (views_read_preview_when_live). Children E17-006 (lgw.8, 4e1036b), E17-007 (lgw.9, 9d1b56c), E17-008 (lgw.10, df4b103) already closed with their tests in store.rs and user_store.rs. Judgement calls: a refused built-in commit also ends the preview, since the token is used up; preview_name returns the base name so the submenu marks the existing row. cargo test -p tl-ui --lib theme:: 59 passed; clippy -D warnings clean with and without test-hooks; rustfmt check clean.

title: E17-001 TlTheme, GraphPalette, status colours and derived tints
description:
## Context
Creates the theme data types every tasklens view reads: `TlTheme` with TaskSlinger's 22 colour slots, `accent`, the 13-field `GraphPalette`, the four status colours and the derived tints. Nothing renders yet; later beads load the built-in JSON (E17-002), map onto the kit theme (E17-004) and install the store (E17-A1). This bead also adds the `theme` module and the tl-ui crate dependencies, so it is the first tl-ui bead. Spec phase P1 (UI-FND-001); built in the phase-0 slice because anchor E17-A1 (P0) needs it. Sources: ADR-009 "Theme model", UI-FND-001, UI-FND-040 (struct), APP-035, APP-039 (accent list), R-068, R-119 (`chart_bg`), D-005.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`:
- `pub enum ThemeMode { Dark, Light }` (`Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug`, serde lower-case `"dark"` / `"light"`).
- `pub struct StatusColors { pub success: Hsla, pub warning: Hsla, pub danger: Hsla, pub info: Hsla }`.
- `pub struct TlTheme { pub name: Arc<str>, pub mode: ThemeMode, pub version: u64, pub builtin: bool, pub window_bg, titlebar, toolbar, input, input_focus, header, list_bg, row_alt, row_hover, row_selected, divider, menu_bg, menu_hover, tab_bg, tab_hover, scroll_track, scroll_thumb, text_primary, text_secondary, text_selected_primary, text_selected_secondary, value_heat: Hsla (22 slots, this order), pub accent: Hsla, pub graph: GraphPalette, pub status: StatusColors, pub derived: Derived }` (`Clone, Debug`).
- `pub enum ThemeSlot` with 23 variants in this order: `WindowBg, Titlebar, Toolbar, Input, InputFocus, Header, ListBg, RowAlt, RowHover, RowSelected, Divider, MenuBg, MenuHover, TabBg, TabHover, ScrollTrack, ScrollThumb, TextPrimary, TextSecondary, TextSelectedPrimary, TextSelectedSecondary, ValueHeat, Accent`. Methods: `pub const ALL: [ThemeSlot; 23]`; `pub fn json_key(self) -> &'static str` (upper-case TaskSlinger keys `WINDOW_BG`, `TITLEBAR`, `TOOLBAR`, `INPUT`, `INPUT_FOCUS`, `HEADER`, `LIST_BG`, `ROW_ALT`, `ROW_HOVER`, `ROW_SELECTED`, `DIVIDER`, `MENU_BG`, `MENU_HOVER`, `TAB_BG`, `TAB_HOVER`, `SCROLL_TRACK`, `SCROLL_THUMB`, `TEXT_PRIMARY`, `TEXT_SECONDARY`, `TEXT_SELECTED_PRIMARY`, `TEXT_SELECTED_SECONDARY`, `VALUE_HEAT`; `Accent` returns lower-case `accent`); `pub fn label(self) -> &'static str` with the APP-035 labels: Window background, Title bar, Toolbar, Input, Input focus, Header, List background, Alternate row, Row hover, Selected row, Divider, Menu background, Menu hover, Tab background, Tab hover, Scroll track, Scroll thumb, Primary text, Secondary text, Selected primary text, Selected secondary text, Value heat, and "Accent"; `pub fn get(self, t: &TlTheme) -> Hsla`; `pub fn set(self, t: &mut TlTheme, c: Hsla)`.
- `pub struct ThemeDef { pub name: Arc<str>, pub mode: Option<ThemeMode>, pub slots: [Hsla; 22], pub accent: Hsla, pub status: Option<StatusColors>, pub graph: Option<GraphPalette>, pub extra: BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value> }` (the parsed JSON record; `extra` holds unknown keys so a user file round-trips, UI-FND-042). `impl ThemeDef { pub fn effective_mode(&self) -> ThemeMode }`: `mode` if set, else `Dark` when `slots[WindowBg]` HSL lightness `< 0.5`, else `Light` (UI-FND-040).
- `impl TlTheme { pub fn from_def(def: &ThemeDef, fallback: &TlTheme, appearance: &AppearanceSettings, builtin: bool, version: u64) -> TlTheme }`: copies slots and accent; `status` and `graph` from the def, else from `fallback` (the built-in theme of the same mode); then `rebuild_derived`.
- `pub mod palette; pub mod derived;` and `pub use` of `GraphPalette`, `Derived`.

`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/palette.rs`:
- `pub struct GraphPalette { pub cpu_fill, cpu_line, kernel_line, mem_fill, mem_line, gpu_fill, gpu_line, disk_fill, disk_line, net_fill, net_line, grid, chart_bg: Hsla }` (13 fields, `Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq`).
- `pub const GRAPH_COLOR_ACCENT: &str = "accent";`
- `pub const ACCENT_COLORS: [(&str, u32); 17]` in this order (APP-039, stored lower-case in state.toml): Coral `0xFF7F50`, Orange `0xF28C28`, Amber `0xF5B700`, Yellow `0xE8D44D`, Lime `0x9BCB3C`, Green `0x4CAF50`, Mint `0x3EB489`, Teal `0x14A098`, Cyan `0x22B8CF`, Blue `0x3B82F6`, Indigo `0x6366F1`, Violet `0x8B5CF6`, Lavender `0xB4A7F5`, Fuchsia `0xD946EF`, Pink `0xEC4899`, Rose `0xF43F5E`, Slate `0x64748B`. Names in display case ("Coral"); `pub fn accent_color(name_lower: &str) -> Option<Hsla>` matches case-insensitively. These hex values are fallbacks until U-18 replaces them (APP-039).

`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/derived.rs`:
- `pub struct Derived { pub new_row_tint: Hsla, pub exited_row_tint: Hsla, pub focus_ring: Hsla, pub shadow: Hsla, pub overlay: Hsla, pub stale_text: Hsla }`.
- `pub fn rebuild_derived(t: &mut TlTheme, appearance: &AppearanceSettings)` with the UI-FND-001 rules: `new_row_tint` = `status.success` alpha 0.18; `exited_row_tint` = `status.danger` alpha 0.18; `focus_ring` = `accent` alpha 1.0; `shadow` = `#000000` alpha `0.35 × shadow_intensity_pct / 100` (dark) or `0.18 × shadow_intensity_pct / 100` (light); `overlay` = `#000000` alpha 0.4 (dark) or 0.25 (light); `stale_text` = `text_secondary`.
- `pub fn heat(row_bg: Hsla, value_heat: Hsla, value: f32, reference: f32, intensity_pct: u8) -> Hsla`: `t = clamp(value / reference, 0, 1) × intensity_pct / 100`; convert both to sRGB `Rgba`, lerp r, g, b per component by `t` (alpha of `row_bg`), convert back. Two multiplies and three lerps; no allocation. `reference <= 0` returns `row_bg`.
- `pub fn blend_over(base: Hsla, tint: Hsla) -> Hsla` (source-over in sRGB, used for the NEW and EXITED tints over a row background).

Crate wiring (this bead is the first to touch tl-ui):
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod theme;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml` `[dependencies]`, if missing: `tl-model = { path = "../tl-model" }`, `gpui-kit = { workspace = true }`, `serde = { workspace = true }`, `serde_json = { workspace = true }`, `smallvec = { workspace = true }`, `rustc-hash = { workspace = true }`, `tracing = { workspace = true }` (the ADR-001 tl-ui row).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a theme with `row_bg #191B1D` and `value_heat #3E2A28` **When** `heat(row_bg, value_heat, 0.0, r, 100)` is called **Then** the result equals `row_bg`.
- **Given** the same colours **When** `heat(.., r, r, 100)` is called **Then** the result equals `value_heat` (within 1/255 per channel).
- **Given** intensity 50 and value = reference **When** `heat` is called **Then** each sRGB channel is the midpoint of the two inputs (within 1/255).
- **Given** a value above the reference **When** `heat` is called **Then** the result is clamped to `value_heat` at 100% intensity.
- **Given** `shadow_intensity_pct = 0` **When** `rebuild_derived` runs **Then** `derived.shadow.a == 0.0`.
- **Given** a dark theme and `shadow_intensity_pct = 100` **When** `rebuild_derived` runs **Then** `derived.shadow.a == 0.35`; for a light theme `0.18`.
- **Given** a `ThemeDef` with `mode = None` and `WINDOW_BG #F3F4F6` **When** `effective_mode()` is called **Then** it returns `Light`; with `#191B1D` it returns `Dark`.
- **Given** a `ThemeDef` without `status` and `graph` **When** `TlTheme::from_def` runs with a fallback theme **Then** `status` and `graph` equal the fallback's.
- **Given** `ThemeSlot::ALL` **When** iterated **Then** it has 23 entries, 22 unique upper-case keys plus `accent`, in the APP-035 order.
- **Given** `accent_color("coral")` and `accent_color("Coral")` **When** called **Then** both return `#FF7F50`; `accent_color("magenta")` returns `None`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: create (types above).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/palette.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/derived.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod theme;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml`: add the dependencies above if missing.

## Tests
- `theme::derived::tests::heat_endpoints`: `heat(0, r)` equals the row bg; `heat(r, r)` at 100% equals `value_heat`.
- `theme::derived::tests::heat_midpoint_and_clamp`: 50% intensity midpoint; value above reference clamps.
- `theme::derived::tests::shadow_and_overlay_alphas`: dark 0.35 and 0.4, light 0.18 and 0.25, intensity 0 gives alpha 0.
- `theme::tests::mode_inferred_from_window_bg`: lightness rule.
- `theme::tests::slot_keys_and_labels`: 23 slots, key and label tables as above, `get`/`set` round-trip every slot.
- `theme::palette::tests::seventeen_accent_colours`: count 17, order, case-insensitive lookup.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A (pure data).
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A here; the contrast floor test is in E17-002.
- Performance: `heat` is called per heat-coloured cell; it must not allocate and must be at most 2 multiplies and 3 lerps beyond the colour-space conversion. Everything else runs only on theme switch.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Parse colours elsewhere (E17-002) with `gpui::Rgba::try_from(&str)` then `.into()` to `Hsla` (UI-FND-001 Build line).
- `AppearanceSettings` is the `[appearance]` section type from `tl-model::settings` (E03-A2): `shadow_intensity_pct`, `heat_intensity_pct`, `rounded_corners`, `ui_scale_pct`, `row_height_pct`.
- Asupersync types are banned in tl-ui (D-001, ADR-001 rule 1).
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/palette.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/derived.rs crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml Cargo.lock`.

title: E17-002 Built-in theme JSON and strict loader
description:
## Context
Ships the two P1 built-in themes, Default Dark and Default Light, as `assets/themes/builtin.json` in TaskSlinger's format plus tasklens keys, and the strict loader that turns the embedded file into `ThemeDef`s. The file is embedded with `include_str!`; it is never read from disk. Spec phase P1 (UI-FND-001, UI-FND-041); built in the phase-0 slice for anchor E17-A1 (P0). Sources: UI-FND-001, UI-FND-041, ADR-009 theme model, APP-035, R-068, R-122 (Default Light ships as given), ADR-011 (built-ins are not on disk).

## Deliverable
`assets/themes/builtin.json` (repository root `assets/`), exactly two themes in this order:

```json
{"themes":[
 {"name":"Default Dark","mode":"dark",
  "WINDOW_BG":"#191B1D","TITLEBAR":"#27292B","TOOLBAR":"#202224","INPUT":"#202224",
  "INPUT_FOCUS":"#25282B","HEADER":"#2E3235","LIST_BG":"#191B1D","ROW_ALT":"#1D1F20",
  "ROW_HOVER":"#232629","ROW_SELECTED":"#075B84","DIVIDER":"#2B2F33","MENU_BG":"#2A2E31",
  "MENU_HOVER":"#104B68","TAB_BG":"#202224","TAB_HOVER":"#27292B","SCROLL_TRACK":"#1A1C1E",
  "SCROLL_THUMB":"#494F54","TEXT_PRIMARY":"#D6D8D9","TEXT_SECONDARY":"#6C7072",
  "TEXT_SELECTED_PRIMARY":"#FFFFFF","TEXT_SELECTED_SECONDARY":"#BFD9E6","VALUE_HEAT":"#3E2A28",
  "accent":"#0277A6",
  "status":{"success":"#4CAF50","warning":"#E0A526","danger":"#D9534F","info":"#2A9FD6"},
  "graph":{"cpu_fill":"#0D546D","cpu_line":"#0A7096","kernel_line":"#C1514E","mem_fill":"#7E6A9A",
    "mem_line":"#A58CC4","gpu_fill":"#508A59","gpu_line":"#71B768","disk_fill":"#8A7340",
    "disk_line":"#D9B567","net_fill":"#1E5C66","net_line":"#359CAB","grid":"#2A3033","chart_bg":"#1D2223"}},
 {"name":"Default Light","mode":"light",
  "WINDOW_BG":"#F3F4F6","TITLEBAR":"#E4E6E9","TOOLBAR":"#EBEDEF","INPUT":"#FFFFFF",
  "INPUT_FOCUS":"#FFFFFF","HEADER":"#DDE1E5","LIST_BG":"#FFFFFF","ROW_ALT":"#F6F7F8",
  "ROW_HOVER":"#E8EBEE","ROW_SELECTED":"#CFE6F2","DIVIDER":"#D4D8DC","MENU_BG":"#FFFFFF",
  "MENU_HOVER":"#E1EEF5","TAB_BG":"#EBEDEF","TAB_HOVER":"#E0E3E6","SCROLL_TRACK":"#EBEDEF",
  "SCROLL_THUMB":"#B5BBC0","TEXT_PRIMARY":"#1B1F22","TEXT_SECONDARY":"#5F666B",
  "TEXT_SELECTED_PRIMARY":"#0F1416","TEXT_SELECTED_SECONDARY":"#3E5460","VALUE_HEAT":"#F6D5CF",
  "accent":"#0277A6",
  "status":{"success":"#2E7D32","warning":"#B7791F","danger":"#C62828","info":"#0277A6"},
  "graph":{"cpu_fill":"#BFDCE8","cpu_line":"#0A7096","kernel_line":"#C1514E","mem_fill":"#D8CCE6",
    "mem_line":"#7E6A9A","gpu_fill":"#CFE4D2","gpu_line":"#3F8A4A","disk_fill":"#F0E2BC",
    "disk_line":"#B8923A","net_fill":"#C4E3E7","net_line":"#2A8A98","grid":"#D9DEE2","chart_bg":"#FAFBFC"}}
]}
```

`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/builtin.rs`:
- `const BUILTIN_JSON: &str = include_str!("../../../../assets/themes/builtin.json");`
- `pub const TS_THEME_ORDER: [&str; 12] = ["Default Dark", "Vivid Nightfall", "Catppuccin Frappé", "Catppuccin Macchiato", "Catppuccin Mocha", "Dracula", "OLED Black", "Default Light", "Windows 7 Aero", "Golden Summer Fields", "Soft Pink Delight", "Catppuccin Latte"];` (APP-035).
- `pub fn parse_hex(s: &str) -> Result<Hsla, ColorParseError>`: accepts `#RRGGBB` and `#RRGGBBAA` only (case-insensitive hex digits); anything else is an error. Used again by the user store.
- `pub enum ThemeParseError { Json(serde_json::Error), NotAnObject, MissingThemesArray, MissingName { index: usize }, MissingSlot { theme: Arc<str>, key: &'static str }, BadColor { theme: Arc<str>, key: String, value: String } }` with `thiserror`-free manual `Display` (thiserror is not in the tl-ui row) naming the theme and key.
- `pub fn parse_theme_object(obj: &BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value>, strict: bool) -> Result<ThemeDef, ThemeParseError>`: reads `name`, optional `mode` (`"dark"`/`"light"`), the 22 upper-case slot keys, `accent`, optional `status` object (four keys), optional `graph` object (13 keys); every other key goes into `ThemeDef.extra`. With `strict = true` a missing slot or bad colour is an error (built-ins). The lenient path is the user store's (E17-008), which calls this with `strict = false` and gets back the list of repairs through a separate function there.
- `pub fn load() -> Arc<[ThemeDef]>`: parses `BUILTIN_JSON` into `serde_json::Value`, each theme into `BTreeMap<String, Value>`, then `parse_theme_object(.., strict = true)`. Panics with the `ThemeParseError` text on failure (the file is embedded; the parse test catches it at build time). Runs once at `TasklensUi::init`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the embedded file **When** `load()` runs **Then** it returns 2 themes named "Default Dark" and "Default Light", in that order.
- **Given** each loaded theme **When** its slots are read **Then** all 22 slots plus `accent` hold the values listed above.
- **Given** a JSON theme object missing `HEADER` **When** parsed with `strict = true` **Then** the result is `MissingSlot { key: "HEADER" }` naming the theme.
- **Given** a colour `"#12345"`, `"red"` or `"#GG0000"` **When** `parse_hex` runs **Then** it returns an error; `"#0277A6"` and `"#0277A6CC"` parse.
- **Given** a theme object without a `mode` key and `WINDOW_BG #F3F4F6` **When** parsed **Then** `effective_mode()` is `Light`.
- **Given** a theme object with an unknown key `"FOO":"bar"` **When** parsed **Then** `extra` holds `FOO` with its value.
- **Given** the loaded names **When** compared with `TS_THEME_ORDER` **Then** they appear in the same relative order.
- **Given** each loaded theme **When** every text/background pair below is measured **Then** WCAG contrast is at least 4.5:1, except the selected pairs which are at least 4.4:1. Pairs: `text_primary` on `list_bg`, `window_bg`, `row_alt`, `menu_bg`, `header`; `text_secondary` on `list_bg`, `window_bg`; `text_selected_primary` and `text_selected_secondary` on `row_selected`.

## Files
- `assets/themes/builtin.json`: create (two themes, exact values above).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/builtin.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod builtin;`.

## Tests
- `theme::builtin::tests::builtin_json_parses`: `load()` succeeds; every slot present in both themes; every value is a 6-digit hex in the file text.
- `theme::builtin::tests::all_slots_present_in_every_theme`: 22 slots plus accent per theme, values equal the tables above.
- `theme::builtin::tests::names_in_ts_order`: loaded names are an ordered subsequence of `TS_THEME_ORDER`.
- `theme::builtin::tests::light_theme_mode_inferred_if_missing`: object without `mode` infers Light from `#F3F4F6`.
- `theme::builtin::tests::strict_rejects_missing_slot_and_bad_colour`.
- `theme::builtin::tests::parse_hex_forms`: the accepted and rejected forms above.
- `theme::builtin::tests::contrast_floor`: the pair list above, with relative luminance per WCAG 2.x.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: a broken built-in file panics at start with the theme name and key; the tests make this a build-time failure.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: the contrast test is the accessibility check for both themes (UI-FND-001).
- Performance: parse once at init; under 1 ms for 12 themes (UI-FND-041).
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Key casing rule (UI-FND-041): slot keys upper-case TaskSlinger names; `name`, `mode`, `accent`, `status`, `graph` lower-case so a TaskSlinger import never collides.
- The other 10 themes are appended by E17-005 (P2); do not add placeholders.
- `thiserror` is not in the tl-ui dependency row (ADR-001); write `Display` by hand.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::builtin`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- assets/themes/builtin.json crates/tl-ui/src/theme/builtin.rs crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`.
close_reason: Built-in theme JSON and strict loader; R-269 TEXT_SECONDARY Dark #959A9C, Light #5E656A; contrast_floor checks secondary text on 12 backgrounds. Commits 2694a4d, d9a8512, 3db612e, ef79b34, c0a2aa0

title: E17-003 UiMetrics global
description:
## Context
Creates `UiMetrics`, the GPUI Global that holds every size token already multiplied by the UI scale: row height, base text, the two radii, spacing, text and icon sizes, and the batch-wide `style_version`. Every view reads sizes from it; no view multiplies by `ui_scale` by hand. Spec phase P1; built in the phase-0 slice for anchor E17-A1. Sources: ADR-009 "Metrics and scale", UI-FND-003, R-020, R-077, APP-040, UI-SHL-130 (recompute steps).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/metrics.rs`:

```rust
pub struct TextSizes { pub xs: Pixels, pub sm: Pixels, pub base: Pixels, pub md: Pixels, pub lg: Pixels, pub xl: Pixels }
pub struct IconSizes { pub xs: Pixels, pub sm: Pixels, pub md: Pixels, pub lg: Pixels }
pub struct UiMetrics {
    pub ui_scale: f32,            // ui_scale_pct / 100
    pub row_height: Pixels,       // 28 × row_height_pct/100 × ui_scale
    pub base_text: Pixels,        // 13 × ui_scale
    pub radius_small: Pixels,     // 4 × ui_scale, or 0 when rounded_corners = false
    pub radius_card: Pixels,      // 6 × ui_scale, or 0
    pub sp: [Pixels; 9],          // sp[0] = 0; sp[1..=8] = 2 4 6 8 12 16 24 32 × ui_scale
    pub text: TextSizes,          // 11 12 13 14 16 20 × ui_scale
    pub icon: IconSizes,          // 12 14 16 20 × ui_scale
    pub line_height: f32,         // 1.3 for every text size (ratio, not scaled)
    pub style_version: u64,       // bumps on any change here or in the active theme
}
impl gpui::Global for UiMetrics {}
```

Functions:
- `pub fn compute(appearance: &AppearanceSettings, prev_version: u64) -> UiMetrics`: pure; takes `ui_scale_pct`, `row_height_pct`, `rounded_corners` from the `[appearance]` section of table (a) (ranges 75..=200 and 80..=150, already clamped by the settings loader); sets `style_version = prev_version + 1`.
- `impl UiMetrics { pub fn hairline(window: &Window) -> Pixels }`: `px(1.0 / window.scale_factor())` (one physical px).
- `pub fn recompute(appearance: &AppearanceSettings, cx: &mut App) -> bool`: computes new metrics; if any field other than `style_version` changed, installs the global with the bumped version and returns `true`; else leaves the global and returns `false`. A change of `window.scale_factor()` is reported by the caller calling `bump_style_version` (scale factor is not part of `UiMetrics`; chart keys and text caches read it themselves).
- `pub fn bump_style_version(cx: &mut App)`: `style_version += 1` on the installed global. The one function every style-version change goes through (theme switches, preview edits, scale-factor changes).
- `pub fn init_metrics(appearance: &AppearanceSettings, cx: &mut App)`: installs the first value with `style_version = 1`.
- `pub fn metrics(cx: &App) -> &UiMetrics` (shorthand for `cx.global::<UiMetrics>()`).

Rules carried in doc comments: views read `metrics(cx)` once per render into a local; no `px()` arithmetic in element builders beyond `m.sp[n]`. `recompute` does not call `theme::map::apply` and does not touch `CellTextCache`; the theme store (E17-A1) calls `map::apply` after a metrics change, and `CellTextCache` clears itself on a new `style_version` (E18).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `ui_scale_pct = 100, row_height_pct = 100, rounded_corners = true` **When** `compute` runs **Then** `row_height = 28`, `base_text = 13`, `radius_small = 4`, `radius_card = 6`, `sp = [0,2,4,6,8,12,16,24,32]`, text `11,12,13,14,16,20`, icons `12,14,16,20`.
- **Given** `ui_scale_pct = 150, row_height_pct = 120` **When** `compute` runs **Then** `row_height = 50.4`, `base_text = 19.5`, `sp[4] = 12`.
- **Given** `rounded_corners = false` **When** `compute` runs **Then** `radius_small = 0` and `radius_card = 0` at any scale.
- **Given** installed metrics with `style_version = 5` **When** `recompute` runs with unchanged appearance **Then** it returns `false` and `style_version` stays 5.
- **Given** installed metrics with `style_version = 5` **When** `recompute` runs with `ui_scale_pct = 125` **Then** it returns `true` and `style_version = 6`.
- **Given** installed metrics **When** `bump_style_version` is called twice **Then** `style_version` rose by 2.
- **Given** a window with scale factor 1.1 **When** `hairline` is called **Then** it returns `px(1.0 / 1.1)`.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/metrics.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/mod.rs`: add `pub mod metrics;` and `pub use metrics::{UiMetrics, bump_style_version, metrics};`.

## Tests
- `theme::metrics::tests::scale_and_row`: scale 150 and row 120 give `row_height` 50.4, `base_text` 19.5, `sp[4]` 12.
- `theme::metrics::tests::defaults_at_100`: the full token list at 100%.
- `theme::metrics::tests::rounded_off_zeroes_radii`.
- `theme::metrics::tests::recompute_bumps_only_on_change` (`#[gpui_kit::test]`, `TestAppContext`).
- `theme::metrics::tests::bump_style_version_increments`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A (scale changes come from the shell, UI-SHL-130).
- Performance: `compute` runs only on a settings or scale change; views read fields, no per-frame work.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- GPUI applies the compositor scale (1.1 on the owner machine); tasklens multiplies by `ui_scale` once (ADR-009). Nothing in tl-ui reads `window.scale_factor()` except `hairline`, chart geometry keys and text cache invalidation (UI-FND-003 preamble).

title: E17-006 Theme crossfade
description:
## Context
Adds the 200 ms theme crossfade (P2): when animations are on, a theme switch interpolates every colour from the old theme to the new one over `m_base` 200 ms, driven by the window's `AnimationDriver` so there is still exactly one `on_next_frame` per frame. Chart geometry rebuilds twice per animated switch (start and end), not every frame. Sources: UI-FND-040 step 3 and states, APP-035 (200 ms crossfade), R-017, ADR-009 "Theme switch" and "Animation driver", UI-SHL-080, UI-SHL-132.

## Deliverable
Changes in `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`:
- `struct Crossfade { from: Arc<TlTheme>, to: Arc<TlTheme>, started: Instant, duration: Duration /*200 ms*/ }` held as `crossfade: Option<Crossfade>` in `ThemeStore`.
- `pub fn lerp_theme(a: &TlTheme, b: &TlTheme, t: f32) -> TlTheme`: linear interpolation in Hsla space for each of the 22 slots, `accent`, the 4 status colours and the 13 graph colours (40 lerps); hue interpolates along the shorter arc; then `rebuild_derived`. Name, mode, version and `builtin` come from `b`.
- `activate` (E17-A1) gains the animated path: when `motion.animations` is true and `cx.reduce_motion()` is false ("animations on", R-017), set `crossfade = Some(..)` with `from = current active (or the current interpolated theme if a crossfade is running)` and `to = new theme`; call `bump_style_version` once at the start; request the next frame through the main window's `AnimationDriver::request(THEME_ANIM_ID)`, where `THEME_ANIM_ID` is a reserved `EntityId` constant used only for the theme.
- `pub fn tick_crossfade(cx: &mut App) -> bool`: called by the driver callback for `THEME_ANIM_ID` (the window's driver calls it instead of `cx.notify` for this id). It computes `t = ease_out_cubic(elapsed / 200 ms)`, replaces `active` with `Arc::new(lerp_theme(from, to, t))`, refreshes windows, and re-requests the next frame while `t < 1`. At `t >= 1`: `active = to`, `crossfade = None`, `bump_style_version` once more, `map::apply` once with the final theme, return `false`. It does not bump `style_version` on intermediate frames.
- `map::apply` is not called on intermediate frames; kit widgets switch at the end.
- A second `activate` during a crossfade restarts from the current interpolated colours (UI-FND-040 states).
- With animations off or reduced motion: the E17-A1 instant path, unchanged (one bump, one apply).

The `AnimationDriver` hook: `anim.rs` (E19-A1) owns the driver. This bead adds no code to `anim.rs`; it registers `tick_crossfade` through the driver's public request API for a non-entity requester if E19-A1 provides one, and otherwise through a callback registration function on the driver. If E19-A1 provides neither, stop and report it as a new open item (do not edit `anim.rs`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** animations on and reduced motion off **When** `activate("Default Light", User)` runs from Default Dark and frames run for 250 ms of test time **Then** `style_version` rose by exactly 2 and the final `active` equals Default Light.
- **Given** a crossfade at 100 ms **When** `active.window_bg` is read **Then** it lies strictly between `#191B1D` and `#F3F4F6` in lightness.
- **Given** a crossfade at 100 ms **When** `activate("Default Dark", User)` runs **Then** the new crossfade starts from the interpolated colours (its `from.window_bg` equals the value at 100 ms, not `#F3F4F6`).
- **Given** `motion.animations = false` **When** `activate` runs **Then** the switch is instant and `style_version` rose by 1 (E17-A1 behaviour).
- **Given** reduced motion on **When** `activate` runs **Then** the switch is instant.
- **Given** a running crossfade **When** frames are drawn **Then** exactly one `on_next_frame` callback is registered per frame by the window (the driver's), never one from the store.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: crossfade state, `lerp_theme`, `tick_crossfade`, animated `activate` path, tests.

## Tests
- `theme::store::tests::crossfade_bumps_style_version_twice` (`TestAppContext`, `advance_clock`).
- `theme::store::tests::crossfade_midpoint_is_between`.
- `theme::store::tests::second_switch_restarts_from_current`.
- `theme::store::tests::animations_off_is_instant_and_single_rebuild` (kept from E17-A1, still passing).
- `theme::store::tests::lerp_theme_endpoints`: `t = 0` equals `a`, `t = 1` equals `b` for all 40 colours.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: reduced motion and `motion.animations = false` make the switch instant (R-017, APP-058).
- Performance: 40 Hsla lerps per frame, 12 frames at 60 Hz; two geometry rebuilds per animated switch (UI-FND-040 Performance). No allocation per frame beyond one `TlTheme` (about 1 KB).
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Easing `ease_out_cubic` (UI-FND-003 motion).
- GPUI `App::reduce_motion()`: `gpui-pre-0.3.7/src/app.rs:1141`.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui theme::store`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`.

title: E17-007 Follow system light and dark
description:
## Context
Adds follow-system theme switching (P2): when `theme.follow_system` is on, a change of the desktop colour scheme selects `theme.dark` for portal value 0 (no preference) or 1 (prefer dark) and `theme.light` for 2 (prefer light), through the normal `activate` path with the crossfade. The portal value arrives from the engine in the snapshot (`system.color_scheme`). Sources: UI-FND-040 "Follow system", APP-036, UI-SHL-080, R-069, table (a) `[theme]`.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`:
- `pub fn scheme_target(theme: &ThemeSettings, scheme: u8) -> &str`: `0 | 1 => theme.dark`, `2 => theme.light`, any other value `=> theme.dark`.
- `pub fn on_system_scheme(scheme: u8, theme: &ThemeSettings, cx: &mut App) -> Option<Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError>>`: stores `system_scheme = scheme`; if `theme.follow_system` is false or the scheme did not change, returns `None`; else calls `activate(scheme_target(..), ActivateSource::FollowSystem, cx)` and returns its result. `FollowSystem` writes nothing to settings.
- `pub fn on_follow_system_enabled(theme: &ThemeSettings, cx: &mut App) -> Option<Result<ThemeEvent, ThemeError>>`: applies the matching preferred theme at once (UI-SHL-080 "Turning sync on applies the matching preferred theme at once"); returns `None` when it is already active.
- Turning follow-system off keeps the current theme; the shell writes it to `theme.active` (UI-FND-040). No store function needed beyond `current()`.

`crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs` (chain edit inside this batch, after E16-A1): in `TasklensUi::init`, subscribe to `SnapshotHub` events; when the `SYSTEM` bit is in the mask and `snapshot.system.color_scheme` differs from `ThemeStore.system_scheme`, call `on_system_scheme` with the current `[theme]` settings. Read settings from `BootSettings` until E20-A2 replaces it with `TlSettings`. The returned event is dropped here (follow-system switches show no toast; APP-036 lists no toast for them).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** follow-system on, `theme.light = "Default Light"`, `theme.dark = "Default Dark"`, Default Dark active **When** a snapshot with `color_scheme = 2` installs **Then** Default Light becomes active and settings are not written.
- **Given** follow-system on and Default Light active **When** `color_scheme` changes to 1 **Then** Default Dark becomes active; with 0 Default Dark as well.
- **Given** follow-system off **When** `color_scheme` changes **Then** `system_scheme` updates and the active theme does not change.
- **Given** follow-system just turned on with `system_scheme = 2` and Default Dark active **When** `on_follow_system_enabled` runs **Then** Default Light becomes active.
- **Given** two snapshots with the same `color_scheme` **When** both install **Then** `activate` runs at most once.
- **Given** an unknown scheme value 7 **When** handled **Then** `theme.dark` is used.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs`: the three functions and tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs`: one hub subscription block in `TasklensUi::init`.

## Tests
- `theme::store::tests::follow_system_picks_light_for_2_dark_otherwise`.
- `theme::store::tests::follow_off_ignores_scheme`.
- `theme::store::tests::enabling_sync_applies_at_once`.
- `ui_theme::scheme_change_from_snapshot_switches_theme` (in `tests/ui_theme.rs`, FakeEngine publishes two snapshots with schemes 1 then 2).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: an `UnknownTheme` (a preferred theme that no longer exists) is logged with `warn!` and the theme stays.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: one comparison per `SYSTEM` change; a switch only when the scheme changes.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Blocked on open item 6 in docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md: ADR-003 has no `SystemSnapshot.color_scheme` field and no engine worker reads the portal `org.freedesktop.portal.Settings.ReadOne("org.freedesktop.appearance", "color-scheme")` with `SettingChanged`. Start only after E03 and the engine owner add them; use the field name the leader settles (recommended `SystemSnapshot.color_scheme: u8`).
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui --test ui_theme theme::store`. On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- crates/tl-ui/src/theme/store.rs crates/tl-ui/src/app.rs crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_theme.rs`.
