title: E18-001 Selection by identity
description:
## Context
Pure selection logic for every tasklens table: a set of row identities plus an anchor and a focus row, never indexes. Selection survives re-sorts, filter changes and view-mode changes because it is keyed by identity (PROC-001, PROC-015, PROC-048). This bead creates the `table` module and `table/selection.rs`, unit-tested without GPUI. Sources: UI-PRC-008, ADR-009 "Selection (`table/selection.rs`)", D-011 (group headers never selectable), PROC-043 (exited rows drop after the linger time).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/mod.rs`: `pub mod selection;` (later beads add `columns`, `cells`, `tree_table`, `header`, `actions`, `columns_window`).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod table;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/selection.rs`:
```rust
pub struct Selection<R: Copy + Eq + Hash> {
    set: FxHashSet<R>,
    anchor: Option<R>,
    focus: Option<R>,
}
/// The view the gesture is computed against: rows in current display order.
pub trait SelectionView<R> {
    fn len(&self) -> usize;
    fn id(&self, ix: usize) -> R;
    fn index_of(&self, id: R) -> Option<usize>;   // the delegate's FxHashMap row_index
    fn selectable(&self, ix: usize) -> bool;      // false for group headers
}
impl<R> Selection<R> {
    pub fn new() -> Self;
    pub fn click(&mut self, id: R);                          // set = {id}, anchor = focus = id
    pub fn ctrl_click(&mut self, id: R);                     // toggle id; focus = id; anchor = id when it was added
    pub fn shift_click(&mut self, id: R, v: &impl SelectionView<R>);      // set = selectable rows anchor..=id in view order; focus = id; anchor unchanged
    pub fn ctrl_shift_click(&mut self, id: R, v: &impl SelectionView<R>); // add anchor..=id range to set
    pub fn right_click(&mut self, id: R) -> bool;            // if id not selected: click(id); returns true when the set changed
    pub fn clear(&mut self);                                 // click on empty body area
    pub fn select_all(&mut self, v: &impl SelectionView<R>); // every selectable visible row; anchor = first selectable
    pub fn move_focus(&mut self, delta: i32, extend: bool, v: &impl SelectionView<R>);   // skips non-selectable rows
    pub fn move_page(&mut self, rows: usize, down: bool, extend: bool, v: &impl SelectionView<R>); // rows = viewport rows - 1
    pub fn move_edge(&mut self, end: bool, extend: bool, v: &impl SelectionView<R>);     // Home / End
    pub fn toggle_focus(&mut self);                          // Ctrl+Space, same as ctrl_click(focus)
    pub fn set_focus_only(&mut self, id: R);                 // focus without selecting (jump helpers)
    pub fn retain(&mut self, keep: impl FnMut(&R) -> bool);  // drop identities that no longer exist (exited after linger)
    pub fn contains(&self, id: &R) -> bool;
    pub fn ids(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = R> + '_;
    pub fn anchor(&self) -> Option<R>;
    pub fn focus(&self) -> Option<R>;
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
    pub fn visible_count(&self, v: &impl SelectionView<R>) -> usize; // selected ids present in the view (hidden ones not counted)
    pub fn in_view_order(&self, v: &impl SelectionView<R>) -> SmallVec<[R; 8]>; // selected ids in display order, hidden ones excluded
}
```
- Gesture table (UI-PRC-008), exactly:
  - Click: set = {row}, anchor = focus = row.
  - Ctrl+click: toggle row; focus = row; anchor = row when it was added.
  - Shift+click: set = rows between anchor and row in current view order (selectable rows only); focus = row; anchor unchanged. No anchor: behaves as Click.
  - Ctrl+Shift+click: add the anchor..row range to the set.
  - Right-click on unselected row: set = {row}. On a selected row: set unchanged.
  - Up/Down: focus moves one selectable row; set = {focus}; anchor = focus. Shift+Up/Down: set = anchor..focus range.
  - PgUp/PgDn: focus moves by (viewport rows - 1), clamped to the first or last selectable row; set = {focus}; Shift extends.
  - Home/End: first or last selectable row; set = {focus}; Shift extends.
  - With no focus row, the first Down (or Up) selects the first selectable row (UI-PRC-009).
  - Group header rows are never added to the set by any gesture.
- A selected identity hidden by the filter or a collapsed parent stays in the set; `visible_count` and `in_view_order` skip it.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** rows A, B, C, D all selectable **When** click B then shift_click D **Then** set = {B, C, D}, anchor B, focus D.
- **Given** set {B} anchor B **When** ctrl_click D **Then** set = {B, D}, focus D, anchor D.
- **Given** set {B, D} **When** ctrl_click D **Then** set = {B}, focus D, anchor stays B.
- **Given** set {A} anchor A **When** ctrl_shift_click C **Then** set = {A, B, C}.
- **Given** row 0 is a group header and rows 1..3 processes **When** select_all **Then** the set holds rows 1..3 only and anchor is row 1.
- **Given** focus on row 1 and row 2 a group header **When** move_focus(+1, false) **Then** focus is row 3 and set = {row 3}.
- **Given** set {B} **When** the view reorders to D, C, B, A **Then** contains(B) is true and index_of(B) is 2.
- **Given** set {B, C} and C filtered out of the view **When** visible_count **Then** 1, and contains(C) is still true.
- **Given** set {B, C} **When** retain drops C (exited after linger) **Then** set = {B}; if focus was C it becomes None.
- **Given** no focus **When** move_focus(+1, false) **Then** focus and set are the first selectable row.
- **Given** set {B} **When** right_click(B) **Then** returns false and set is unchanged; right_click(C) returns true and set = {C}.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/mod.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/selection.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod table;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_selection.rs`: create, tests below (a `VecView` test helper implementing `SelectionView<u32>`).

## Tests
- `ui_selection::selection_click_ctrl_shift_matrix`: every row of the gesture table above.
- `ui_selection::selection_survives_resort`: reorder the view, the set and anchor keep their identities (ADR-009 verification).
- `ui_selection::selection_skips_group_headers`: arrows, Shift ranges and select_all never include non-selectable rows.
- `ui_selection::selection_drops_exited_after_linger`: `retain` removes ids absent from the view's backing data and clears focus or anchor that pointed at them.
- `ui_selection::selection_hidden_by_filter_not_counted`: hidden ids stay selected, not counted, and reappear in `in_view_order` once present again.
- `ui_selection::page_and_edge_moves`: PgDn with viewport 10 moves 9 rows; End goes to the last selectable row; Shift variants extend from the anchor.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: this logic backs the full keyboard model (UI-PRC-009).
- Performance: range selection O(range); no allocation in `contains` or `move_focus`; `in_view_order` allocates only past 8 ids.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Uses `rustc_hash::FxHashSet` and `smallvec` (both in the ADR-001 tl-ui row). No GPUI types in this file.
- The mouse and keyboard wiring is E18-007; this bead has no GPUI code.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>`. New files need `git add` first. Read `CLAUDE.md` first.
- Plan file: `docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md` (open items cited by number).
close_reason: table/mod.rs + table/selection.rs (Selection by identity, SelectionView) and tests/ui_selection.rs, 6 tests pass. Commits a761735, f9e37a0, 516f90d

title: E18-002 CellTextCache
description:
## Context
Tables re-format a cell only when its value or validity changes. `CellTextCache` maps a row identity and column to the last value bits, validity and formatted `SharedString`, so a 1 Hz table update re-formats only changed cells and the frame loop never calls `format!`. It also caches middle-ellipsized path texts per 8 px width bucket. Sources: ADR-009 "Text caching", UI-FND-052 (path truncation cache, 8 px bucket), UI-FND-003 (scale change clears the cache), ADR-009 verification (hit rate above 95%).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/text_cache.rs` (and `pub mod text_cache;` in `lib.rs`):
```rust
pub struct CellTextCache<R: Copy + Eq + Hash> {
    cells: FxHashMap<(R, ColumnId), CacheEntry>,
    paths: FxHashMap<(R, ColumnId, u16 /* width bucket = floor(width_px / 8) */), (u64 /* source text hash */, SharedString)>,
    table_version: u64,          // last table version seen
    style_version: u64,          // last UiMetrics.style_version seen
    hits: u64, misses: u64,      // test and bench counters
}
struct CacheEntry { bits: u64, validity: Validity, text: SharedString, last_seen: u64 /* table_version */ }

pub const MAX_ENTRIES: usize = 8192;
pub const KEEP_VERSIONS: u64 = 3;

impl<R> CellTextCache<R> {
    pub fn new() -> Self;
    /// Call once per new table version (ProcessTableView.header.version or the owner's version).
    pub fn begin_version(&mut self, table_version: u64, style_version: u64);
    /// Returns the cached text when bits and validity match, else calls `format(&mut String)` once,
    /// stores the result and returns it. `format` writes into a reused scratch String.
    pub fn get_or_format(&mut self, row: R, col: ColumnId, bits: u64, validity: Validity,
                         format: impl FnOnce(&mut String)) -> SharedString;
    /// Names and other Arc<str> texts: stores SharedString::from(Arc<str>) without copying.
    pub fn get_or_insert_arc(&mut self, row: R, col: ColumnId, text: &Arc<str>) -> SharedString;
    pub fn path(&mut self, row: R, col: ColumnId, width: Pixels, source: &Arc<str>,
                truncate: impl FnOnce(&str, Pixels) -> SharedString) -> SharedString;
    pub fn clear(&mut self);
    pub fn hit_rate(&self) -> f64;   // hits / (hits + misses), 1.0 when both are 0
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize;
}
```
Rules:
- Key `(R, ColumnId)` where `R` is the table's row identity (`NodeId` for processes). Value `(u64 value bits, Validity, SharedString)` (ADR-009). `bits` is `f32::to_bits as u64` or the raw `u64` value; the caller decides.
- A cell re-formats only when its bits or validity changed. Validity is part of the key so glyph texts (`…`, `n/a`, `-`, `!`) are cached like values (UI-FND-026).
- Eviction: in `begin_version`, entries whose `last_seen` is older than `table_version - KEEP_VERSIONS + 1` (not seen in the last 3 table versions) are removed. If after that more than 8192 entries remain, remove the oldest `last_seen` entries until 8192 remain.
- `begin_version` with a `style_version` different from the stored one clears both maps (scale, row height or font change, UI-FND-003 and the batch rule that metrics.rs never names this type).
- Path cache key includes the width bucket `floor(width / 8 px)`; a different bucket re-truncates. The source text hash is FxHash of the `Arc<str>` contents; a change re-truncates.
- `get_or_insert_arc` hits when the stored `SharedString` points at the same `Arc` (pointer equality) or equal text.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** an empty cache **When** get_or_format(row 1, cpu, bits X, Valid) is called twice in the same version **Then** `format` runs once and both calls return the same `SharedString`.
- **Given** a cached cell **When** the same cell arrives with validity WarmingUp and the same bits **Then** `format` runs again.
- **Given** 100 rows × 9 columns formatted at version 1 **When** versions 2..=10 bring identical values **Then** `hit_rate()` is above 0.95.
- **Given** a cell last seen at version 1 **When** begin_version(5) runs **Then** the entry is gone.
- **Given** 9000 distinct cells all seen at the current version **When** begin_version(next) runs **Then** `len()` is at most 8192.
- **Given** a filled cache **When** begin_version is called with a new style_version **Then** `len()` is 0 and the path cache is empty.
- **Given** a path cell cached at width 200 px **When** asked at 205 px (same bucket 25) **Then** `truncate` does not run; at 208 px (bucket 26) it runs.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text_cache.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`: add `pub mod text_cache;`.

## Tests
- `text_cache::tests::hit_rate_above_95_over_10_versions`: as the acceptance criterion (ADR-009 verification).
- `text_cache::tests::reformats_on_bits_or_validity_change`.
- `text_cache::tests::evicts_after_3_versions`.
- `text_cache::tests::caps_at_8192`.
- `text_cache::tests::clears_on_style_version`.
- `text_cache::tests::path_width_bucket_8px`.
- `text_cache::tests::arc_names_not_copied`: `get_or_insert_arc` returns a `SharedString` whose text pointer equals the `Arc<str>` pointer.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: every `Validity` state is part of the key.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: one hash lookup per visible cell per frame; `format` reuses one scratch `String` held in the cache; no allocation on a hit.
- Privacy: the cache holds display text only in memory; never logged.

## Notes
- `ColumnId` and `Validity` come from `tl-model` (`ids.rs`, `validity.rs`, E03-A1).
- `UiMetrics.style_version` is the `u64` in the `UiMetrics` Global (E17-003); the caller passes it in.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>`. New files need `git add` first. Read `CLAUDE.md` first.
- Plan file: `docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md` (open items cited by number).
close_reason: CellTextCache in crates/tl-ui/src/text_cache.rs with 8 tests; commits a420c6f, d064df7, d2bbf3d, 4be631f. Release hit path 8.4 ns per lookup.

title: E18-003 ColumnLayout, ColumnSpec, widths and column state by id
description:
## Context
The column model shared by every table: per-column specs (label, alias, group, alignment, kind, sortability, width template, tooltip, availability), and the per-table layout (order, visible set, widths, precomputed x offsets). Column state is stored by `ColumnId` string, never by index, in `state.toml` `[columns.<table>]`. Sources: UI-PRC-001 (`columns()`, `column_spec()`), UI-PRC-005 (minimum widths), UI-PRC-007 (order keeps hidden ids in place), ADR-009 ("Column positions are a precomputed `Arc<[Pixels]>`"), ADR-011 (columns by id, unknown id dropped with a log line), PROC-022, PROC-023, PROC-025, R-065 (aliases), canonical table (a) `[columns.*]` and `[sort.*]`, UI-FND-051 rule 3 (template widths through `TextMetricsCache`).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/table/columns.rs` (add `pub mod columns;` to `table/mod.rs`):
```rust
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Debug, serde::Deserialize, schemars::JsonSchema)]
pub enum TableId { Processes, History, Services, Startup, Connections }   // the five tables of canonical table (a) [columns.*]
impl TableId { pub fn state_key(self) -> &'static str }                   // "processes" | "history" | "services" | "startup" | "connections"

#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum ColumnAlign { Left, Right }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum ColumnKind { Text, Path, Numeric }
#[derive(Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)] pub enum Availability { Available, NotOnThisSystem }  // picker note "n/a on this system"

pub struct ColumnSpec {
    pub id: ColumnId,
    pub label: SharedString,              // header line 1, e.g. "Memory"
    pub full_name: SharedString,          // picker name, e.g. "Working set private"; equals label when no alias
    pub group: SharedString,              // picker heading, e.g. "Memory"
    pub align: ColumnAlign,               // Text and Path: Left; Numeric: Right
    pub kind: ColumnKind,
    pub sortable: bool,                   // false: PSS, USS, Cycles, Cycles delta, Context switches, Context switches delta
    pub template: Option<&'static str>,   // numeric width template, e.g. "100.0%", "999999 +99", "xxx MiB/s", "999 MiB", "999999", "999:59:59"
    pub default_width: Pixels,            // logical px at 100%
    pub tooltip: Option<SharedString>,    // header tooltip (UI-PRC-005 texts are supplied by the owner)
    pub availability: Availability,
    pub hideable: bool,                   // false only for Name
}

pub struct ColumnLayout {
    pub table: TableId,
    pub order: Vec<ColumnId>,             // every known column, hidden ones kept in place
    pub visible: FxHashSet<ColumnId>,     // the filter
    pub widths: FxHashMap<ColumnId, Pixels>,   // logical px at 100%, remembered for hidden columns too
    offsets: Arc<[Pixels]>,               // x offset of each visible column in order, scaled
    visible_order: Arc<[ColumnId]>,       // visible ids in order
    total_width: Pixels,
    version: u64,                         // bumps on every change; offsets rebuilt then
}
impl ColumnLayout {
    pub fn from_state(table: TableId, state: &ColumnsState, specs: &[ColumnSpec]) -> Self;
    pub fn to_state(&self) -> ColumnsState;
    pub fn defaults(table: TableId, specs: &[ColumnSpec], default_order: &[ColumnId], default_visible: &[ColumnId]) -> Self;
    pub fn visible_columns(&self) -> &Arc<[ColumnId]>;
    pub fn offsets(&self) -> &Arc<[Pixels]>;
    pub fn total_width(&self) -> Pixels;
    pub fn width(&self, id: ColumnId) -> Pixels;          // scaled by UiMetrics.ui_scale
    pub fn set_visible(&mut self, id: ColumnId, on: bool) -> Result<(), ColumnError>;
    pub fn set_width(&mut self, id: ColumnId, w: Pixels);
    pub fn move_column(&mut self, id: ColumnId, before: Option<ColumnId>) -> Result<(), ColumnError>;
    pub fn rebuild(&mut self, ui_scale: f32);             // recompute offsets, visible_order, total_width; bump version
    pub fn version(&self) -> u64;
    pub fn column_at_x(&self, x: Pixels) -> Option<ColumnId>;
    pub fn boundary_near_x(&self, x: Pixels, half_band: Pixels) -> Option<ColumnId>;   // resize hit band, 4 px each side
}
pub enum ColumnError { NameCannotBeHidden, LastVisible, NameMustStayFirst, Unknown }

pub fn min_width(spec: &ColumnSpec, is_sort_column: bool, metrics: &mut TextMetricsCache, m: &UiMetrics) -> Pixels;

impl SortSpec { pub fn next_for(current: &SortSpec, col: ColumnId, kind: ColumnKind) -> SortSpec; } // free fn `next_sort` if SortSpec is foreign
```
`ColumnsState` is the `tl-model::settings` type for `[columns.<table>]` (fields `order: Vec<ColumnId>`, `visible: Vec<ColumnId>`, `widths: map id -> u32`), written by E03-A2. If E03 named it differently, use E03's name.

Rules:
- `from_state`: ids not in `specs` are dropped with `tracing::info!(target: "tasklens::ui", ...)` naming the id string (ADR-011). Spec ids missing from `order` are appended at the end in spec order, hidden. A missing width takes `default_width`. Name (`ColumnId` "name") is forced first in `order` and forced visible.
- Minimum width (PROC-023, UI-PRC-005): Numeric columns: template width + 16 (8 px padding each side) + 12 more on the current sort column (sort arrow reservation). Text and Path columns: 60. Template width is measured through `TextMetricsCache` (E15-002) in the table font at `t_base` 13 × ui_scale with `tnum`, so it follows scale changes.
- `set_visible(name, false)` returns `NameCannotBeHidden`; hiding the last visible column returns `LastVisible` (toast text "At least one column must stay visible" is shown by the caller). Showing a column restores its remembered width and its old slot in `order` (UI-PRC-007).
- `move_column` refuses moving Name and refuses `before == Some(name)` (nothing before Name, UI-PRC-005), returning `NameMustStayFirst`.
- `next_for`: same column: flip direction. New column: Numeric starts descending, Text and Path start ascending (UI-PRC-005, PROC-047).
- Offsets are scaled by `UiMetrics.ui_scale` (widths are stored at 100%) and rebuilt only in `rebuild`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** state order `["name","pid","bogus"]` **When** from_state **Then** "bogus" is dropped, a log line names it, and every other spec id is appended hidden.
- **Given** state order with "pid" before "name" **When** from_state **Then** "name" is first.
- **Given** a layout **When** set_visible(name, false) **Then** `Err(NameCannotBeHidden)` and nothing changes.
- **Given** "cpu" hidden after being third with width 70 **When** set_visible(cpu, true) **Then** it is third again with width 70.
- **Given** widths name 248, user 92, pid 96 at ui_scale 1.5 **When** rebuild **Then** offsets are 0, 372, 510.
- **Given** a Numeric column with template "100.0%" **When** min_width at the sort column **Then** it equals measured template width + 16 + 12; not sorted: + 16; a Text column gives 60 × ui_scale.
- **Given** sort pid ascending **When** next_for(pid) **Then** pid descending; next_for(cpu, Numeric) gives cpu descending; next_for(user, Text) gives user ascending.
- **Given** a layout **When** to_state then from_state **Then** the layout is equal (round trip).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/columns.rs`: create, with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/mod.rs`: add `pub mod columns;`.

## Tests
- `columns::tests::unknown_id_dropped_and_logged`.
- `columns::tests::name_forced_first_and_visible`.
- `columns::tests::reshown_column_keeps_slot_and_width`.
- `columns::tests::offsets_scaled_and_rebuilt_on_change`: version bumps, offsets match the criterion.
- `columns::tests::min_width_from_template`: template + 16 (+ 12 on the sort column); text columns 60.
- `columns::tests::next_sort_numeric_desc_text_asc`.
- `columns::tests::state_round_trip`.
- `columns::tests::move_refuses_before_name`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: `ColumnError` variants above; callers show the toasts.
- Validity: N/A.
- Accessibility: N/A.
- Performance: offsets are an `Arc<[Pixels]>` rebuilt only on layout change; render reads them without allocation.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- `schemars` is required by GPUI for data-carrying Actions that use `TableId`; it comes through gpui-kit (`gpui_kit::schemars` re-export if present, else check how gpui-kit derives `JsonSchema` for its own actions and do the same).
- Default column sets and widths per table are the owner's (processes: canonical table (a) `[columns.processes]`); this file only stores and applies them.

title: E18-004 Cell painters: text, path and numeric cells
description:
## Context
The generic cell painters every table uses: plain text cells with end ellipsis and a tooltip only when truncated, path cells with the middle ellipsis, numeric cells right-aligned with tabular figures that clip instead of ellipsizing, and validity glyph cells. Page-specific painters (Name cell, heat colouring, dim zeros) live in the pages, never here (00-epics section 2). This bead also defines `CellOut`, the buffer a delegate fills per cell. Sources: UI-PRC-001 (`cell(ix, col, out: &mut CellOut)`), UI-PRC-002 (cell padding 8, `t_base`, clipping), UI-FND-051 (tnum, right alignment, numbers clip with no ellipsis), UI-FND-052 (truncation table, conditional tooltip, middle ellipsis per 8 px bucket), UI-FND-053 rule 1 (debug check: no control characters), UI-FND-026 (glyph cells keep numeric alignment and width; secondary colours on selected rows), ADR-009 text caching.

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/table/cells.rs` (add `pub mod cells;` to `table/mod.rs`):
```rust
/// Filled by TreeTableDelegate::cell. The table calls cell() with want_text = false, looks up
/// CellTextCache with (row, col, bits, validity); only on a miss it calls cell() again with
/// want_text = true and the delegate writes `text`.
pub struct CellOut {
    pub bits: u64,                 // value bits (f32::to_bits as u64, or the raw integer)
    pub validity: Validity,
    pub arc: Option<Arc<str>>,     // text cells that hold an Arc<str> (names, users): no formatting, no copy
    pub text: String,              // scratch, reused; written only when want_text
    pub want_text: bool,
    pub background: Option<Hsla>,  // page override (heat colouring, UI-PRC-004); drawn under selection
    pub text_color: Option<Hsla>,  // page override (dim zero values)
    pub tooltip: Option<SharedString>, // optional explicit cell tooltip
}
impl CellOut { pub fn reset(&mut self); }

pub struct CellCtx<'a> {          // per-row painting context
    pub m: &'a UiMetrics, pub theme: &'a TlTheme,
    pub selected: bool, pub width: Pixels,
}
pub fn text_cell(text: SharedString, ctx: &CellCtx, truncated: Rc<Cell<bool>>) -> impl IntoElement;
pub fn path_cell(text: SharedString /* already middle-ellipsized */, ctx: &CellCtx) -> impl IntoElement;
pub fn numeric_cell(text: SharedString, validity: Validity, ctx: &CellCtx) -> impl IntoElement;
pub fn glyph_cell(validity: Validity, value_text: &SharedString, ctx: &CellCtx) -> impl IntoElement; // wraps TlValidityGlyph::render
pub fn cell_tooltip_if_truncated(full: SharedString, truncated: Rc<Cell<bool>>) -> ...;           // 500 ms TlTooltip::text
```
Rules:
- Every cell: fixed width from `ColumnLayout`, absolutely positioned by the row at its x offset, padding 8 left and 8 right (× ui_scale), vertically centred, `overflow_hidden`, `whitespace_nowrap`, text `t_base` 13 regular `text_primary`; on a selected row `text_selected_primary`, and every secondary colour becomes `text_selected_secondary`.
- `text_cell`: end ellipsis with `text_overflow(TextOverflow::Ellipsis)` (U+2026). The cell measures its text against the available width in `prepaint` and sets the shared `truncated` flag; the cell tooltip (`TlTooltip::text`, 500 ms) is attached only when the flag is set (UI-FND-052 "shown only when truncated"). In debug builds it `debug_assert!`s that the text has no C0 or C1 control character (UI-FND-053 rule 1).
- `path_cell`: the text passed in is already cut by `text::ellipsis::middle_ellipsis` (E15-003) through `CellTextCache::path` keyed by the 8 px width bucket; full text in the cell tooltip when it was cut.
- `numeric_cell`: right-aligned, `text::style::numeric_style(m)` with the shared `TNUM` features (E15-002); text that exceeds the width is clipped at the right edge, never ellipsized (UI-FND-051 rule 4); the full text goes to the cell tooltip only when clipped.
- `glyph_cell`: for any validity other than Valid, draws `TlValidityGlyph::render` (E15-012): `…`, Lucide `lock` 12 px, `n/a`, `-`, `!`, right-aligned like a number in numeric columns, so a change from `…` to a number moves nothing. A glyph cell never gets a `background` override (no heat on glyphs).
- `background` and `text_color` overrides are drawn as given; the selected fill always wins over `background`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a 60 px text column and a 40-character name **When** the row renders **Then** the cell shows "…" at its end and hovering 500 ms shows a tooltip with the full name.
- **Given** a text that fits **When** hovered **Then** no tooltip appears.
- **Given** the numeric text "10.00 GiB/s" in a column narrower than it **When** rendered **Then** the text is clipped at the right edge and contains no "…".
- **Given** validity WarmingUp in a numeric column **When** rendered **Then** "…" in `text_secondary` sits right-aligned at the same right edge a number uses.
- **Given** validity Restricted **When** rendered **Then** a 12 px lock icon in `text_secondary` is right-aligned.
- **Given** a selected row **When** a Stale cell renders **Then** its colour is `text_selected_secondary`.
- **Given** a delegate with `background = Some(heat)` and validity Failed **When** rendered **Then** no background is drawn and the glyph is "!" in `status.warning`.
- **Given** a debug build and a cell text containing U+0007 **When** rendered **Then** the debug assertion fires.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/cells.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/mod.rs`: add `pub mod cells;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_tree_table.rs`: create with the cell tests below (E18-A1 adds more cases to this file).

## Tests
- `ui_tree_table::text_cell_tooltip_only_when_truncated` (TestAppContext, 60 px column).
- `ui_tree_table::numeric_cell_clips_without_ellipsis`.
- `ui_tree_table::glyph_cells_keep_right_edge`: `…`, `n/a`, `-`, `!` and the lock all end at the column's right padding edge.
- `ui_tree_table::selected_row_uses_selected_text_colours`.
- `ui_tree_table::no_heat_on_glyph_cells`.
- `cells::tests::control_char_debug_assert` (`#[should_panic]`, `#[cfg(debug_assertions)]`).

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: all seven states, through `TlValidityGlyph` for non-Valid.
- Accessibility: tooltips carry the full text of truncated cells.
- Performance: no `format!` here; texts arrive as `SharedString` from `CellTextCache`; no element id per cell (UI-PRC-001), the truncation tooltip uses the row's hitbox and the cell's measured flag.
- Privacy: untrusted text is already sanitized by `tl-collect::sanitize`; the debug check only verifies it.

## Notes
- Depends on `TlValidityGlyph` (E15-012), `TlTooltip` (E15-007), text styles (E15-002), `middle_ellipsis` (E15-003, blocked on open item 2) and `CellTextCache` (E18-002).
- The RTL render case (`untrusted::tests::rtl_name_in_ltr_cell`) and the 60 px golden are in E18-013.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.

- Plan file: `docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md` (open items cited by number).

title: E18-006 TlTreeTable body and one-line header
description:
## Context
The `TlTreeTable<D>` entity and its body: a GPUI `uniform_list` that builds only the visible rows, each row one `div` with fixed-width cells at precomputed x offsets, a one-line header with column labels, shared horizontal scrolling, the kit scrollbars, the zebra, hover and selected fills, the group header band, and the generic Name cell (indent, chevron, connector lines, icon, texts). Sorting, filtering and expansion state belong to the delegate; the table never sorts. Sources: UI-PRC-001 (anatomy, entity fields, performance), UI-PRC-002 (row parts, group header band, stale 60% opacity), UI-PRC-003 (Name cell geometry), R-105 (group header band), D-011 (group rows `row_h` tall), ADR-009 (row height, column offsets, body not cached), UI-FND-003 (scrollbar geometry), ADR-014 `table-2000` gate.

## Deliverable
In `crates/tl-ui/src/table/tree_table.rs`:
```rust
pub struct TlTreeTable<D: TreeTableDelegate> {
    pub delegate: D,
    pub selection: Selection<D::RowId>,
    scroll: UniformListScrollHandle,
    x_offset: Pixels,                 // shared by header and body
    focus: FocusHandle,               // created in new(), never in render
    text_cache: CellTextCache<D::RowId>,
    header_state: HeaderState,        // drag and resize, filled by E18-009..011
    hover_row: Option<usize>,
    pub paused: bool,                 // set by the page during Ctrl-pause (UI-PRC-017); E18-008 stops anchoring while true
    last_version: u64,
    #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-hooks"))] pub render_count: Cell<u32>,
    #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-hooks"))] pub rows_built_last_frame: Cell<u32>,
}
impl<D> TlTreeTable<D> {
    pub fn new(delegate: D, window: &mut Window, cx: &mut Context<Self>) -> Self;
    pub fn focus_handle(&self) -> &FocusHandle;
    pub fn delegate_mut(&mut self) -> &mut D;
    pub fn on_new_version(&mut self, cx: &mut Context<Self>);   // owner calls after installing new rows; bumps cache version, notifies
}
impl<D> Render for TlTreeTable<D> { ... }
```
Layout (all sizes × `ui_scale` through `UiMetrics`; `row_h = UiMetrics.row_height`):
- Root: `v_flex`, background `list_bg`, `key_context("Table")`, `track_focus(&focus)`, `tab_index(0)`, `tab_stop(true)`.
- Header (`table/header.rs::TlTreeTableHeader`, one-line mode in this bead): height 28 for `HeaderLines::One` and 44 for `Two` (line 2 empty until E18-009), background `header`, bottom border 1 px `divider` (hairline, `UiMetrics::hairline`), one label per visible column at the same x offsets as the body, label `t_base` 13 weight 500 `text_primary`, padding 8, end ellipsis, aligned like the column (Left or Right). Translated by `-x_offset`. A 1 px `divider` boundary line at each column boundary in the header at all times.
- Body: `uniform_list` (gpui `elements/uniform_list.rs:22`) with item height `row_h`, `ListHorizontalSizingBehavior::Unconstrained`, `track_scroll(&self.scroll)`; the render closure builds rows only for the requested range. Not wrapped in `.cached()` (it owns scrolling, ADR-009).
- Row: one `div` of width `ColumnLayout::total_width()` and height `row_h`, cells absolutely positioned at `offsets()`. One hitbox per row (`id` = row index within the frame's range is not allowed; use the row div's `on_mouse_down`, `on_mouse_move` without a per-cell id). Background order: zebra (`list_bg` for even flattened index, `row_alt` for odd), then `CellOut.background` overrides, then NEW tint `derived.new_row_tint` or EXITED tint `derived.exited_row_tint` (flags), then hover `row_hover`, then selected `row_selected` (selected wins; hover on a selected row changes nothing).
- Group header row (`RowKind::GroupHeader`): no zebra and no hover; the full row width is filled with `header`; a 1 px `divider` line at the top edge unless it is row 0; the Name cell draws chevron (`chevron-down` expanded, `chevron-right` collapsed, 16 px `text_primary`) at x 8 and the label `t_md` 14 weight 600 `text_primary` at x 30; no other cell renders (R-105, UI-PRC-002).
- Stale rows (`RowFlags::STALE`): every metric cell (all columns except the Name column) at 60% opacity.
- Name cell (`table/cells.rs::paint_name_cell(cell: NameCell, depth, expandable, flags, guide_lines, ctx)`):
  indent `8 + depth × 18`; chevron box 16 × 16 (`chevron-right` / `chevron-down`, `text_secondary`, `text_primary` while its 20 × `row_h` hit area is hovered), its 16 px always reserved even with no chevron; connector lines when `guide_lines()` is true: for each ancestor depth k < depth with bit k of `ancestor_continues`, a 1 px `divider` vertical quad at x = `8 + k×18 + 8` over the full row; for the row's own depth a vertical quad from the row top to the row centre (to the bottom unless `LAST_SIBLING`) and a horizontal quad from that x to the chevron's left edge at the centre; depth-0 rows under a group draw from x 16; group headers draw none; quads via `paint_quad` inside a `canvas`, snapped to 1 physical px. Then the icon (24 for `IconSlot::Large`, 16 otherwise, vertically centred; `NameIcon::File` through `img(path)`, missing file falls back to Lucide `binary` in `text_secondary`), gap 6, the primary text (`t_base`, `text_primary` or `text_selected_primary`, end ellipsis; U+FFFD runs in `status.warning` when `highlight_fffd`, using `text::untrusted::split_fffd_runs` from E15-004; `count_run` drawn with `tnum`), then, after an 8 px gap, the secondary text in `text_secondary` (`text_selected_secondary` when selected), hidden entirely when the cell is narrower than primary width + 8 + 40; then the glyph icons 12 px `text_secondary` with their tooltips; then `trailing` at the right edge inset 4. The Name cell is the only cell with an element id (hover and the row tooltip, 600 ms, from `row_tooltip`).
- Vertical scrollbar: kit `Scrollbar::vertical(&scroll)` on the body's right edge (not over the header), `ScrollbarMode::Always`, width 16 (4 inset + 8 active thumb + 4), idle thumb 6 wide, active 8, minimum thumb length 48, radius 0, track `scroll_track`, thumb `scroll_thumb` (UI-FND-003).
- Horizontal scrollbar: same style, 16 high, shown only when `total_width > viewport width`; header and body share `x_offset`.
- Empty state: when `row_count() == 0` and `empty_text()` is `Some`, the body shows the text centred (`t_base`, `text_secondary`); the header stays visible.
- Keyboard focus without selection: when the table has keyboard focus (`window.last_input_was_keyboard()`), no row is selected and no focus row exists, a 1 px `accent` inset ring around the whole body.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** 2,000 rows and a 720 px viewport at `row_h` 28 **When** rendered **Then** at most 27 row elements are built (`rows_built_last_frame <= 27`).
- **Given** rows 0..3 with row 0 a group header **When** rendered **Then** row 0 is filled `header` with no top line, row 1 `list_bg`, row 2 `row_alt`.
- **Given** row 2 selected and hovered **When** rendered **Then** its fill is `row_selected`.
- **Given** a group header at row 5 **When** rendered **Then** it has a 1 px `divider` line at its top edge and only the Name cell content.
- **Given** a depth-2 row **When** the Name cell renders **Then** the text starts at x = 8 + 18×2 + 16 + 6 + icon width (UI-PRC-003 `name_cell_indent_by_depth`).
- **Given** `guide_lines()` false **When** rendered **Then** no connector quads are painted; true: they are.
- **Given** columns totalling 1,400 px in a 1,000 px viewport **When** rendered **Then** the horizontal scrollbar shows and scrolling it moves the header and body by the same offset.
- **Given** total width 900 px in a 1,000 px viewport **When** rendered **Then** no horizontal scrollbar.
- **Given** a row with `STALE` **When** rendered **Then** metric cells are drawn at 60% opacity and the Name cell at 100%.
- **Given** 0 rows and `empty_text = Some("No processes match the filter")` **When** rendered **Then** the header and the centred text show.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/tree_table.rs`: add the entity and `Render` (large file).
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/header.rs`: create `TlTreeTableHeader` one-line mode and boundary lines; `pub mod header;` in `table/mod.rs`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/table/cells.rs`: add `paint_name_cell`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_tree_table.rs`: add the tests below.

## Tests
- `ui_tree_table::tree_table_renders_visible_range_only` (UI-PRC-001).
- `ui_tree_table::zebra_on_flattened_index_and_group_band`.
- `ui_tree_table::selected_wins_over_hover`.
- `ui_tree_table::name_cell_indent_by_depth` (UI-PRC-003).
- `ui_tree_table::connector_lines_only_when_enabled` (UI-PRC-003).
- `ui_tree_table::horizontal_scrollbar_only_on_overflow`.
- `ui_tree_table::stale_row_dims_metric_cells`.
- `ui_tree_table::empty_text_keeps_header`.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A.
- Validity: per cell through `glyph_cell` (E18-004).
- Accessibility: the body is a tab stop; focus visuals per UI-PRC-008 (ring only without a selection); chevron tooltip "Expand" / "Collapse".
- Performance: ADR-014 `table-2000` gate (UI thread p99 at most 2.0 ms per frame while scrolling 1,200 px/s with 1 Hz data changes) is measured by E01; this bead must keep: no `format!` in render (texts from `CellTextCache`), no per-cell element ids except the Name cell, one row `div` with absolute children, offsets read from the `Arc<[Pixels]>`, `row_index` rebuilt only when `table_version()` changes.
- Privacy: N/A.

## Notes
- Large-file rule: commit `tree_table.rs` before building or testing.
- `UniformListScrollHandle` is at gpui `elements/uniform_list.rs:80`; `window.last_input_was_keyboard()` at gpui `window.rs:3241`; kit `Scrollbar` at gpui-kit `crates/base/src/scrollbar.rs:815`, `ScrollbarMode` at `:48`.
- Label `perf-gate`: this bead carries the ADR-014 `table-2000` constraints.
- Build rule: run cargo through `heavy-build cargo ...` (for example `heavy-build cargo test -p tl-ui`). On exit 137 (OOM kill) retry once, then report. On exit 75 (low disk) stop and report.
- Commit with a pathspec: `git commit -m "..." -- <files>`. New files need `git add` first. Read `CLAUDE.md` first.
- Plan file: `docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md` (open items cited by number).

title: E18-007 Mouse and keyboard selection, table actions and keymap
description:
## Context
Mouse and keyboard selection for every table, the shared table Actions and their key bindings. Every command is one GPUI Action in namespace `tasklens`, bound once in `bind_keys_table(cx)` for the `Table` context, so menu items and keys dispatch the same Action. Arrow keys move rows, never columns. Sources: UI-PRC-008 (gesture table), UI-PRC-009 (bindings, Left/Right rules, Ctrl+Space, first Down), canonical table (b) Table rows, D-008 (Enter opens Properties, Space toggles expand), R-128 (one namespace), R-129 (`table/actions.rs`), UI-PRC-002 (double-click, chevron click does not select).

## Deliverable
`crates/tl-ui/src/table/actions.rs` (`pub mod actions;` in `table/mod.rs`):
```rust
// namespace tasklens (R-128)
actions!(tasklens, [SelectAll, ExpandOrChild, CollapseOrParent, ToggleExpand, ToggleSelectFocus,
                    OpenProperties, CopyRow, CopyRowsAsTable, CollapseAll, OpenContextMenu]);
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Deserialize, JsonSchema, Action)] #[action(namespace = tasklens)]
pub struct MoveFocus { pub delta: i32, pub extend: bool }
pub struct MoveFocusPage { pub down: bool, pub extend: bool }
pub struct MoveFocusEdge { pub end: bool, pub extend: bool }
pub struct CopyCell { pub col: ColumnId }       // serialized as the column id string
// header actions (handled in E18-009..E18-A2; declared here so menus and keys share them)
pub struct SortByColumn { pub id: ColumnId }
pub struct OpenColumnPicker { pub table: TableId }
pub struct HideColumn { pub id: ColumnId }
pub struct ResizeColumnsToFit { pub table: TableId }
pub struct SetColumnResize { pub mode: ColumnResizeMode }
pub struct ResetColumns { pub table: TableId }
pub struct SetColumnVisible { pub id: ColumnId, pub on: bool }

pub fn bind_keys_table(cx: &mut App);
```
`bind_keys_table` binds in context `"Table"` (GPUI keystroke syntax):

| Keys | Action |
|---|---|
| `up` / `down` | `MoveFocus { delta: -1 / 1, extend: false }` |
| `shift-up` / `shift-down` | `MoveFocus { delta: -1 / 1, extend: true }` |
| `pageup` / `pagedown` | `MoveFocusPage { down: false / true, extend: false }` |
| `shift-pageup` / `shift-pagedown` | same with `extend: true` |
| `home` / `end` | `MoveFocusEdge { end: false / true, extend: false }` |
| `shift-home` / `shift-end` | same with `extend: true` |
| `ctrl-a` | `SelectAll` |
| `right` | `ExpandOrChild` |
| `left` | `CollapseOrParent` |
| `space` | `ToggleExpand` |
| `ctrl-space` | `ToggleSelectFocus` |
| `enter`, `alt-enter`, `ctrl-i` | `OpenProperties` |
| `ctrl-c` | `CopyRow` (the ProcessTable context rebinds it to `CopyDetails`, E22) |
| `ctrl-shift-c` | `CopyRowsAsTable` |
| `ctrl-l` | `CollapseAll` |
| `shift-f10`, `menu` | `OpenContextMenu` |

Handlers in `tree_table.rs` (`.on_action(cx.listener(..))` on the table root):
- `MoveFocus`, `MoveFocusPage` (by viewport rows − 1), `MoveFocusEdge`, `SelectAll`, `ToggleSelectFocus`: call the `Selection` methods (E18-001) with a `SelectionView` over the delegate; with no focus row, the first Down or Up selects the first selectable row. Keep-visible scrolling is E18-008.
- `ExpandOrChild`: collapsed row with children: `delegate.on_toggle_expand(id)`; expanded row: focus and select its first child (the next row, which has depth + 1); leaf: nothing.
- `CollapseOrParent`: expanded row: `on_toggle_expand(id)`; else focus and select the parent (nearest preceding row with depth − 1). Left on a depth-1 row whose parent is a `GroupHeader` collapses that group (`on_toggle_expand(group id)`) and keeps the selection (UI-PRC-009 decided).
- `ToggleExpand`: on the focus row when `row_expandable` is `Some`; no-op on leaves.
- `OpenProperties`: focus row is a `GroupHeader`: toggle expand; otherwise `delegate.on_activate(focus id)`. With no focus row: nothing.
- `CopyRow`, `CopyCell`, `CollapseAll`, `SetColumnResize`: not handled by the table; they propagate to the owner page (open item 16). `ResetColumns { table }` is handled by the table when the owner called `set_default_layout` (E18-012, R-184).
- `CopyRowsAsTable` and `OpenContextMenu`: handled in E18-A1.
Mouse (row `on_mouse_down` with `event.modifiers` and `click_count`):
- Left click on a selectable row: `click`; Ctrl: `ctrl_click`; Shift: `shift_click`; Ctrl+Shift: `ctrl_shift_click` (gesture table, UI-PRC-008). Clicking a row focuses the table.
- Click on a group header row (anywhere): `on_toggle_expand`, no selection change.
- Click on a chevron hit area (20 × `row_h`): `on_toggle_expand(id)` without changing the selection.
- Double-click (`click_count == 2`): group header toggles; when `delegate.double_click_expands()` is true, a row whose `row_expandable` is `Some(_)` toggles expansion and a leaf does nothing (Processes, R-216); otherwise other rows `delegate.on_activate(id)` (system tables, UI-SYS-002).
- Click on the empty body area below the last row: `selection.clear()`.

description:
## Context

When it closes, every file of the A1 group exists and is exported: `text/{mod,fonts,style,metrics,ellipsis,untrusted}.rs` and `components/{mod,focus,icons,button,checkbox,switch,input,tabs,tooltip}.rs` (plus `progress.rs`, which the button needs). U-7, U-40, U-41 and U-42 are recorded by the group beads. Sources: UI-FND-016, UI-FND-003, APP-028, PROC-077, APP-014, APP-037, PROC-024, R-043. Spec phase P1; P0 because E01 (phase-0 spike) and other epics depend on this anchor. Other epics use `UiMetrics` from E17-A1 together with this group.

Group beads this anchor closes: E15-001 fonts, E15-002 text styles, E15-003 middle ellipsis, E15-004 untrusted text, E15-005 focus and icons, E15-006 progress and spinner, E15-007 tooltip, E15-008 button, E15-009 checkbox, E15-010 switch, E15-011 tabs.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/input.rs`:
  - `pub struct TlTextInput` (`RenderOnce`) wrapping kit `Input::new(&state)` with `.small()` (sm, 24 high) or default (md, 28 high), `.appearance(true)`, optional `.cleanable(true)`, `.prefix(..)`, `.key_context("TlInput")`. Builders: `.size(TlInputSize::{Sm, Md})`, `.prefix_icon(TlIcon::Search)` (`i_sm` 14, `text_secondary`, gap `sp3` 6), `.clear_button(bool)`, `.clean_on_escape(bool)`, `.invalid(bool)`, `.loading(bool)`, `.disabled(bool)`, `.placeholder(SharedString)`.
  - Look: padding x `sp4` 8, radius `r_sm`, bg `input`, 1 px `divider` border; text `t_base` `text_primary`; placeholder `text_secondary`; caret 1 px `text_primary`; selection `accent` at 0.35. Clear button: Lucide `x` `i_sm`, 20 × 20 hit area, shown only when the text is non-empty, tooltip "Clear filter".
  - States: hover border `text_secondary`; focused bg `input_focus` with 1 px `accent` border and no ring; disabled 0.5 with text `text_secondary`; invalid border `status.danger` (the owner's tooltip gives the reason); loading: `TlSpinner` `i_sm` replaces the clear button.
  - Interaction: kit `InputState` editing (select all, undo, word moves, clipboard). Esc with `clean_on_escape`: the first Esc clears the text and emits `InputEvent::Change`, and the owner moves focus; a second Esc follows the global rule. Enter emits `PressEnter`. Right-click opens the kit edit menu (Cut, Copy, Paste, Select all) through `Input::context_menu`.
  - Data: the owner creates `Entity<InputState>` once in its constructor. Read text with `state.read(cx).text()` (a `Rope` borrow), never `value()`.
  - `pub struct TlFilterBox` wrapping `TlTextInput` sm: the label "Filter:" (`t_sm`, `text_secondary`, real text node left of the box), width 160, grows to 280 over 150 ms `ease_out_cubic` on focus, shrinks on blur unless the text is non-empty (then it stays 280); instant under reduced motion. Animation via kit/GPUI `Animation` keyed by focus. The box does not debounce; owners debounce 100 ms before sending a query (ADR-009). Ctrl+F focusing and type-to-filter routing are the shell's (E20) and use `TlFilterBox::focus_and_insert(&state, ch, window, cx)` provided here.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/ui_components.rs` (create; E15-A2 and E16-011 append): a base-control keyboard suite in one window with a `TlButton`, `TlCheckbox`, `TlSwitch`, `TlTextInput` and `TlTabs`:

  - after a mouse click no focus ring is painted; after Tab the ring is painted (U-42 integration);
  - every control at `font_size` 13 has the foundation height (button sm 24, md 28; input sm 24, md 28; checkbox row 24; tab strip 32).
- `components/mod.rs`: add `pub mod input;` and check that every A1 group module is declared.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a filter box with text "fire" and `clean_on_escape` **When** Esc is pressed once **Then** the text is empty and one `Change` event fires.

## Cross-cutting

- Performance: each keystroke re-shapes the visible line in the kit; the parent re-renders only when its debounce fires. No `value()` allocation per frame.

title: E15-007 TlTooltip
description:
## Context
Tooltip content wrapper with the tasklens widths, line cut, delays, placement and keyboard behaviour. Sources: UI-FND-019, R-111, PROC-039 (row tooltip 600 ms, command line cut to 512 chars upstream), ADR-003 validity tooltips, D-004. Spec phase P1; phase-0 slice (anchor E15-A1).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/tooltip.rs`:
  - `pub struct TlTooltip` built with `TlTooltip::text(impl Into<SharedString>)` (one short line, wraps at max width 360) or `TlTooltip::lines(Vec<SharedString>)` (each line its own text run so long lines wrap independently, max width 560), plus `.action(&dyn Action, focus: Option<&FocusHandle>)` that appends the shortcut line (kit `Tooltip::action`), `t_xs`, `text_secondary`, right-aligned.
  - Look: bg `menu_bg`, 1 px `divider` border, radius `r_sm` (4 × ui_scale), menu-level shadow (offset (0, 2), blur 8, `derived.shadow`), padding y `sp2` (4) and x `sp4` (8), text `t_sm` (12) `text_primary`.
  - Max height 12 lines (about 190 px); more lines are cut and the last visible line ends with "…" (U+2026). No middle ellipsis.
  - `pub fn build(self) -> impl Fn(&mut Window, &mut App) -> AnyView + 'static`: returns the closure for GPUI `.tooltip(..)`; the text is built when the tooltip opens.
  - Delays: `pub const DELAY_CONTROL: Duration = 500 ms` (buttons, glyphs; kit default) and `pub const DELAY_ROW_NAME: Duration = 600 ms` (table Name cells, PROC-039), applied as `tooltip_show_delay`.
  - Placement: below the trigger, left-aligned, offset `sp2` (4 × ui_scale); flips above when there is no room below; clamps to the window.
  - Closes on pointer leaving the trigger, mouse down, key down, scroll, window deactivate. A focused button shows its tooltip after the same delay while focus rests on it; Esc hides it and focus stays. No grace period is added for plain `.id().tooltip(..)` elements.
  - Accessible prefix helper: `pub fn with_kind_prefix(kind: &str, text: &str) -> SharedString` ("Error: …") for toasts (UI-FND-020).
- Add `pub mod tooltip;` to `components/mod.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `TlTooltip::text` with a 600-character sentence **When** laid out **Then** its width is at most 360 × ui_scale.
- **Given** `TlTooltip::lines` with a 400-character path line **When** laid out **Then** its width is at most 560 × ui_scale and the line wraps.
- **Given** 15 lines **When** rendered **Then** 12 lines show and the 12th ends with "…".
- **Given** a focused button with a tooltip shown from keyboard focus **When** Esc is pressed **Then** the tooltip hides and the button keeps focus.
- **Given** `.action(&EndTask)` with a bound key **When** rendered **Then** the shortcut line shows the binding text.

- Performance: one extra view only while visible; table Name cells attach a closure that captures the row id, not the text.

title: E15-008 TlButton (U-41)
description:
## Context
The tasklens button with its seven kinds and two densities. Every button dispatches an Action, so menu items, keys and buttons share one command (widgets rule 10). Settles U-41: at rem 13 the kit `Button` size that gives 24 px. Sources: UI-FND-010, R-123, U-41, APP-002 to APP-005, APP-045, PERF-014. Spec phase P1; phase-0 slice (anchor E15-A1).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/button.rs`:
  - `pub enum TlButtonKind { Primary, Secondary, Danger, Ghost, Icon, Toggle { on: bool }, Segment { on: bool } }`, `pub enum TlButtonSize { Sm /*24*/, Md /*28*/ }`.
  - `pub struct TlButton` (`RenderOnce`) with builders `new(id, kind)`, `.label(SharedString)`, `.icon(TlIcon)`, `.size(TlButtonSize)`, `.action(Box<dyn Action>)`, `.on_click(..)` (allowed only inside dialogs for OK and Cancel), `.tooltip(TlTooltip)`, `.disabled(bool)`, `.loading(bool)`, `.pressed(bool)` (dropdown trigger stays pressed while its menu is open), `.tab_stop(bool)` (default true).
  - Table of looks (sizes × ui_scale):

    | Kind | Height sm / md | Padding x | Fill | Border | Text |
    |---|---|---|---|---|---|
    | Primary | 24 / 28 | `sp5` 12 | `accent` | none | `#FFFFFF`, `t_base` 500 |
    | Secondary | 24 / 28 | `sp5` | `toolbar` | 1 px `divider` | `text_primary`, `t_base` 400 |
    | Danger | 24 / 28 | `sp5` | `status.danger` | none | `#FFFFFF`, 500 |
    | Ghost | 24 / 28 | `sp4` 8 | transparent | none | `text_primary` |
    | Icon | 24 / 28 square | 0 | transparent | none | icon `i_md` `text_primary` |
    | Toggle | 24 square | 0 | off transparent; on `accent` at alpha 0.25 | on: 1 px `accent` | icon `i_md`; on: icon tinted `accent` |
    | Segment | 24 | `sp5` | off `toolbar`; on `accent` at 0.25 | 1 px `divider`; on `accent` | label `t_sm` |

  - Icon with label: icon `i_md` left, gap `sp3` 6. Minimum label-button width 72. Radius `r_sm`.
  - States: hover: Primary and Danger lighten 8% (`Hsla.l + 0.08`); Secondary, Ghost, Icon, Toggle fill `tab_hover`; Segment fills `tab_hover` when off. Pressed: Primary and Danger darken 8%; others fill `header`. Hover and pressed change instantly (no animation). Disabled: opacity 0.5, no hover or pressed change, tooltip still shown, not a tab stop. Loading: label replaced by `TlSpinner` `i_sm`, button inert, width kept (measure the label first). Focused (keyboard): `TlFocusRing`.
  - Interaction: click, Space and Enter activate; the Action is dispatched on the window's focused handle. `key_context("TlButton")`. Icon and Toggle require a tooltip (debug assert); the tooltip uses `TlTooltip::text(..).action(&action)` so the shortcut shows. Icon-only buttons set the accessible label from the tooltip text.
  - Build: Primary, Secondary, Danger, Ghost, Icon wrap kit `Button` (`.primary()`, `.danger()`, `.ghost()`, `.compact()` for Icon) with the kit size chosen by the U-41 measurement (`.xsmall()` or `.small()` for 24 px at rem 13; default for 28). Toggle and Segment are custom `div`s with `.id(..)`, `.tab_stop(true)`.
  - A button that opens a dialog ends its label with "…" (owner text, rule 11).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** a focused Primary button with an action **When** Enter is pressed **Then** the action is dispatched once.
- **Given** a focused button **When** Space is pressed **Then** the action is dispatched once.

description:

    | Unsupported | `n/a` | `text_secondary` | "Not available on this device" |

title: E15-016 TlKeyValueGrid and TlValue
description:
## Context

Sources: UI-FND-025, PERF-011, PERF-012, PERF-013, PROC-078, PERF-100 to PERF-104, SYS-011, SYS-026, SYS-034, R-050, D-007. Spec phase P1 (layouts), P2 (links, section copy); phase-0 slice because the CPU page (E24-A1, P0) uses it through anchor E15-A2.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/kv_grid.rs`:
  - `pub struct TlValue { pub text: SharedString, pub validity: Validity, pub word: Option<UnsupportedWord>, pub tooltip: Option<SharedString>, pub link: Option<Box<dyn Action>>, pub path: bool }` with `pub enum UnsupportedWord { NotSupported, NotReported, NeedsSetup }`.
  - `pub struct TlKvRow { pub label: SharedString, pub value: TlValue }` and `pub struct TlKvSection { pub title: Option<SharedString>, pub blocks: Vec<TlKvBlock> }`, `TlKvBlock { pub heading: Option<SharedString>, pub rows: Vec<TlKvRow> }`.
  - `pub struct TlKeyValueGrid` (`RenderOnce`), `new(id, layout: KvLayout::{Stacked, Inline})`, `.sections(&[TlKvSection])`, overrides for the inline layout `.row_height(Pixels)` (default 28 × ui_scale), `.label_width(Pixels)` (default 180 × ui_scale), `.block_indent(Pixels)` (default `sp6` 16), `.block_gap(Pixels)` (default `sp4` 8), `.copy_on_click(bool)`, `.on_copied(impl Fn(SharedString /*copied text*/, &mut Window, &mut App))`, `.on_copy_section(impl Fn(usize, ..))`, `.filtered_empty(bool)`. Owners scale every override through `UiMetrics`; the grid never scales twice.
  - Stacked layout: label `t_sm` `text_secondary` over value `t_base` `text_primary` with `tnum`; three equal columns, min width 160, column width `floor((w - 2 × sp7) / 3)` computed once from the available width (`sp7` 24); column gap `sp7`, row gap 0; pair height 2 × `row_height` (56 at 100%).
  - Inline layout: one row per pair, row height as set, label column width as set (label text includes the ":" from the owner), value flex.
  - Section title band (Information cards): `header` fill, `row_height` high, a 3 px `accent` bar at the left edge, title `t_md` 500 `text_primary` with `sp4` padding, a `TlButton::Icon` (`copy`, `i_sm`, tooltip "Copy section") at the right end calling `on_copy_section`. `sp4` between band and first row. Sub-blocks ("Module 1") indent rows by `block_indent` and are separated by `block_gap`. The gap between cards is the page's.
  - Values: selectable text (kit `Label` with selection, or GPUI `InteractiveText`). Click on a value with `copy_on_click` copies the value text to the clipboard (`cx.write_to_clipboard`), calls `on_copied(text)` (the owner shows the toast, for example "Process property value copied." for PROC-078) and flashes the row with `accent` at alpha 0.25 for 120 ms (instant removal under reduced motion).   - Validity words (`text_secondary` for every non-valid word): Valid → text in `text_primary`; WarmingUp "Collecting…"; Stale → last value with tooltip "Last updated {age} ago"; Restricted "Restricted"; Unsupported → "Not supported", "Not reported" or "Needs setup" per `word` ("Needs setup" is a `TlLink` to the owner's Additional Setup action); Missing → the row is not drawn; Failed "Unavailable" with tooltip "Could not read: {last_error}".

title: E15-021 TlStepper
description:
## Context
Numeric input with minus and plus buttons for ranged integers: `processes.interval_ms` custom value, `history.retention_h`, `history.max_disk_mb`, `motion.tab_switch_ms`, the Set Priority custom nice and the Set Affinity count display. The kit `NumberInput` is not used (look and unconditional wheel behaviour). Sources: UI-FND-015, APP-023, PROC-066, PROC-067. Spec phase P2; phase-0 slice because anchor E15-A2 delivers it.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/stepper.rs`:
  - `pub struct TlStepper` (`RenderOnce`) over an owner-held `Entity<InputState>`: `new(id, &state)`, `.range(min: i64, max: i64, step: i64)`, `.value(i64)`, `.suffix(SharedString)` ("ms", "h", "MB" inside the input in `text_secondary`), `.disabled(bool)`, `.on_change(impl Fn(i64, ..))`.
  - Layout `[ - ][  1000  ][ + ]`, height 28 × ui_scale: minus and plus are `TlButton::Icon` 28 square with 1 px `divider` border joined to a `TlTextInput` md of width 72 (right-aligned, `tnum`); outer radius `r_sm` on the group, inner corners square.
  - At min the minus button is disabled; at max the plus button.
  - Invalid typed text (non-digit or out of range): input border `status.danger`, tooltip "Enter a number between {min} and {max}", value not applied; blur with invalid text reverts to the last valid value.
  - Interaction: buttons step by `step`; Up/Down in the input step; Shift+Up/Down step 10 × step; Enter applies; the mouse wheel over the input steps only while the input is focused. `on_change` fires on apply, not per keystroke. Values are clamped to the range.
- Add `pub mod stepper;` to `components/mod.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** range 1..=12, value 12 **When** rendered **Then** plus is disabled and minus enabled.
- **Given** value 1000, step 250 **When** plus is clicked **Then** `on_change(1250)` fires once.
- **Given** typed text "abc" **When** the input blurs **Then** the text reverts to the last valid value and `on_change` does not fire.
- **Given** typed "99999" with max 10000 **When** rendered before apply **Then** the border is `status.danger` and the tooltip reads "Enter a number between 250 and 10000" (for range 250..=10000).
- **Given** an unfocused input **When** the wheel scrolls over it **Then** the value does not change.

## Files

## Tests

## Cross-cutting

- Accessibility: keyboard stepping; the minus and plus buttons carry tooltips (see Notes).
- Performance: event on apply only.

title: TlTooltip: hover helper that follows the spec placement and close rules
description:
Files: crates/tl-ui/src/components/tooltip.rs.
Why: ug9.10 built TlTooltip and a keyboard FocusTooltip that meet the spec, but hover tooltips use GPUI's .tooltip(..). GPUI places those at the pointer, not below the trigger, and they do not close on key down or window deactivation. The spec (docs/ui/foundation.md, tooltip section) wants the same placement and close rules for hover as for keyboard focus.
Leader decision: owners use a tasklens hover helper instead of raw .tooltip(..). Add HoverTooltip with the same shape as FocusTooltip (state(id, ..) and attach(..)): it opens after the hover delay, below the trigger, left-aligned, sp2 away, flips above and stays inside the window; it closes on pointer leave, mouse down, scroll, any key down and window deactivation. Keep build() for content. Document in the module header that raw .tooltip(..) is not to be used for tasklens tooltips.
AC: Given a hovered trigger after the delay, then the tooltip's top is trigger bottom + sp2 and its left equals the trigger's left. Given a key down while shown, then it closes. Given a trigger near the window bottom, then it shows above. Existing tooltip tests pass. clippy -p tl-ui --all-targets -D warnings clean.
close_reason: HoverTooltip (state + attach) in components/tooltip.rs: opens after delay below trigger left-aligned sp2 away, flips above, closes on leave, mouse down, scroll, key down, window deactivation; header bans raw .tooltip(..). Commits a593d9a, 70a049b

title: E15-A3 Gallery and render tests
description:
## Context
Anchor E15-A3 "Gallery and render tests". The component gallery is the host for golden-image render tests (ADR-013) and lets a reviewer check every component state without the engine. This bead settles U-4 (headless wgpu screenshots work with `HeadlessAppContext` on Mesa lavapipe) by running the render tests in CI. Sources: UI-FND-030, ADR-013 "Headless screenshot tests", R-138 (`--gallery` beside `--bench`, behind the `bench` feature), U-4. Phase P1.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/gallery.rs`:
  - `pub fn open_gallery(cx: &mut App) -> WindowHandle<GalleryView>`: one window (1280 × 800 logical) with a `TlTabs` strip, one page per E15 component, and a `TlSwitch` "Reduced motion" at the top that forces reduced motion for the pages.
  - Each page lists every variant and state in both themes side by side: left half Default Dark, right half Default Light, by rendering two subtrees each under its own `TlTheme` (a scoped theme override: build the two `TlTheme` values from `ThemeStore.builtin` and pass them down explicitly; the gallery does not switch the global theme).
  - `pub const GALLERY_PAGES: &[&str]` = the E15 component modules: `button`, `checkbox`, `radio`, `switch`, `slider`, `stepper`, `input`, `select`, `tabs`, `tooltip`, `progress`, `skeleton`, `kv_grid`, `validity`, `badge`, `empty`, `banner`, `link`, `icons`, `text` (fonts, `tnum` digit column 0 to 9, thin-space grouping, middle ellipsis samples). E16 adds `toast`, `dialog`, `window_frame`, `menu`, `shield` pages in E16-011 by chain edit.
  - States shown per component follow foundation section 2 (for example button: every kind × sm/md × default, hover, pressed, focused, disabled, loading; validity: all 7 states, selected and not).
  - The gallery is compiled only with feature `bench` (`#[cfg(feature = "bench")]` on the module line in `components/mod.rs`) and opened by `tasklens --gallery` (tl-app `gallery_main.rs`, E01).
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/render_gallery.rs` (feature `render-tests`, which enables `bench`): for each page in `GALLERY_PAGES`, open it headless through `testing::render` (E16-005), capture at scale 1.0 and 1.1, compare with `tests/golden/gallery_<page>_<scale>.png`. Pass: at most 0.1% of pixels differ by more than 2/255 in any channel. `TL_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1` rewrites goldens. Reduced motion is forced on so animations are at their end state.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/golden/gallery_*.png`: the goldens, generated with `TL_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1` on lavapipe (`VK_ICD_FILENAMES` set to lavapipe) and reviewed by eye before commit.
- Budget check: a test counts spinners and indeterminate bars per gallery window and asserts each page shows at most 2 animated elements at once (UI-FND-023).
- If the headless screenshot path does not work (U-4 fails), `testing::render` falls back to `painted_quads()` assertions; this bead then asserts quad colours and bounds per page instead of PNGs, and records that in U-4.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** the module list of `components/` **When** `every_component_has_a_page` runs **Then** every E15 component module appears in `GALLERY_PAGES`.
- **Given** goldens committed **When** `cargo test -p tl-ui --features render-tests` runs on lavapipe **Then** every page at scales 1.0 and 1.1 passes the 0.1% / 2/255 rule.
- **Given** `TL_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1` **When** the tests run **Then** goldens are rewritten and the tests pass.
- **Given** the `text` page **When** captured **Then** the digit column 0 to 9 is aligned (tabular figures).
- **Given** any page **When** counted **Then** at most 2 spinners or indeterminate bars are visible.

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/gallery.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/mod.rs`: add `#[cfg(feature = "bench")] pub mod gallery;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/render_gallery.rs`: create.
- `crates/tl-ui/tests/golden/gallery_*.png`: create.
- `docs/RECONCILIATION.md`: append the U-4 result to the U-4 row.

## Tests
- `components::gallery::tests::every_component_has_a_page`: const list checked against the module list (read `components/mod.rs` with `include_str!` and parse `pub mod` lines).
- `tests/render_gallery.rs::gallery_pages_match_goldens`: all pages, scales 1.0 and 1.1.
- `tests/render_gallery.rs::animated_element_budget`: at most 2 per page.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: a missing golden fails with the path and the hint `TL_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1`.
- Validity: the validity page covers all 7 states.
- Accessibility: the reduced-motion switch is keyboard reachable.
- Performance: test-only and bench-only code; not in release builds.
- Privacy: N/A

## Notes
- Headless path (ADR-013): `HeadlessAppContext::with_platform(Arc::new(CosmicTextSystem::new(..)), assets, || gpui_platform::current_headless_renderer())` and `capture_screenshot(window)`; gpui-pre `src/app/headless_app_context.rs:38` and `:168`. The helpers live in `testing/render.rs` (E16-005).

title: E15-001 Bundled fonts and start-up face check (U-7, U-40)
description:
## Context
Bundle the four static Noto faces and load them before the first window, with a start-up check that each face resolves (zed#61660 drops faces without an `m` glyph; zed#64783 breaks variable fonts). This settles U-7 (Noto Sans static faces load and have `tnum`) and U-40 (Noto Sans Mono loads and has `tnum`). Sources: UI-FND-050, ADR-009 "Fonts", R-118, APP-043, U-7, U-40. Spec phase P1; built in the phase-0 slice because anchor E15-A1 (P0) delivers it.

## Deliverable
- `assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf`, `NotoSans-Medium.ttf`, `NotoSans-SemiBold.ttf`, `NotoSansMono-Regular.ttf` (static hinted TTFs, not the variable font) and `assets/fonts/LICENSE-OFL.txt` (SIL Open Font License 1.1 text from the same release).
- Source of the TTFs: the official notofonts `latin-greek-cyrillic` GitHub release (paths `fonts/NotoSans/hinted/ttf/` and `fonts/NotoSansMono/hinted/ttf/`). Take all four from one release. The system package at `/usr/share/fonts/noto` has no SemiBold, so do not mix sources. Record the release tag and the SHA-256 of each of the four files in the commit message.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/mod.rs`: `pub mod fonts;` (later beads add `style`, `metrics`, `ellipsis`, `untrusted`). Add `pub mod text;` to `crates/tl-ui/src/lib.rs`.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/fonts.rs`:
  - `pub const UI_FAMILY: &str = "Noto Sans";` and `pub const MONO_FAMILY: &str = "Noto Sans Mono";`
  - `pub fn load_bundled_fonts(cx: &mut App) -> FontLoadReport` calls `cx.text_system().add_fonts(vec![Cow::Borrowed(include_bytes!("../../../../assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf")), ...])` with all four faces embedded with `include_bytes!`. Then checks `cx.text_system().font_id(&font(...))` for "Noto Sans" at weights 400 (`FontWeight::NORMAL`), 500 (`FontWeight::MEDIUM`), 600 (`FontWeight::SEMIBOLD`) and for "Noto Sans Mono" at 400.
  - `pub struct FontLoadReport { pub ui_ok: bool, pub mono_ok: bool, pub failed: SmallVec<[&'static str; 4]> }` with `ui_ok` true only when all three Noto Sans weights resolve.
  - `pub struct BundledFontStatus(pub FontLoadReport);` implementing `gpui::Global`, set by `load_bundled_fonts`, so the About window (E21) can show "Bundled font failed to load" under the version when `!ui_ok`.
  - On a failed UI face: `tracing::error!(target: "tasklens::ui", face = name, "bundled font failed to load")` and the UI falls back to `.SystemUIFont` (the caller uses `effective_ui_family(&report)` which returns `"Noto Sans"` or `".SystemUIFont"`). On a failed mono face: `warn!`; the kit's mono fallback chain applies (UI-FND-002) and no layout depends on mono metrics.
  - Weights used in tl-ui: 400, 500, 600 only. No `FontWeight::BOLD` (700) anywhere in tl-ui.
- Fallback for non-Latin text is cosmic-text's fontconfig lookup; tasklens does not substitute `U+FFFD` for missing glyphs.

## Acceptance Criteria

title: E15-002 Numeric and label text styles, TextMetricsCache
description:
## Context
Shared text styles so every numeric run uses tabular figures from one static `FontFeatures` value, plus a cache of template widths that tables use for minimum numeric column widths. Sources: UI-FND-051, UI-FND-003 (text sizes, line height 1.3), ADR-009 "Text caching", canonical table (d) template strings, PROC-023. Spec phase P1; built in the phase-0 slice (anchor E15-A1, P0).

  - `pub fn numeric_style(m: &UiMetrics, size: Pixels) -> TextStyleRefinement`: family "Noto Sans", weight 400, `font_features: Some(TNUM.clone())`, line height 1.3 × size.
  - `pub fn label_style(m: &UiMetrics, size: Pixels, weight: FontWeight) -> TextStyleRefinement`: proportional figures (no `tnum`), line height 1.3.

  - `pub fn template_width(&mut self, template: &str, size: Pixels, window: &Window, cx: &App) -> Pixels`: measures with `text_system().layout_line` in "Noto Sans" 400 with `tnum`, caches the result.

title: E15-003 Middle ellipsis for paths
description:
## Context
Paths in table cells (Image path, Command line, Working dir, Executable) use a manual middle ellipsis so the file name stays visible. Sources: UI-FND-052a, UI-FND-052 truncation table, ADR-009 text caching. Spec phase P1; built in the phase-0 slice (anchor E15-A1).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/ellipsis.rs`:
  - `pub const ELLIPSIS: char = '\u{2026}';`
  - `pub fn middle_ellipsis(text: &str, max_px: Pixels, measure: &mut impl FnMut(&str) -> Pixels) -> SharedString` where `measure` is backed by `TextMetricsCache::char_advance` (sum of per-character advances; no shaping per candidate; one call is O(n) additions).
  - Rules:
    1. If the whole text fits in `max_px`, return it unchanged.
    2. Keep the last path component (after the last `/`) whole when its width is at most 40% of `max_px`; else keep its last 12 characters.
    3. Fill the start from the beginning of the path up to `max_px` minus the ellipsis width minus the kept tail width.
    4. Cut only at grapheme boundaries (`unicode_segmentation::UnicodeSegmentation::graphemes(true)`), never inside a grapheme.
    5. The ellipsis must replace at least 2 characters; if only one would be removed, return the text whole (the cell clips it).
  - `pub fn end_ellipsis_note()`: none; end ellipsis is GPUI's `text_overflow(TextOverflow::Ellipsis)` on a `whitespace_nowrap` element (UI-FND-052), not this module.
- Example at a width that fits 30 characters: `/usr/lib/firefox/firefox-bin` stays whole; `/home/oystein/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Game/bin/game.x86_64` becomes `/home/oystein/.local/s…/game.x86_64`.
- Add `pub mod ellipsis;` to `text/mod.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `/usr/lib/firefox/firefox-bin` and a 30-character width **When** `middle_ellipsis` runs **Then** the text is returned unchanged.
- **Given** the Steam path above and a 30-character width (monospace test measure, 1 px per char, `max_px` 30) **When** `middle_ellipsis` runs **Then** the result is `/home/oystein/.local/s…/game.x86_64`.
- **Given** a last component wider than 40% of the width **When** `middle_ellipsis` runs **Then** only its last 12 characters are kept after the ellipsis.
- **Given** text with a combining mark sequence and a flag emoji at the cut point **When** `middle_ellipsis` runs **Then** no grapheme is split.
- **Given** text one character too wide **When** `middle_ellipsis` runs **Then** the text is returned whole (2-character minimum removal).

## Files
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/ellipsis.rs`: create, with tests.
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/mod.rs`: add `pub mod ellipsis;`.
- `crates/tl-ui/Cargo.toml` and root `Cargo.toml`: add `unicode-segmentation = "1.12"` only after the leader settles open item 2.

## Tests
- `text::ellipsis::tests::keeps_last_component`: the Steam example.
- `text::ellipsis::tests::long_tail_keeps_12_chars`: tail rule.
- `text::ellipsis::tests::grapheme_boundary`: combining marks and a flag emoji are not split.
- `text::ellipsis::tests::two_char_minimum`: one-over text stays whole.
- `text::ellipsis::tests::fits_unchanged`: short text unchanged.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: N/A
- Performance: O(n) additions per call; the result is cached per cell by `CellTextCache` keyed by `(row, column, 8 px width bucket)` (E18).
- Privacy: path text is never logged.

## Notes
- Blocked on open item 2 in docs/plan/b5-ui-foundation.md: `unicode-segmentation` is not in the tl-ui row of ADR-001. Do not start until the leader adds it (version 1.12, already in Cargo.lock through gpui-base).

title: E15-004 Untrusted text display rules
description:
## Context
Process-derived text is already sanitized in tl-collect (ADR-015): C0/C1 controls became U+FFFD, bidi controls and U+200B..U+200F were removed. The UI marks U+FFFD visibly in Name cells and applies the name fallback chain. Sources: UI-FND-053 rules 1 to 8, ADR-015 "Untrusted process text", ADR-003. Spec phase P1; phase-0 slice.

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/text/untrusted.rs`:
  - `pub fn split_fffd_runs(text: &str) -> SmallVec<[(Range<usize>, bool /*is_fffd*/); 4]>`: splits a string into runs, `true` for each run of U+FFFD characters.
  - `pub fn name_runs(text: &SharedString, normal: Hsla, warning: Hsla) -> SmallVec<[TextRun; 4]>`: one `TextRun` per run; U+FFFD runs use `status.warning`, others the normal colour. Used only by Name cells; other cells and tooltips draw U+FFFD in the normal colour.
  - `pub fn display_name<'a>(name: &'a str, comm: &'a str, pid: u32, scratch: &'a mut String) -> &'a str`: if `name` is empty or consists only of U+FFFD, return `comm`; if `comm` is empty or only U+FFFD too, write `[pid N]` into `scratch` and return it.
  - `pub fn debug_assert_clean(text: &str)`: in debug builds only, `debug_assert!` that no char in C0 (U+0000..U+001F), DEL, C1 (U+0080..U+009F), U+202A..U+202E, U+2066..U+2069, U+200B..U+200F, U+2028, U+2029 remains. Compiles to nothing in release. U+200D (ZWJ) is allowed.
  - The module header comment states rules 3 to 8 of UI-FND-053: each cell is one LTR paragraph; RTL letters are kept and shaped by cosmic-text; the ellipsis goes at the logical end; no UI mirroring; copy uses the sanitized text.
- Add `pub mod untrusted;` to `text/mod.rs`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Given** `"ab\u{FFFD}\u{FFFD}cd"` **When** `split_fffd_runs` runs **Then** it returns three runs: `ab` (false), the two U+FFFD (true), `cd` (false).
- **Given** that text and `name_runs` **When** colours are read **Then** only the middle run has `status.warning`.
- **Given** name `""`, comm `"bash"` **When** `display_name` runs **Then** it returns `bash`.
- **Given** name `"\u{FFFD}"`, comm `""`, pid 4242 **When** `display_name` runs **Then** it returns `[pid 4242]`.
- **Given** a debug build and text with U+202E **When** `debug_assert_clean` runs **Then** it panics; with U+200D it does not.

## Files

## Tests

- `text::untrusted::tests::empty_name_falls_back_to_comm_then_pid`: both fallbacks.
- `text::untrusted::tests::debug_check_rejects_bidi_allows_zwj` (`#[cfg(debug_assertions)]`, `#[should_panic]` variant for U+202E).
- The RTL render test (`rtl_name_in_ltr_cell`) lives in E18-013 because it needs a table cell.

## Cross-cutting
- Errors: N/A
- Validity: N/A
- Accessibility: U+FFFD is marked by colour and by the replacement glyph itself, not colour alone.
- Performance: no per-frame scan in release; split only when a Name cell's text changes (cached by the caller).
- Privacy: never log the text.

title: E15-005 Component module, TlFocusRing, icons and asset source (U-42)
description:
## Context
Creates the `components` module, the keyboard-only focus ring helper and the icon layer: Lucide names through `gpui_kit::assets::IconName` and an `AssetSource` that serves tasklens SVGs first and falls back to the kit assets. Settles U-42 (the "last input was keyboard" focus-ring heuristic). Sources: UI-FND-003 (icons, focus ring), UI-FND-028 (shield-unlocked glyph), ADR-009 "Icons", R-123, U-42, D-005. Spec phase P1; phase-0 slice (anchor E15-A1).

## Deliverable

- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/focus.rs`:

  - `pub fn ring(el: impl Styled, radius: Pixels, theme: &TlTheme) -> impl Styled`: 2 px solid `accent`, 2 px outside the border box, radius = element radius + 2 (UI-FND-003). Use the kit focus ring drawing where `Theme::focus_ring` is true, or an outer `div` with `border_2` and negative inset.

  - Inputs show focus through `input_focus` background plus 1 px `accent` border, no ring (documented here; drawn by the input component).
  - Fallback if U-42 fails: `pub const KEYBOARD_ONLY_RING: bool = true;` set to `false` makes `show` return `focused` (the kit default of always showing the ring on focus, R-123).

title: E15-006 TlProgress and TlSpinner
description:
## Context
Progress bar and spinner wrappers with fixed sizes, 1% value bucketing and reduced-motion stand-ins. Used by toasts, dialog footers, the Properties hash row, the setup window, the Strings tab header and the Services status text, never in table cells, charts, sidebar cards or the main status bar. Sources: UI-FND-023, ADR-009 (no kit Spinner, Skeleton or Progress in cells or charts), APP-058. Spec phase P1 (toasts) and P2; phase-0 slice because TlButton's loading state needs the spinner (anchor E15-A1).

## Deliverable
- `crates/tl-ui/src/components/progress.rs`:
  - `pub struct TlProgress { value: Option<f32 /*0..=100*/>, size: TlProgressSize::{Sm /*4 px*/, Md /*6 px*/}, show_label: bool, reduced_motion: bool }` (`RenderOnce`). Track `scroll_track`, fill `accent`, radius full, width from the parent. Determinate: `.value(v)`. Indeterminate (`value = None`): a 30% wide segment moving left to right over 1.2 s, looping (kit `Progress::loading(true)`). Optional right-aligned `t_xs` percent label with `tnum` ("37%").
  - Value changes jump: the element `id` includes the 1% bucket (`(value as u32)`), so the kit transition never runs.
